Consensus Cloud Solutions is a publicly traded, leading digital cloud fax and interoperability solutions organization in the United States and globally, focusing on connecting and empowering healthcare providers, payers, care teams, and technology innovators to unify multiple systems that wouldn’t otherwise talk to each other. Consensus is a trailblazer in our industry and believes that data transformation will reshape the world of healthcare.

Founded over 25 years ago, Consensus leverages its technology heritage to move from simple digital documents to advanced healthcare standards (HL7/FHIR) for secure data transport, as well as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to convert unstructured to structured, analytics-ready data, helping users unveil information that is meaningful and actionable for better patient care.

Consensus leads the industry in data exchange solutions and we’re only getting started! With exciting new initiatives on the horizon, we are continuing our strategic expansion and we are looking to add to our diverse team of innovators.

Now is the ideal time to join us in our mission to solve healthcare’s biggest challenges, and work collaboratively with a diverse team of like-minded self-starters and partners to accomplish it.

Consensus Cloud Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We offer many remote and hybrid career opportunities.

How you will impact the organization…

The Senior Information Security Engineer for FedRAMP plays a vital role in maintaining the organization’s FedRAMP High compliance and overall cloud security posture. This position supports the mission of delivering secure, government-compliant services by leading Security Operations (SecOps) projects, managing technical operations, and ensuring compliance with NIST 800-53 Rev 5 standards. Key responsibilities include supporting the Annual 3PAO Assessment, managing OS patching for up to 350 servers, overseeing antivirus and backup solutions, and conducting regular vulnerability scans using tools such as Nessus and Burp Suite. The engineer will oversee endpoint security with FortiClient EMS, handle authentication with Okta for Government, and manage backups with N2WS. They will ensure SOC and technical support coverage, monitor logs and intrusions using Splunk, and conduct security assessments of AWS GovCloud. Additional duties include managing Active Directory user access reviews and access controls, supporting red team and penetration testing, assisting with security impact analysis (SIA), significant change requests (SCR), continuous monitoring (ConMon), and plans of action and milestones (POAMs) in coordination with the FedRAMP GRC team, and leading incident response and disaster recovery exercises. This role also involves mentoring other engineers and supporting change management and annual assessment preparation.

The value you will deliver…

  • Provide project management oversight of FedRAMP SecOps services.
  • Support Annual FedRAMP 3PAO assessments and security control validation.
  • Perform patch management for operating systems on up to 350 servers.
  • Manage antivirus solutions and ensure endpoint security using FortiClient EMS.
  • Oversee AWS backup and disaster recovery using N2WS Backup.
  • Conduct monthly vulnerability scans (OS, database, containers, web apps, STIG baseline) using Nessus and Burp Suite tools and provide reporting and analysis.
  • Perform rescans to confirm remediation of vulnerabilities.
  • Generate monthly security reports and conduct user access reviews.
  • Manage and test functional Disaster Recovery and Incident Response plans per NIST 800-53 Rev 5.
  • Operate and maintain SIEM tools such as Splunk for threat detection and correlation.
  • Ensure Security Operations Center (SOC) response SLAs.
  • Maintain technical support services with a 15-minute callback SLA.
  • Perform continuous log management and intrusion detection monitoring.
  • Conduct configuration consistency checks and quarterly authorized software reviews.
  • Manage AWS GovCloud security groups and access control list reviews.
  • Administer Active Directory account creation, password resets, and YubiKey setup.
  • Manage user access for production and pre-production systems, as well as security tools.
  • Support and validate annual penetration testing and red team exercises.
  • Conduct continuous monitoring (ConMon) and FedRAMP validation scans.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to manage and resolve SIAs, SCRs, and POAMs.
  • Participate in Incident Response and Disaster Recovery testing activities.
  • Contribute to Annual Assessment preparation and Significant Change Management reviews.
  • Mentor and guide other security engineers.
  • Assist with evaluating security tools and conducting proof-of-concept testing for new technologies.
  • Support internal and external security audits beyond FedRAMP (e.g., SOC 2, HITRUST, PCI, etc.).
  • Provide input on security policies, procedures, and documentation updates.
  • Participate in cross-functional project teams for infrastructure or application changes.
  • Deliver internal security awareness or training sessions as needed.
  • Research emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security trends to inform program improvements.
  • Assist in vendor risk assessments and third-party security reviews.
  • Create and maintain technical runbooks, knowledge base articles, and process documentation.
  • Support response efforts for privacy incidents or data breaches involving PII/PHI.
  • Participate in industry or government security forums, working groups, or communities of interest.
  • Provide backup support for other security team members during absences.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as required, assigned, or requested. Consensus reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

What you will bring to the table…

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering or a similar technical security role.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, with at least 4 years in a security engineering role.
  • 5+ years of experience with Vulnerability Management tools for identifying, tracking, and mitigating vulnerabilities across systems and applications. Such as Nessus Pro, Burp Suite, and SonarCube.
  • 5+ years of experience using Endpoint Protection tools like FortiClient Enterprise Management Server (EMS), CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, or SentinelOne to monitor and protect endpoints against threats.
  • 5+ years of experience with Cloud Service Providers and their Security platforms, including cloud-native application protection, cloud security posture management in tools such as AWS Security Hub.
  • 4+ years of experience with AWS security services such as IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and Security Hub.
  • 4+ years of experience implementing Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and baseline configuration management.
  • 4+ years of experience with AWS backup tools such as N2WS Backup for AWS backup and disaster recovery.
  • 4+ years of experience with One-time password systems for secure authentication, such as Okta.
  • 4+ years of experience with SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) platforms, such as Splunk, Elastic, or Exabeam, for detecting, analyzing, and responding to security incidents.
  • 4+ years of experience with Security Monitoring and Incident Response processes, such as Splunk, to manage alerts, monitor for potential threats, and respond effectively.
  • 2+ years of direct experience supporting FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, or similar government security compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, or other government compliance frameworks is strongly preferred.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, Security+, or equivalent are preferred but not required.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Nessus, Splunk, Burp Suite, FortiClient EMS, and AWS GovCloud is required.
  • Ongoing training and continuing education in cybersecurity best practices are encouraged.
  • Experience applying compliance frameworks to support product security efforts, such as ensuring adherence to security best practices during product development and integration, particularly in cloud-based and SaaS environments.
  • Practical experience performing vulnerability scanning, patch management, and incident response.
  • Experience working with security tools such as Nessus, Splunk, FortiClient EMS, and Burp Suite.
  • Familiarity with cloud security, preferably within AWS GovCloud or other regulated cloud environments.
  • Experience managing or supporting a Security Operations Center (SOC) or 24/7 security monitoring environment is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in cross-functional teams and lead technical initiatives.
  • Basic understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks related to product security compliance, such as GDPR, CCPA, and NIST, to ensure the organization meets necessary security standards.
  • Experience in security compliance frameworks, including NIST 800 53 Rev 5 and FedRAMP, to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and security best practices.
  • Demonstrates strong analytical thinking to assess complex systems, identify risks, and interpret vulnerability data.
  • Maintains a high level of attention to detail when reviewing configurations, scan results, and documentation.
  • Possesses strong technical proficiency with security tools, AWS GovCloud, and enterprise IT infrastructure.
  • Applies effective problem-solving skills to resolve security incidents and compliance gaps.
  • Manages multiple concurrent security projects and meets critical deadlines.
  • Communicates technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Adapts quickly to changing threats, technologies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  • Proactively identifies opportunities to improve security posture and operational efficiency.
  • Provides leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, supporting team growth and development.

You will stand out if you also have…

  • Experience supporting or leading FedRAMP High environments or other high-impact government-authorized systems.
  • Experience with Plan of Action and Milestones (POAM) management and working with GRC teams.
  • Exposure to penetration testing and red team operations in cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Experience automating security tasks using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  • Knowledge of ticketing and workflow systems like ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (MESD).
  • Ability to contribute to policy and procedure development and documentation.
  • Strong written communication skills for reporting, analysis, and compliance documentation.
  • Previous mentorship or leadership experience within a security team.

Additional details…

  • Location requirements: Fully remote within the U.S.
  • Travel requirements: Up to 10% travel.

  • Technology requirements: Reliable, high speed internet.

Requirements include (subject to change), but are not limited to, active U.S. Citizenship or green card holder residing in the U.S. for a minimum of 3 consecutive years and working location is in the U.S.

Associate Digital Solutions Engineer (Associate DSE)

THE POSITION IN A NUTSHELL

Sciens Building Solutions is seeking an Associate Digital Solutions Engineer (Associate DSEs) that build and test practical AI and automation tools that make everyday work easier for our field and office teams.

This position will work with the Digital & AI team, reporting to the Chief Digital Officer. Associate DSEs take in ideas from across the business, build pilots for the ones that are prioritized, test them with the people who will use them, and measure whether they work. Pilots that prove out are handed to the delivery team for production builds.

Associate DSEs are encouraged to try modern AI tools and test ideas quickly. Strong performers can grow into the Digital Solutions Engineer role as they take on more ownership.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING (and doing well!)

  • Spend time with field and office teams, take in their ideas, and check whether SAP or a tool we already have can do the job before anything new is built.
  • Build and configure pilot tools using AI, automation, and workflow platforms, starting from use cases prioritized by the Chief Digital Officer.
  • Test pilots with the people who will use them, measure whether they save time or improve results, and refine them based on what you learn.
  • Work with the analytics and systems teams to get the data a pilot needs.
  • Document on how each pilot works, what was tested, and what was learned, and share results in short, clear updates.
  • Support the handoff of validated pilots to the delivery team for production builds.
  • Review AI tools that teams and departments build for themselves before they are shared more widely.
  • Help run tools once they are live by watching answer quality, fixing wrong answers, and flagging tools that are not showing value.

WHAT WE LIKE ABOUT YOU

  • Curious about how a business runs and how technology can make the work easier.
  • Hands-on builder who learns new tools quickly.
  • Interest in applying AI and automation to practical, everyday problems.
  • Prefers simple, testable approaches and is comfortable trying something, measuring it, and adjusting.
  • Asks good questions, takes direction well, and follows work through to the end.

QUALIFICATIONS

Requirements

  • Experience engaging with regulators or government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

Who We Are

Simpplr is the AI-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at .

Overview:

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will own a portfolio of complex, strategic customers and partner with them to achieve their business objectives, maximize the value of their investment in Simpplr, and build long-term successful partnerships.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen with technical curiosity and a proactive mindset. They are comfortable engaging executive stakeholders, navigating complex customer environments, and helping customers realize measurable value from their investment in Simpplr.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

As Simpplr continues to grow globally, we are expanding our Customer Success team and creating a new Senior Customer Success Manager role. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and take ownership of a portfolio of complex, strategic customers across the US and EU market.

Simpplr is a Series D, AI-powered Employee Experience platform that has raised over $131M in funding and is the only 4x Leader across Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and G2.

For individuals looking to accelerate their career, this role provides significant opportunities for learning, growth, visibility, and progression.

Customer Value Realization

  • Drive adoption and measurable business value by helping customers maximize their investment in Simpplr
  • Partner with customers to define success metrics, track progress, and demonstrate value realization throughout the customer lifecycle

Executive Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present business value, adoption insights, strategic recommendations, and success plans to customer leadership teams

Proactive Customer Success & Risk Management

  • Monitor customer health, engagement, and adoption trends to identify risks early
  • Develop and execute mitigation plans to address risks before they impact customer outcomes

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Advocacy

  • Advocate for customer needs and provide actionable feedback to influence product and process improvements.
  • Coordinate internal resources and stakeholders to resolve customer challenges and drive strategic initiatives.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Proven experience managing complex, enterprise customers across either North America or EU Region.
  • Experience leading Executive Business Reviews (EBRs/QBRs) and presenting business value, strategic recommendations, and success plans to executive stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a track record of driving customer retention, growth, and long-term partnerships.
  • Technically savvy with the ability to understand product capabilities, integrations, and customer use cases, and translate technical concepts into business value.
  • Highly proactive with a demonstrated ability to anticipate customer needs, identify risks and opportunities early, and drive actions to successful outcomes with minimal direction.

A first migration kept reports running, and the semantic models now need structure and best practices. This role opens a new engagement and shapes the data foundation that every future report depends on.

The Analytics Developer Senior turns existing data views into a reliable dimensional model and builds the semantic layer that feeds business dashboards. jobs.description:
Crystal Dynamics is constantly seeking the best gaming talent worldwide to add to our 30-plus year legacy of game development creating new and iconic franchises. We are committed to making great games with great people and living the dream while doing it.

Benefits for our regular full-time positions include, but are not limited to, a competitive regional salary, 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance options, professional development reimbursement, flexible hybrid on-site/off-site work opportunities, company paid holidays, plus additional paid days in December when the studio is closed for holiday break, and the ability to accrue additional paid time-off.

Join us and help shape an amazing studio culture, where we’re building award-winning franchises like Tomb Raider and more!

JOB DESCRIPTION

Crystal Dynamics is now accepting applications for a remote spring internship, open to candidates across most U.S. states. As part of this 12-week program, you will take part in meaningful, hands-on work that contributes directly to active AAA projects. Throughout the program, you will step into a professional development environment where ongoing projects, experienced mentors, and collaborative teams give you a direct view into AAA game creation. This internship is designed to help you build industry ready skills, form strong professional relationships, and deepen your understanding of how world class games are made!

Eligibility Criteria: 

  • Graduated from a college or university program in 2026 (Spring, Summer, Fall, or Winter).
  • Degree in Animation, Art, Game Art, Technical Art, Game Design, Game Development, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Availability to work full-time (40 hrs / week), during core business hours, for the duration of the program (February 1st – April 23rd, 2027), including the first week onsite at our studio in San Carlos, CA for onboarding.
  • Legal eligibility to work in the United States.  
  • Submission of a complete application that includes a resume, cover letter, and a link to your portfolio or GitHub. 

What You Will Gain:  

  • Practical Project Involvement: Contribute to active game development efforts while learning production scope, workflows, and the advanced tools used across modern AAA pipelines.  
  • Professional Mentorship: Receive guidance from experienced professionals with deep industry knowledge. 
  • Skill Development: Expand your skill set, establishing a solid foundation for your professional journey.  
  • Team Collaboration: Work alongside our dedicated onsite and remote teams including fellow interns, building valuable professional relationships within the gaming industry.  

What You Will Do:

  • Learn and apply development workflows in Unreal Engine, using Blueprint scripting, rapid prototyping, and playtesting to turn design ideas into working gameplay. Review, test, and refine your work with guidance from your design mentor.
  • Help improve existing combat and traversal mechanics by reproducing issues, debugging Blueprint logic, tuning gameplay values, and building small test spaces to evaluate movement distances, timing, readability, and game feel.
  • Prototype clearly scoped gameplay features with guidance from the project’s design leadership. Potential assignments include progression and upgrade systems, new movement abilities, systemic encounters, or a focused boss encounter. Contribute fresh ideas and iterate on a small playable prototype through regular feedback.
  • Help develop and document repeatable workflows for designing, building, and testing gameplay and levels. Explore Unreal Engine’s procedural content generation (PCG) tools, create reusable test setups, and record what works so others can build on your experiments.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Foundational hands-on experience with Unreal Engine and Blueprint scripting, demonstrated through a small playable project, prototype, or coursework, together with a strong interest in learning and thoughtfully applying game development tools, systems, and workflows.
  • Portfolio examples should show one or more of the following:
    • Gameplay logic or systems you helped build, such as a character ability, movement mechanic, interaction, encounter, or simple progression system. Explain your contribution, how the logic works, and how you investigated a problem or improved the result.
    • A playable gameplay or level prototype that demonstrates experimentation, attention to the player experience, and iteration based on testing or feedback. Personal, classroom, and game jam projects are welcome.
  • Industry involvement outside classroom curriculum such as game jams, personal projects and/or contributions to group projects that show going above and beyond.
  • Exposure to industry-standard development software tools and engines.
  • Willingness to tackle challenges, learn from feedback, and adapt to new tools or workflows.   
  • Ability to communicate your ideas with eagerness to learn and put feedback into action. 

INTERNSHIP FAQ

Interns are vital to our innovation and growth. Below are answers to some of the most frequently asked questions about our internship program. Given the volume of applications we receive, we aren’t able to accept resumes directly via email or provide individual updates through outreach. To be considered, please submit your application through our careers site so your materials are routed to the hiring team for review.

Q: When and how long will the internship take place?

A: The internship is a 12-week, full-time program, with interns working 40 hours per week. The exact dates will vary year over year, and may be subject to change.

Please see our upcoming schedule below for details:

Spring 2027 Internship

  • February 1st – April 23rd, 2027

Q: Where will the internship be located?

A: This is a remote internship for candidates living in eligible US states. However, the first week will be on-site at our studio in San Carlos, California for onboarding and a chance to meet people who you will be working with throughout the internship.

Q: Will this be a paid internship?

A: Yes, the internship will be paid. Hourly rates for each position will be detailed in the job description. Compensation for this internship is $20-23/hr. Compensation is location-based and will be aligned to the intern’s confirmed work location during the program. Interns are also eligible for a medical, dental, and vision benefits package. Your recruiter can provide more information about total compensation. 

Q: What are we expecting an intern to do?

A: Interns will be selected based on our current project needs. Specific responsibilities and expectations for each intern will be outlined in the job description for the internship position you apply for. This will provide valuable hands-on experience within your chosen field at our studio.

Q: Does Crystal Dynamics have a dress code?

A: At Crystal Dynamics, we believe that creativity thrives when you can be yourself. That’s why we encourage you to wear what makes you comfortable and confident, as long as it’s within the bounds of professionalism and respect for others. Whether it’s casual wear or your favorite gaming tee, feel free to showcase your individuality. Just remember, any attire that could be considered offensive or inappropriate is not allowed.

Q: How do I apply?

A: To apply for an internship, please visit our careers page, where you will find detailed information on our current internship openings and the application process. We encourage you to apply since we’re looking at your skills, experience, and potential, not every requirement! Please note that incomplete applications or attempts to submit outside of the careers page will not be considered. If you make our shortlist, we’ll be in touch for further assessments and interviews. We look forward to receiving your application!

Q: What can I do to make my application stand out from the crowd?

A: To make your application stand out, focus on tailoring your resume to the specific internship role you’re interested in and put together a thoughtful cover letter. Highlight any relevant experience or coursework related to game development and consider including a well-organized portfolio if it showcases your skills effectively. Emphasize your ability to work collaboratively in teams, stay informed about industry trends and the studio’s projects, and ensure your application materials are error-free and professional. If you have references who can vouch for your skills, consider including them. Lastly, closely follow application instructions and be thoroughly prepared for interviews, demonstrating your passion and suitability for the role.

Q: Do I need a degree?

A: At Crystal Dynamics, we value diverse backgrounds, including various levels of education and experience. Having a university degree is not a strict requirement for all of our regular full-time positions. However, if you’re interested in our internship program, eligibility is as follows:

Spring 2027 Internship:

  • Recent college or university graduates from Spring/Summer/Fall/Winter 2026 with a relevant degree.

Q: Is there a possibility for an intern to become a full-time employee?

A: We value the impact our interns bring to the teams and projects. Our goal is to give interns the experience they need to be successful after schooling is complete. These opportunities are limited and depend entirely on business needs at the time. Interns are encouraged to make the most of their internship and explore future opportunities with us as they become available.

Q: What perks and benefits does Crystal Dynamics offer to interns?

A: Interns at Crystal Dynamics enjoy a range of perks and benefits. These include competitive compensation, access to industry professionals, networking opportunities, and a supportive learning environment. Additionally, interns will be eligible for medical, dental, and vision benefits and have access to unlimited snacks in the office! Detailed information about these perks and benefits will be provided to successful candidates during the onboarding process.

Q: If I’m not eligible for the program at this time, can I be considered for any future internship programs?

A: If you are not eligible for the program at this time, we encourage you to keep an eye on our future internship opportunities. We regularly assess our needs and welcome talented individuals to apply when suitable positions become available.

The pay for this internship role includes the base hourly rate, and does not include the medical, dental and vision benefits package that interns will also be eligible for.

Overview

The Finance team at Confluent Health needs a true technology partner - someone who understands financial workflows, owns the technical side of financial applications, and works closely with Finance from within IT to solve operational problems.

This role exists to strengthen technology ownership for our financial systems, including revenue cycle management, accounting, billing/claims, and related workflows. You’ll help co-own roadmap decisions, system configuration, process improvements, and vendor relationships across the finance application landscape.

This is an individual contributor role, not a people-management role. The ideal candidate is a finance-technology bridge: someone who can understand how Finance works, translate needs into technical direction, and help move solutions forward with speed and accountability.

The immediate focus will include supporting AI-enabled and automation-supported solutions for revenue cycle and accounting workflows, while serving as the long-term technology owner for financial applications. This role complements, but is distinct from, the AI Solutions Engineer builder role.

  • Serve as the primary technology point of contact for Finance leadership and staff
  • Own vendor relationships, including escalations, performance feedback, and renewal input, and roadmap alignment
  • Use agentic AI tools to help analyze workflows, identify opportunities, and prototype practical solutions
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements and implementation plans
  • Help drive process improvement across finance workflows
  • Partner with IT and AI development resources on automation and AI-enabled solutions
  • Support building, testing, validation, rollout, and continuous improvement for finance technology changes
  • Maintain visibility into system dependencies, integrations, data flows, and risks
  • Drive process improvement across finance workflows with a strong understanding of how technology can improve execution

What Success Looks Like

  • Financial applications have clear technical ownership
  • Finance leadership has a trusted technology partner
  • Revenue cycle automation moves faster and more reliably
  • Financial solutions have a clear and published technical roadmap
  • Agentic AI is used to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and solution design where it creates real value
  • Vendor and system decisions are proactive, not reactive
  • Finance and IT are aligned on the same workflow and the same problem
  • Technology decisions are grounded in how work actually gets done within finance

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years of experience in financial systems, finance operations technology, revenue cycle management, or related workflows
  • Process improvement mindset, including experience in process mapping, documentation, and Process Improvement cross-functional exercises (i.e. Six Sigma).
  • Experience bridging a business function and a technology/IT team with real ownership of outcomes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience working with & managing technology vendors
  • Strong communication skills across business and technical audiences
  • Working knowledge of automation and AI concepts, with the ability to identify practical applications in financial workflows
  • Comfort using agentic AI tools to explore problems, prototype solutions, and support decision-making

Preferred

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a people-management role
  • Not a traditional business analyst role
  • Not a pure developer role
  • This role is about technology ownership, workflow understanding, and solution architecture & development within Finance.

Finance is one of the most important places for technology and workflow to be aligned. This role will help close the gap between Finance and IT, improve how critical financial systems are managed, and accelerate meaningful process improvement across the business.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of finance and technology, this role should be a strong fit.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Account Manager, Client Development & Renewals, you will be tasked with owning a book of existing customer accounts and driving both renewal retention and expansion revenue within them. This is not a transactional renewals seat; it is a growth-first role where renewal is the floor, not the goal, and you will protect the base by keeping renewals healthy and on time and grow it by uncovering and closing whitespace, running consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations, and turning satisfied customers into expanding ones. You will sit within the Client Development / Renewals organization and partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Engineering, in a role built for a rep who is driven to outgrow a base they know well, own their numbers, and earn a path to strategic accounts or AE-track roles through expansion results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Manage renewals end to end, from early quoting and multi-threading through negotiation and on-time close; keep renewal timelines definitive and forecasts predictable across your book, so the primary focus remains on whitespace and expansion with your accounts; handle commercial negotiation on your accounts, including multi-year commitments, with support on the most complex deals.

At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. Find out more: Our approach to R&D


We’re looking for a Clinical Development Director to shape the future of our respiratory portfolio. In this role, you’ll lead the scientific design and delivery of clinical studies across multiple stages of drug development and play a pivotal part in driving our clinical research and development strategy.

Position Summary
You will lead the clinical development of respiratory disease programs, working closely with global teams to design and deliver impactful clinical studies. Your role will help shape operational strategies that advance important treatments, supporting patients and healthcare providers. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. This position offers a unique chance to grow your expertise, make meaningful contributions, and be part of our mission: uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Responsibilities
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  • Generating the data and evidence required to determine a medicine’s potential efficacy, safety profile, key areas of product differentiation and value to patient in the shortest possible timeframe
  • Providing effective support / oversight of evidence generation activities to assure patient safety and study delivery
  • Contributing to regulatory interactions including clinical trial applications, briefing documents, presentations, addressing questions and responses
  • Contributing to the writing of the clinical study synopsis (CSP), study protocols, clinical study reports (CSR) and any subsequent study abstract and manuscript publications
  • Supporting the strategic management of the Integrated Evidence Plan (IEP), including the Clinical Development Plan (CDP) for an asset in development
  • Ensuring alignment with and support to project strategic plans, regulatory requirements and commercial goals, optimizing clinical study design aligned with IEP and CDP
  • Delivering clinical development timelines, enabling key decision points and Go/No Go criteria for the CDP
  • Developing and maintaining relationships with matrix counterparts in Commercial, Research, Regulatory, Clinical Operations and Statistics.
  • Serving as a clinical point of contact for senior management and senior level matrix teams, both internally and externally for an asset in development
  • Interfacing and influencing a diverse range of scientific external experts (e.g. regulators, payors, CROs, consultants, investigators) in order to deliver clinical programs and align to business strategy and address patient needs
  • Contributing to the implementation and embedding of strategic initiatives and various organizational initiatives in Clinical Sciences
  • Identifying and highlighting transformational opportunities where projects can offer highly significant benefit to patients in ways not possible with existing approaches


Why You?

Basic Qualifications
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science related field
  • 3 years of Significant clinical training and/or applicable clinical research experience; understanding of clinical development planning and running clinical trial from concept study idea to publication.
  • Robust knowledge of ICH guidelines, GCP, FDA requirements, regulatory and reimbursement data requirements in responsible area
  • Solid understanding of needs and priorities of regulators, payers and prescribers in relevant market(s)
  • Demonstrated experience using new learning and digital tools to create innovation in other areas
  • Thorough understanding of clinical research methodology and biostatistics principles, to facilitate innovative and efficient clinical trial design, and clinical development plans with clear data-driven decision rules
  • Proven ability to utilize statistics, and visualisation techniques to interpret or analyse complex information and make correct inferences and conclusions.

Preferred Qualifications
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • PhD or PharmD degree valuable but not required
  • Experience leading matrix teams with a strong reputation of inspiring and motivating high performance
  • Previous experience as a Clinical science Lead (CSL) at GSK, or a similar position in another company
  • Significant experience in respiratory clinical drug development with an understanding of the disease area, the underlying biology and potential therapeutic targets.


Work Arrangement

This role is home based in Canada, preferably in Ontario.

Are you ready to bring your clinical development experience to a team that’s making a real impact? Join us, and together we will push boundaries and create better outcomes for people affected by respiratory diseases. Apply today and let’s get ahead of disease together.


Skills

Analytical Thinking, Business Acumen, Change Management, Clinical Research, Clinical Trial Designs, Communication, Decision Making, Fostering Collaboration, Influencing Without Authority, Leadership, Matrix Leadership, Mentorship, People Management, Risk Management, Strategic Thinking

Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

jobs.excerpt: Safe Childhoods is an international initiative dedicated to mobilising more—and more effective—philanthropic funding to prevent and respond to childhood sexual violence.
jobs.description:
Safe Childhoods is an international initiative dedicated to mobilising more—and more effective—philanthropic funding to prevent and respond to childhood sexual violence. We work with leading philanthropists, foundations and partners around the world to raise awareness, connect donors with trusted experts and organisations, and unlock larger, longer-term and more strategic investments. Our mission is to transform how philanthropy addresses childhood sexual violence, making prevention and effective responses a global priority.

Safe Childhoods is hosted by Purposeful Ventures, a UK charity that partners with social entrepreneurs and philanthropists to build and grow organisations that improve the lives of children and young people. Purposeful Ventures is committed to creating a fairer society in which every young person can thrive. The Senior Communications Manager, will be employed by Purposeful Ventures.

The Senior Communications Manager is an exciting new role that will play a central part in developing Safe Childhoods’ communications and strengthening its external profile. Working closely with the Executive Director and wider team, you will help ensure that Safe Childhoods communicates clearly, consistently and credibly with funders, partners and the wider philanthropic and civil society community.

You will help develop and implement Safe Childhoods’ communications strategy, producing high-quality content across publications, newsletters, the website, social media, event materials and donor-facing communications. You will support the Executive Director and senior colleagues with presentations, talking points and written materials, while helping to establish a consistent voice and visual identity across our communications.

We are looking for an excellent writer and editor with strong judgement, creativity and attention to detail. You will be able to translate complex and sensitive issues into clear, compelling and carefully considered communications for philanthropic audiences. You will be highly organised, comfortable managing multiple priorities and capable of delivering high-quality work independently, while knowing when to seek input and guidance.

This is an opportunity to take significant ownership of communications within an ambitious, growing international initiative. You will work closely with colleagues across donor engagement, field-facing work and operations, helping to develop the content, materials and communications approaches that strengthen Safe Childhoods’ reach, credibility and impact.

Please download thefull job descriptionon the Purposeful Ventures website.

Job Description

Purpose

To support the development and delivery of Safe Childhoods’ communications, ensuring that the initiative communicates clearly, consistently and credibly with funders, partners and the wider philanthropic and civil society community. The Senior Communications Manager will take responsibility for producing high-quality communications and maintaining a consistent organisational voice, with particular attention to accuracy, sensitivity and sound judgement.

Responsibilities and duties

Communications strategy and content

  • Contribute to the development and implementation of Safe Childhoods’ communications strategy, ensuring activities support organisational priorities and reach key audiences.

  • Manage the production of key communications materials, including publications, newsletters, website content, social media, event materials and donor-facing communications.

  • Translate complex and sensitive issues into clear, engaging and accessible content for philanthropic and partner audiences.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen the quality, consistency and reach of Safe Childhoods’ communications.

Executive and senior communications support

  • Work closely with the Executive Director and senior colleagues to develop presentations, talking points, speeches and other written materials.

  • Provide high-quality writing, editing and proofreading support, adapting content to different audiences and purposes.

  • Support the preparation of donor briefings, external correspondence and other materials as required.

Voice, identity and quality

  • Maintain a consistent organisational voice, tone and visual identity across communications outputs.

  • Exercise sound judgement on safeguarding, reputational considerations and power dynamics when developing and reviewing communications.

  • Ensure that all external materials are accurate, accessible and produced to a high standard, with appropriate review and approval processes followed.

  • Develop and maintain practical communications processes, templates and resources to support consistency and efficiency across the team.

Events and external profile

  • Coordinate communications for webinars, convenings and other events, working closely with colleagues and external suppliers.

  • Develop event-related content, including invitations, programmes, speaker briefings, presentations and follow-up communications.

  • Support appropriate media engagement and other public-facing activities, balancing opportunities to strengthen Safe Childhoods’ profile with the need for discretion.

  • Provide communications and practical event support alongside the events agency and operations team as required.

The job description is subject to change and the postholder may be required to undertake tasks not specifically referred to above. Such duties, however, will fall within the scope of the job description.

Who we are looking for

Essential

Key requirements

  • Passionate about creating a fairer society where all young people thrive.

  • Demonstrable track record of taking ownership of responsibilities and delivering on commitments.

  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to produce clear, nuanced material for different audiences.

  • Able to produce simple, high-quality visual materials independently using tools such as Canva, while knowing when to bring in specialist design support.

  • Strong strategic judgement and the ability to communicate appropriately about complex and sensitive issues.

  • Thoughtful, calm and attentive to safeguarding, reputation and power dynamics across various communications channels.

  • Comfortable working in a small team, managing multiple deadlines and producing high-quality work autonomously.

  • Right to work in the UK.

Knowledge

  • Strong working knowledge of strategic communications, audience-focused messaging and multi-channel content development.

  • Understanding of the reputational, safeguarding and ethical considerations involved in communicating about sensitive issues.

Experience

  • Demonstrable experience of developing and delivering communications strategies and high-quality external communications.

  • Demonstrable experience of writing and editing complex material for senior, external or philanthropic audiences.

  • Experience of producing communications across a mix of channels such as publications, newsletters, websites, social media, presentations and events.

Skills and competencies

  • Effective, engaging and nuanced communicator, written and verbal, with the ability to structure and articulate complex information for internal and external audiences.

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver multiple pieces of work to deadline.

  • Ability to be pragmatic and agile, using good judgement to identify the most effective actions.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with senior colleagues, partners and external suppliers.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion

Desirable

  • Experience in a foundation, charity, international development, advocacy or field-building context.

  • Experience supporting events, media or other public-facing communications.

  • Advanced design skills or experience working with professional design tools.

Overview

Goldbelt Professional Services specializes in providing expert resources for Public Health missions including scientific, technical, and administrative support from junior staff to high-level subject matter experts. Research and data driven, Goldbelt Professional Services’ experts create solutions customized to the client’s needs.

Summary:

Goldbelt Professional Services is seeking a Data Analyst I to provide NHSN Dialysis Event Prevention and surveillance training support within the Surveillance Branch (SB).

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Provide direct user support guidance for the NHSN Dialysis Event module from a user perspective.
  • Conduct user outreach and education and provide consultation/technical assistance to dialysis provider groups, quality improvement organizations, and health departments.
  • Analyze the NHSN system's daily function and develop system modifications to improve data quality; track modifications.
  • Update surveillance forms, instructions, and protocols with improvement recommendations.
  • Develop data validation projects to evaluate and improve quality.
  • Work with Division SMEs to enhance usability of NHSN surveillance data for prevention efforts.
  • Manage reports, data file exchanges, and agreements between CDC and partner organizations.
  • Review user inquiries related to NHSN and CMS quality incentive programs and prepare response documents.
  • Handle inquiries, perform enrollment, and support correct application of CDC HAI definitions and data entry. Expected volume is 212 per month (range 122–415).
  • Identify user/system issues requiring modification; contribute to development and prioritization of modifications.
  • Develop NHSN modules and electronic reporting mechanisms; communicate with users to improve interface and group functions.
  • Prepare and present educational trainings (20–30 annually) about NHSN.
  • Write and review training/educational documents and outreach messages.
  • Contribute subject matter support for meeting planning related to NHSN, the Coalition, and dialysis safety.
  • Create draft CDC communication materials promoting HAI prevention strategies.
  • Write/review content for the CDC Dialysis Safety webpage.
  • Perform data management, cleaning, and quality assessment analyses.
  • Perform NHSN data analyses for CMS quality incentive programs and create user reports.
  • Advocate with partners to increase participation in ESRD Network, NCC, and other CMS HAI prevention activities.
  • Develop and promote CDC infection prevention and surveillance resources.
  • Review and develop website materials and communications related to infection prevention, surveillance, and response.
  • Participate during CDC response activities and training exercises under direction of the DHQP Team Lead; duties include staffing the EOC desk to help support CDC's mission.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Knowledge of the principles, concepts, methods, and techniques of public health research and evaluation to analyze, evaluate, and provide expert advice and consultation.
  • Knowledge of the principles, methods, applications, and state-of-the-art technology in the position's scientific area of responsibility to provide direction and guidance on critical and complex issues.
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing to make clear, convincing presentations.
  • Knowledge of the rules, procedures, and principles that govern intramural and extramural program development, monitoring, and evaluation.
  • Highly proficient in using Microsoft Office Tools (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint).
  • Excellent judgment and decision-making; capable of working independently with ability to multitask successfully.
  • Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication in interpersonal exchanges.
  • Highly organized with great attention to detail.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1 – 2 years of experience providing public health data analysis and manipulating, cleaning, and reporting data using a variety of statistical functions.
  • Highly proficient in using various statistical software (SAS, R, Python, etc.)
  • Knowledge of data management systems and application of data management software.
  • Previous experience working with the government procedures and guidelines.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain CDC Public Trust Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Public Health, or related field.
  • 3 – 5 years of experience providing public health data analysis and manipulating, cleaning, and reporting data using a variety of statistical functions.
  • Prior experience working with the CDC is highly desired to understand the culture and environment.

Pay and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $80,000.00 to $90,000.00 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Job Title: Business Analyst (Agile)

Location: Caribbean/Remote

Role Summary

The Agile Business Analyst will be a key partner to the internet and mobile banking teams, driving the successful delivery of agile projects that enhance digital banking experiences. This role bridges business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions are customer- centric, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The Agile BA will champion agile practices, facilitate rapid iteration, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic financial services environment. They will develop a deep understanding of the product and provide the business context with a focus on the end-to-end process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agile Requirements Elicitation & Analysis: Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather, refine, and prioritize user stories and requirements. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives). Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Business Process Improvement: Analyze current digital banking processes, identify pain points, and recommend enhancements leveraging agile methodologies. Support automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance in solution design. Identify potential impacts of proposed designs to any element of the end-to-end process.
  • Solution Design & Validation: Work with cross-functional teams to design and validate solutions that meet business and customer needs. Participate in solution evaluation, ensuring alignment with agile principles and maximizing value delivery.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Develop stakeholder maps and communication plans tailored to agile project environments. Act as a liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring transparency and shared understanding.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Support the creation and execution of test plans, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and continuous feedback loops. Troubleshoot issues and facilitate rapid resolution during sprints.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain agile documentation (user stories, process maps, release notes). Facilitate training and onboarding for new systems and processes. Identify new procedures and job aids to be developed or impacts to existing documentation.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide insights through data analysis to inform decision- making and measure project success.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts) and feedback

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years experience as a Business Analyst on agile projects, preferably in financial services or digital banking.
  • Proven track record supporting internet/mobile banking initiatives.

Kriya is a biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to develop life-changing gene therapies for diseases affecting millions of patients around the world.

We leverage our proprietary computational engine, in-house manufacturing infrastructure, and integrated design platform to engineer technologies and therapeutics with the potential to transform the treatment of a broad universe of diseases of high unmet need, with a focus on metabolic disorders, neurology, and ophthalmology.

We are proud to have been named Triangle Business Journal’s Life Sciences 2024 “Best Private Company to Work For,” recognized by Forbes as one of “America’s Best Startup Employers of 2024,” and honored as one of BioSpace’s “2025 Best Places to Work.”

Role Overview

The Vice President, Biometrics leads all biometrics functions at Kriya Therapeutics, including biostatistics, statistical programming, and clinical data management. This leader develops and executes the statistical and data strategy for the clinical pipeline, ensures the integrity and quality of data supporting regulatory submissions, and builds the team and systems needed to move programs from early clinical studies through registration. The role is a member of the clinical development leadership team and a trusted partner to Clinical, Regulatory, Translational, CMC, and Quality.

The VP will apply deep expertise in rare and common disease trial design, novel endpoints, and natural history and external control approaches to a modality where the data package must be both rigorous and efficient.

Key Responsibilities
  • Strategy and leadership. Develop and execute the biometrics strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap in line with the clinical development plan. Serve on the clinical development leadership team and represent Biometrics to executive management and, alongside the CMO, to the Board as needed.
  • Biostatistics. Provide statistical leadership for trial design, sample size, endpoint selection, adaptive and Bayesian methods, interim analyses, and statistical analysis plans across all programs. Lead use of natural history data, external controls, and real-world evidence in support of development and regulatory strategy
  • Regulatory interaction. Lead biometrics content and execution, in partnership with Regulatory, for FDA, EMA, and other health authority interactions, including pre-IND, End-of-Phase meetings, Scientific Advice, INDs, and BLAs/MAAs. Ensure submission-ready datasets, ADaM/SDTM packages, and define files meet CDISC and agency standards.
  • Statistical programming and data standards. Oversee SDTM and ADaM development, TLFs, integrated summaries, and programming validation. Establish standards, metadata repositories, and reusable macros that support quality and speed.
  • Long-term follow-up and safety data. Partner with Clinical Safety and Clinical Operations on data strategy for long-term follow-up required for gene therapy programs, including DSMB and independent data monitoring committee support.
  • Vendor and CRO oversight. Select, govern, and manage CROs and technology vendors for biometrics services, with clear performance metrics, quality agreements, and budget accountability.
  • Clinical data management. Ensure high-quality, inspection-ready data collection, cleaning, and database lock across internal and CRO-managed studies. Oversee EDC selection and build, data review, external data integration, and risk-based quality management.
  • Quality and compliance. Ensure compliance with GCP, ICH, 21 CFR Part 11, and applicable data privacy requirements. Maintain inspection readiness and lead biometrics participation in audits and inspections.
  • People and organization. Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing team. Help build a scalable organization as the company moves toward commercial readiness, and manage functional budgets and resource planning.

Experience & Skills and Work Environment

Experience & Skills
  • PhD in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required; MS with exceptional experience may be considered.
  • 12 or more years of biometrics experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry, including 5 or more years leading biometrics teams or functions
  • Proven track record leading or substantially contributing to biometrics for successful regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA/MAA) and approvals; experience with cell and gene therapy, rare disease, or ophthalmology/cardiology/neurology programs is strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of CDISC standards, ICH guidelines, FDA and EMA expectations, and statistical methodology for novel and adaptive designs. Demonstrated experience with health authority interactions, DSMB support, and inspection readiness.
  • Technical proficiency with SAS, R, and statistical programming (SDTM, ADaM, TLFs), plus oversight of clinical data management and EDC.
  • Experience managing CRO and vendor relationships and building scalable systems and processes.
  • Strong executive presence, with the ability to communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to cross-functional leaders, regulators, and executive management.
  • Strategic thinking that connects data and statistical strategy to program value.
  • Scientific rigor combined with pragmatism and speed.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and the ability to influence without authority.
  • Talent development and the ability to lead, build, and scale teams.
  • Accountability for quality, timelines, and budget.

You'll build programs that recruit new MSPs, grow pipeline and revenue through existing and new business, enable partners to sell and market Mimecast, and strengthen MSP engagement and retention. You'll turn global strategy into consistent regional execution across demand generation, campaigns, content, events, enablement and lifecycle marketing.

  • Own the global MSP marketing strategy, annual plan and budget, aligning with MSP leaders and corporate marketing on regional goals and KPIs. Represent MSP marketing in executive forums.

Location: US Remote

Role Overview

Nasuni is looking for a Senior Manager, Marketing Operations (PMO) to build and scale the operating system that turns marketing strategy into predictable execution.

You will own the Marketing PMO function, creating the planning rhythms, governance, work-management infrastructure, and cross-functional processes that help our marketing organization prioritize effectively, execute consistently, and adapt quickly as the business grows.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has built or significantly evolved a PMO, centralized planning function, or comparable operating model—not simply managed projects within an established system.

You will also lead complex strategic programs spanning Marketing, IT, Sales Operations, Finance, and other business functions, including acquisition integrations and transformation initiatives.

This role reports to the VP of Marketing Operations and works closely with functional marketing leaders and executive stakeholders.

Level & Scope

You will independently own the Marketing PMO operating model while partnering with the VP of Marketing Operations on strategic direction and priorities.

You will have autonomy to diagnose execution challenges, design governance and planning mechanisms, establish operating cadences, improve workflows, and drive adoption across teams where you may have influence but no direct authority.

The role combines operating-model design with hands-on execution. You will build the system and also lead it until the system can operate predictably at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and continuously improve Marketing’s integrated planning and operating cadence, including sprint planning, business reviews, quarterly planning, and cross-functional execution management.
  • Build scalable PMO governance that improves prioritization, accountability, handoffs, visibility, and delivery predictability across marketing functions.
  • Own and optimize Smartsheet as Marketing’s primary work-management environment, including workspace architecture, dashboards, templates, automations, and executive visibility.
  • Lead complex strategic programs spanning multiple functions, including acquisition integrations, business transformation initiatives, systems projects, and other leadership priorities.
  • Design and improve Marketing’s request and intake processes, establishing clear standards for prioritization, briefs, routing, ownership, and service expectations.
  • Identify execution risks, dependencies, and blockers early and work across functions to resolve them without relying on executive escalation.
  • Establish meaningful operating metrics, including delivery performance, governance adoption, backlog health, milestone completion, and planning predictability.
  • Partner with the VP of Marketing Operations to evolve PMO capabilities and build repeatable approaches for future integrations and transformation programs.
  • Apply AI-enabled tools to improve appropriate operational workflows such as planning, project synthesis, reporting, analysis, and workflow automation while maintaining validation, data awareness, and human accountability.

What Success Looks Like

In your first several months, you will take independent ownership of core planning and sprint cadences, establish a reliable source of truth for project execution, strengthen intake governance, and create structured workplans for priority strategic initiatives.

Over time, the Marketing Rhythm of Business should operate predictably without VP-level facilitation. Teams should experience the PMO as a function that creates clarity and makes execution easier—not as an additional layer of bureaucracy.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Demonstrated experience building, establishing, or substantially evolving a PMO, centralized planning function, or comparable operating model.
  • Experience leading complex programs across multiple business functions without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Strong enterprise work-management platform expertise, including advanced use of Smartsheet or comparable platforms involving dashboards, automation, templates, governance, and scalable workspace design.
  • Demonstrated ability to design operating processes that improve accountability, adoption, and execution—not simply administer existing processes.
  • Strong influence and stakeholder-management skills with experience working across functional and leadership boundaries.
  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools to improve professional workflows, with clear methods for validating outputs and maintaining human accountability.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or comparable project/program management certification.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, SharePoint, and Slack.
  • Experience with marketing budget governance or financial forecasting.

Ideal

  • Experience building a Marketing PMO or integrated marketing planning function from the ground up.
  • Experience supporting M&A integration or other significant cross-organizational transformation programs.
  • Advanced Smartsheet architecture and automation expertise.
  • Evidence of creating repeatable AI-enabled operational workflows that improve speed, quality, visibility, or decision-making.

Experience Guidelines

Candidates will typically bring 8+ years of relevant professional experience, including meaningful experience in program management, PMO, marketing operations, business operations, or a related discipline.
