jobs.excerpt: Overview At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward.
jobs.description:
Overview

At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the mission, vision and values that define our organization.

As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.

What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it. Each decision we make is rooted in seven core values:

  • Clinical quality
  • Integrity
  • Service excellence
  • Teamwork
  • Accountability
  • Continuous improvement
  • Inclusion

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Principal Architect – Security, responsible for working with stakeholders, both leadership and subject matter experts, to build a holistic view of the organization’s security architecture, controls, and risk posture. This individual will utilize knowledge and experience to link the business mission, strategy, and processes of the organization to a secure-by-design IT strategy, and document this utilizing multiple architectural models or views that show how the current and future needs of the organization will be met in an efficient, sustainable, agile, adaptable, and secure manner. A central focus of this role is embedding security into architecture decisions across SCA’s hybrid, partner-driven environment and serving as the authoritative security voice at the Architecture Review Board. Because SCA maintains its own identity boundary with no federation to its Optum/UHG parent, this role treats identity as the primary control plane and delivers secure access through a Zero Trust, Zscaler-anchored model.

Key Accountabilities

  • Develop, maintain, promote, and evangelize an enterprise view of the security architecture blueprint and roadmap for the organization
  • Align the security strategy, controls, and solutions with the Company’s business objectives and defined risk appetite
  • Serve as the authoritative security reviewer at the ARB/DRB, evaluating architectures for security fitness and recording the Security domain sign-off
  • Partner with the CISO organization to ensure architecture aligns with the NIST CSF-aligned security remediation framework, coordinating it with the EA-owned Technical Debt Management Framework
  • Establish and lead the threat modeling practice required by Optum for qualifying solution architectures — defining which architectures trigger a threat model, the method applied (e.g., STRIDE), and how threat-model findings are remediated and carried into the ARB security sign-off
  • Perform architecture risk assessments across initiatives, mapping mitigations to the design and reducing project risk
  • Provide strategic security consultation to assigned business customers in designing technology-based solutions, and identify enabling security technologies based on requirements
  • Design and publish security patterns and reference architectures spanning identity and access management, zero-trust, data protection, network segmentation, secrets management, and logging/detection
  • Own the enterprise identity and access management architecture as the primary control plane for Zero Trust — directory and identity services (Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory), authentication and federation standards (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM), Conditional Access, MFA and passwordless, and RBAC/ABAC authorization models
  • Architect identity governance and privileged access — joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle and automated provisioning/deprovisioning, access certification and entitlement reviews, and privileged access management (e.g., Entra Privileged Identity Management) with just-in-time, least-privilege elevation
  • Design cross-boundary, workforce, and partner identity for SCA’s separated identity model — Optum-issued contractor identities, B2B/guest access, and Citrix — where SCA and the Optum parent maintain distinct identity stores without federation; define workload and non-human identity patterns (service principals, managed identities, workload federation) and secrets management to eliminate long-lived credentials
  • Architect data protection for PHI and PII in the ASC context, including encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and masking/tokenization
  • Establish the Zero Trust network and secure-access architecture on the Zscaler SSE/SASE platform — Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) for identity- and posture-aware access to private applications, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) for secure web/egress and inline inspection, and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for monitoring — replacing implicit-trust VPN patterns and enforcing segmentation and ingress/egress controls
  • Extend the Zscaler platform into the broader control set where it fits — CASB and DLP for SaaS, posture control, and device-posture signals feeding Conditional Access — with clean integration to Entra ID, endpoint tooling, and logging/detection
  • Provide cloud and SaaS security architecture, in particular for Microsoft Azure, including landing-zone guardrails, policy-as-code, and shared-responsibility clarity
  • Map security controls to applicable frameworks (NIST CSF, HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, PCI) with ownership and an evidence approach
  • Guide vulnerability management and supply-chain security, including SBOM, patching, and security gates in the SDLC/CI-CD pipeline
  • Lead the security architecture review of third-party and vendor solutions, with particular rigor for Tier 1 PHI vendors
  • Monitor and manage security-related technical debt within the environment, coordinating remediation priority with the CISO framework
  • Contribute to the growth and maturity of the IT department through mentorship, knowledge transfer, and thought leadership by example
  • Articulate security architecture concepts, risk, and analytical findings to Executive Management, business leadership, software developers, and end users
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 8-10+ years of experience in security architecture and engineering, with the most recent role in an architect or technical leadership capacity
  • 2-5+ years of experience working in an architect or technical leadership capacity
  • Solid understanding of healthcare provider (ASC) security and compliance obligations (HIPAA, HITRUST), with the ability to provide a trusted voice at the decision-making table
  • Strong command of security frameworks and control catalogs: NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, HITRUST, SOC 2, and PCI DSS
  • Deep identity and access management expertise: directory and identity platforms (Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory), federation and authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM), Conditional Access, MFA and passwordless, and RBAC/ABAC authorization
  • Identity governance and privileged access experience: IGA lifecycle and provisioning, access certification and entitlement management, and PAM with just-in-time elevation (e.g., Entra Privileged Identity Management); experience with workforce/partner identity across separated, non-federated identity stores — including externally issued contractor identities, B2B/guest, and Citrix — is a strong plus
  • Thorough understanding of cloud security and governance, in particular Microsoft Azure (landing zones, guardrails, policy-as-code)
  • Data protection expertise: encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and masking/tokenization for PHI and PII
  • Strong network and boundary security background, including segmentation and zero-trust network access
  • Hands-on Zscaler experience across the SSE platform — Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) — designing zero-trust access to replace legacy VPN, with an understanding of how Zscaler integrates with identity (Entra ID) and device posture
  • Proficiency with threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) and risk assessment methodologies as they relate to integration and software engineering
  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing a threat-modeling program — establishing trigger criteria, applying a recognized methodology (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA, or attack-tree analysis), and integrating findings into architecture governance — not just performing individual threat models
  • Experience with security logging, monitoring, and detection, including SIEM and SOC integration
  • Experience with vulnerability management, SBOM, and DevSecOps / secure SDLC practices, including CI/CD security gates
  • Knowledge of TOGAF and a security architecture framework such as SABSA required; certification preferred (CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP, CCSP, SABSA, Microsoft SC-300 Identity and Access Administrator, Azure security certifications, or Zscaler certifications such as ZCCA/ZCCP)
  • Excellent conceptual and security design pattern skills irrespective of technology, and willingness to assume total ownership of security architecture from inception to delivery
  • Experience creating an effective framework and process model for establishing enterprise-wide security architecture
  • Ability and willingness to document security architecture, integrations, and dependencies for existing platforms and systems currently in use at SCA
  • Understanding and experience implementing the strategic alignment of business and security
  • Experience with third-party and vendor security risk management, particularly for Tier 1 PHI SaaS vendors
  • Demonstrated competency in communicating the value of security architecture to stakeholders and senior management
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to develop and conduct executive-level presentations
  • Ability to collaborate with various levels of individuals – both IT and business
  • Self-directed with the ability to work effectively under tight deadlines
  • Experience with Mergers & Acquisitions, in areas of security diligence and integration, is desirable.

About the Role

We are building out a dedicated Application Support function for our GCP-hosted, microservices-based commercial card and payments platform. This mid-level analyst is the second US seat on the team, working alongside a Lead Application Support Engineer who anchors the function.

You will handle tier-1 and tier-2 support tickets independently, investigate issues across GCP logs and MySQL data, and be a reliable presence during US banking hours for our bank clients. This is a hands-on investigation role — you will spend real time in log consoles and query interfaces, not just routing tickets.

Location

  • Zact is a global company with multiple locations across US, Europe and India.
  • We provide 100% Remote Working Option.
  • Candidates applying for this role should be located in India;

What You’ll Do

Day-to-Day Ticket Handling

  • Own the Zendesk ticket queue during US hours — triage incoming issues by severity, respond within SLA, and resolve or escalate with full documentation
  • Handle known incident types independently using the team’s runbook library — no need to escalate for established patterns
  • Be the first US contact for bank client technical queries — acknowledge promptly, investigate thoroughly, communicate clearly
  • Cover the queue when the Lead is occupied with complex incidents, client escalations, or tooling work

Investigation & Triage

  • Search and filter GCP Cloud Logging to find error entries, trace requests across microservice boundaries using correlation IDs, and identify where failures occur in the service chain
  • Write MySQL SELECT queries against production read replicas to investigate transaction status, card data, account records, and settlement details
  • Escalate to the Lead with a structured handoff — logs reviewed, queries run, hypothesis formed, nothing left vague
  • For P1/P0 incidents, join the Lead immediately — contribute to the investigation rather than waiting for direction

Monitoring & Alerting

  • Check GCP monitoring dashboards and Zendesk alert channels at shift start — surface anything anomalous before clients report it
  • Track open incidents across shifts and ensure clean handoff to the team at end of US day
  • Flag alert noise or misconfigured thresholds to the Lead — you are on the front line and will notice signal problems first

Client Communication

  • Write clear, professional, jargon-free updates to banking client operations teams during and after incidents
  • Follow up on resolved tickets — confirm the fix, provide a plain-language explanation, close cleanly
  • Maintain a professional tone under pressure; bank clients operate in regulated, audit-sensitive environments

Documentation & Knowledge base

  • Document every new issue investigated — symptom, logs found, queries run, resolution or escalation path
  • Contribute to and improve runbook entries after resolving incidents
  • Build and share a personal MySQL query library for common investigation patterns

Technology Environment

  • Cloud platform: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Logs & monitoring: GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring — primary investigation tools
  • Database: MySQL — read-only investigation queries (SELECT only; strict change-control for anything else)
  • Architecture: Microservices — REST APIs; tracing requests across services using correlation IDs
  • Ticketing: Zendesk — managing your queue, documenting investigations, client communication
  • Scripting: Python / Bash — desirable; the Lead will help you grow here if needed
  • Product domain: Commercial card programs — card issuance, payments authorization, settlement, spend controls
  • Client environment: US community and regional banks — SLA-bound, audit-sensitive, regulated

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years in application support, technical support, IT operations, or a closely related role
  • Solid SQL — you write SELECT queries with JOINs, subqueries, and WHERE clauses without needing a template; you read query results and know what to look for
  • GCP Cloud Logging or equivalent — you have used at least one cloud log platform (CloudWatch, Splunk, Kibana, Datadog, or GCP) to investigate a real production issue
  • Familiarity with microservice concepts — you understand that a user action may touch multiple backend services and know how to trace a request across them
  • REST API literacy — HTTP status codes, reading API responses, identifying where in a request chain an error originated
  • Methodical troubleshooting — you rule out possibilities systematically and document as you go
  • Clear written communication — you can write a calm, professional client-facing update mid-incident
  • Change-control discipline — you never modify production data without explicit authorization

Nice to Have

  • GCP-specific experience — Cloud Logging query syntax (Log Explorer), Cloud Monitoring dashboard navigation
  • Familiarity with Zendesk as a support platform — using ticket views, macros, and SLA tracking
  • Basic Python or Bash scripting — log parsing, simple automation, or one-off scripts count
  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment — fintech, banking, healthcare, or telecoms
  • Exposure to commercial card or payments concepts — authorization flows, settlement, spend controls — helpful but fully trainable

Working Hours

  • Standard shift of 8–10 hours per day, US business hours (Eastern or Central preferred for bank client coverage)
  • ~2-hour overlap with India team at start of US day — used for handoff, standups, and any incidents in flight

You will work on projects ranging from 12 kV to 500 kV, supporting designs from early concept through construction and commissioning. This opportunity is ideal for a principal engineer who enjoys technical ownership, mentoring others, and solving complex system-level challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the Qualus’ Protection & Control Subject Matter Expert (SME), providing technical governance across multiple projects and programs
  • Set and uphold protection, control, and metering philosophy, standards, and best practices for high voltage substations
  • Serve as Principal Engineer or Technical Authority on complex, high risk, or non standard projects, providing final technical approval and direction
  • Provide review and approval of: -Protection planning, philosophy, and application documents-One-lines, schematics, logic diagrams, panel layouts, and wiring diagrams
  • Oversee protection coordination studies and relay settings for utility transmission systems, including review and validation of work performed by others
  • Chair or participate in senior-level design reviews, hazard and risk assessments, and near miss investigations
  • Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), Site Acceptance Tests (SATs), and critical field inspections for complex installations
  • Advise project teams on construction sequencing, outage planning, and commissioning strategy
  • Participate in client technical, Safety by Design, and constructability review meetings
  • Provide technical oversight for project scopes, feasibility studies, cost estimates, and definition-phase deliverables, including review of assumptions and risks
  • Support Business Development by contributing technical strategy, execution approaches, and risk assessments for proposals and pursuits
  • Act as a primary technical escalation point for clients, internal teams, and external partners
  • Mentor senior and junior engineers, and play a key role in the continuous improvement of P&C standards, tools, and engineering practices

Minimum Qualifications

  • 20+ years of utility-focused protection, control, and metering engineering experience, with demonstrated system-level responsibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university
  • Registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) in Canada, or eligibility to obtain (U.S. PE considered an asset)
  • Recognized expertise in substation protection philosophy, including transmission line, transformer, bus, and feeder protection
  • Extensive experience reviewing and approving detailed P&C design drawings and technical deliverables
  • Experience performing protection coordination studies and relay settings for high-voltage transmission systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of protection software and platforms such as ASPEN, CAPE, EasyPower, SKM, and SEL / GE relay families
  • Practical experience with substation construction, commissioning, outage planning, and operational interfaces
  • Proven ability to provide technical judgment on non standard, complex, or first of kind applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services.   • Operational Reporting and Data Discrepancies

  • Location: Fully remote — no geographic restrictions. Strong English required (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)

  • Next step: Complete the role-specific AI interview — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client

  • Your tasks: Design realistic, multi-step business operations tasks with objective criteria for grading the output

Your domain knowledge is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

The work is to turn real operational workflows into benchmark tasks: realistic, difficult, and gradable against objective criteria. If you’ve written an SOP, built a QA checklist, or trained a team against a standard, that’s the instinct this needs.

Scope of Work:

  • Design multi-step tasks drawn from real operations work — reporting, process design, workflow management — with realistic reference files and clear instructions.

  • Define objective grading criteria so two qualified reviewers would reach the same verdict on the same output.

  • Build tasks that require judgment rather than lookup: ones where the right answer depends on reading the materials correctly.

  • Create or source the supporting materials each task needs: spreadsheets, system exports, process documentation, operational reports.

  • Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable instead of submitting them anyway.

  • Deliver approved tasks on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on responsibility in business operations, operations reporting, process design, or workflow management — direct ownership of the work, not supervisory-only or adjacent exposure.

  • Experience creating or applying structured standards: SOPs, QA checklists, process documentation, service level definitions, or training assessments.

  • Strong Excel capability and comfort reasoning across multiple documents at once.

This is a remote position.

Big Ideas PH is seeking a high-velocity, execution-driven Influencer Outreach Specialistwith dedicated experience in the beauty and skincare space to power creator activation programs for two premier US beauty brands:Patchology (micro-creator high-frequency seeding) and Kate Somerville(tiered authority outreach). Reporting directly to brand marketing leads and managers, this is a daily execution and high-cadence volume role centered on sourcing creators, driving outreach, managing end-to-end sample fulfillment, and converting contacts into organic brand advocacy. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love solving operational puzzles, and take pride in hitting daily conversion targets, this role is for you.

This is a full-time, contractual, freelancer position for a trial period of 3 months while working at home. If you are a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual with experience and qualified based on the criteria below, we encourage you to apply.

Upon successful completion of the evaluation period, the contractor's performance will be reviewed, potentially leading to a contract renewal that may include a benefits package.

JOB DESCRIPTION
​

  • High-Volume Daily Outreach: Execute 50–75 outbound creator or influencer touches per day across TikTok and Instagram using tailored, brand-aligned messaging (no generic mass-DM copy), using an influencer management platform

  • Dual-Engine Program Execution: Sourcing and activating creators against strategic briefs for two distinct brand engines:

    • Patchology (Velocity Engine): High-frequency micro-creator seeding and volume gifting.

    • Kate Somerville(Authority Engine): Tiered outreach targeting beauty creators, wellness influencers and lifestyle trendsetters.

  • Sample Fulfillment Workflow & Tracking: Manage end-to-end sample requests including logging creator addresses, submitting accurate warehouse requests, tracking timestamped shipments, and proactively following up to confirm receipt.

  • Creator Relationship Nurturing & Follow-Ups: Conduct timely post-outreach follow-ups to maintain creator engagement and maximize response-to-posted content conversion rates.

  • Content Auditing & Compliance Tracking:Monitor, log, and verify live creator posts to ensure accurate product tagging, adherence to brand messaging, and compliance with FTC disclosure guidelines.

  • Data Logging & Reporting Discipline:Daily and weekly tracking of outreach volume, response rates, sample shipments, and content output using spreadsheets or ShopMy/CRM tracking tools to roll up actionable performance data to brand leads.

  • CRM & Creator Database Management: Maintain a clean, organized creator directory categorized by creator tiers, skin concerns/niches, platform performance, and engagement metrics.

  • Daily Alignment & Problem Solving: Participate in daily standups or asynchronous check-ins with brand leaders, proactively troubleshooting stalled responses or shipping delays to maintain continuous workflow velocity

​

Requirements

  • EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred.

    • As least 2-3 years prior experience in influencer marketing, social media management, creator recruiting, talent outreach, or affiliate marketing management.

    • What this job is NOT:Not a community manager, not a content creator, not a paid media buyer.

  • TECHNICAL AND OTHER SKILLS (MUST-HAVES)

    • Direct Creator Outreach Experience:Proven experience in hands-on creator outreach on TikTok (including TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace / Affiliate Plan) and Instagram (DM, email, or native outreach tools). Generic social media management is not a substitute.

    • Seeding Platform Fluency:Direct operational familiarity with ShopMyor comparable creator gifting platforms (Superfiliate, GRIN, Aspire).

    • Fulfillment Operations Comfort:Hands-on experience working inside sample fulfillment workflows (address logging, warehouse coordination, and timestamped shipment tracking).

    • Exceptional English Communication:Fluency in written English required to draft personalized, brand-voice outreach messages that build authentic creator connection.

    • Rigorous Reporting Discipline:Consistent track record of daily/weekly data logging, tracker hygiene, and clear performance reporting.

    • High comfort working with spreadsheets(Google Sheets, MS Excel) and CRM-style tracking tools to maintain data accuracy.

    • Self-starter mindset with full comfort working toward daily/weekly outreach targets and performance KPIs.

  • PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • Beauty/CPG Industry Background:Hands-on experience in the beauty, skincare, or consumer packaged goods space.

    • Campaign Structure Knowledge:Ability to differentiate gifting/seeding workflows (low-cost, product-only) from contracted posting waves (negotiated deliverables and paid agreements).

    • FTC Disclosure Familiarity:Understanding of basic FTC compliance requirements for influencer gifting and sponsored content.

    • Experience utilizing AI tools(e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) with strong prompting skills to optimize outreach copy generation and communication efficiency.

    • Prior experience supporting US-based clients or working in a remote agency ecosystem.

  • REQUIREMENTS FOR REMOTE WORK

    • Eligible to legally work as a remote freelancer or contractor based in the Philippines.

    • Natural-born Filipino citizen or Foreigner with a working VISA or permit to legally work in the Philippines.

    • Has own computer or laptop capable of handling the rigorous demands of work.

    • Has a fast and reliable internet connection at home (at least 200-300 MBPS)

    • Has a quiet and distraction free work environment at home.

    • Willing to work in graveyard shifts or changing shift US schedules.

About the Role:

CrowdStrike’s Strategic Advisory Services team assists our customers with a wide array of proactive engagements to help enhance security programs, educate employees, and develop tailored cyber initiatives. The Consultant role is one of the primary contributors to engagement delivery, with a strong focus on task-oriented activities, reporting, and supporting engagement leadership to ensure projects are performed on time and to our highest standards. Consultants will also have the opportunity to contribute to thought leadership, methodology development, and other “back of office” tasks, as a secondary function of the role.

  • Security Program Development: you’ve personally contributed to the development, management, and implementation of a security program, helping organization build, enhance, or recalibrate their plans for a successful future-leaning security program. This may include aspects of developing a SOC, CSIRT, Fusion Center, or several security initiatives that support a centralized security function.
  • Security Analysis / Operations: you’ve held leadership or key delivery positions in organizations or on teams that focus on organizational security (such as SOCs, IR teams, etc.). You understand cybersecurity from a practitioner standpoint, and importantly, you also understand how to consolidate and communicate results to senior leaders.
  • Business Strategy / Risk Analysis: you’ve helped businesses address a range of risks, including cyber risks, across their organization. You’re familiar with how organizational risk frameworks are developed, and you have experience helping organizations improve and apply their risk frameworks to address cyber risks.
  • Cybersecurity Policy: you’ve been responsible for developing new policies or enhancing existing policies that inform how private or government organization performs and manages its various cyber security activities. Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Care Manager – RCT to join our team! Trillium’s Care Manager – RCT plays a vital role in ensuring members receive whole person-centered care to meet their individual and complex physical, mental health, and social needs. The Care Manager serves as the single point of contact for members and works with a multidisciplinary care team, including primary care providers, specialists, care manager extenders, transition staff, and caretakers/legal guardians to promote continuity of care and quality care for each member. The Care Manager – RCT would be expected to work and be available at their remote location between the hours of 8:30 am – 5:00pm and be flexible to travel within the community to meet with members as well as attend other meetings as needed.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned members, providing ongoing care management and advocacy.

A graduate of a college or university with a master’s degree in a human service field and has one year of full-time, pre or post-graduate degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has one year of full-time, pre or postgraduate degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR

A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a human service field and has two years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has two years of full-time, pre or post bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR

jobs.excerpt: As the "quarterback" of each pursuit, the Proposal Specialist leads the end-to-end proposal process for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs and similar solicitations, running color team reviews from assignment through submission, supporting post-submission activities and coordinating all resources across sales, technical, pricing, contracts, legal, program management, partners and vendors into one cohesive response.
jobs.description:
As the "quarterback" of each pursuit, the Proposal Specialist leads the end-to-end proposal process for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs and similar solicitations, running color team reviews from assignment through submission, supporting post-submission activities and coordinating all resources across sales, technical, pricing, contracts, legal, program management, partners and vendors into one cohesive response.

The role calls for both a strong persuasive writer and a disciplined project manager. The Proposal Specialist uses content library/knowledge management platforms and company-approved generative AI tools to produce compliant, compelling, win-focused responses efficiently. The ultimate goal of the role is to increase win rates and drive revenue.


What You Will Do:


Opportunity Assessment & Planning

  • Analyze solicitations for requirements, evaluation criteria, instructions and risks; build compliance matrices and outlines mapping each requirement to an owner.
  • Research the customer's priorities, constraints and hot buttons, the incumbent and the competitive landscape.
  • Provide relevant context and input for sales-led bid/no-bid decisions.

Proposal Leadership & Project Management

  • Build a schedule backward from the due date, define roles and track actions, risks and dependencies.
  • Manage concurrent proposals, hold contributors accountable without direct authority, escalate issues early.

Color Team Review Process

  • Plan, facilitate and adjudicate Kickoff, Pink (first draft), Red (final draft), Gold (page by page compliance); coordinate Green (pricing) reviews owned by sales or technical leads.

Strategy, Win Themes & Writing

  • Work with the opportunity team to develop the win strategy, win themes, discriminators and value propositions.
  • Write, edit and tailor persuasive, accurate, compliant content in one voice, aligned to evaluation criteria.

AI & Content Library

  • Use company-approved generative AI tools to analyze and deepen understanding of solicitations, draft and refine content, summarize requirements and speed up reviews.
  • Verify AI output, protect confidential data, and grow the content library, templates and boilerplate.

Compliance, Production & Submission

  • Ensure compliance with instructions, forms, certifications, formatting and page limits; manage final assembly, quality control and on-time submission, including via portals.

Post-Submission Support

  • Support clarifications, Q&A, orals, BAFOs and protests as needed, in a supporting rather than leading role.
  • Request and conduct debriefs, capture lessons learned, support award transition and close out opportunities.

Department Contribution

  • Join training, department and process-improvement initiatives, industry days and pre-proposal conferences; share best practices with peers.

What We Expect of You:

Minimum Basic requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Two or more years of proposal writing, proposal management, project management, technical/business writing or editorial experience.
  • Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadline-driven projects at the same time.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on compliance.
  • Working proficiency with generative AI tools and a willingness to adopt new technology.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint) and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Sound judgment, composure under pressure and constructive communication with all levels of the organization, including executives.

Preferred skills, experience, and qualities needed

  • Public sector or government procurement knowledge, including contracts, T&Cs and purchasing requirements.
  • General knowledge of IT products, services and solutions.
  • Experience with proposal content/RFP response platforms and structured color team reviews (e.g., Shipley).
  • APMP certification (Foundation or Practitioner) or PMI certification (CAPM or PMP).

Pay range: $71,000 - $100,000 depending on experience and skill set

Annual bonus target of 5% subject to terms and conditions of plan

Benefits overview:

Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyWe build and run a portfolio of software products.
jobs.description:
About the Company

We build and run a portfolio of software products. Our own software creates most of our messaging and keeps it on target and on brand. We are hiring a portfolio content marketer who uses that software every day, edits what it produces, and runs the content and outbound work around it.

The Role

You will own how our products show up in the market. You start with two products. The first is a self-service B2B platform. The second is a B2B product sold only through enterprise contracts. Both are account based, which means we sell to a limited target list of named companies, and every message, email, and page is written with those accounts in mind.
Our software drafts the messaging and content. You decide what is accurate, what sounds right, and what goes out. Great discernment is required: you will catch what a draft gets wrong, sharpen what it gets right, and know the difference quickly. The job rewards someone with strong editorial judgment who learns tools fast and ships.
The role starts part time and becomes full time at day 45.

How the Role Works

For the first 45 days the role is part time. You use our software to write the messaging and content for the first product, review its brand core and marketing vitals, and work with the founder, the product team, and our agency to get it into market. From day 45 the role is full time. You keep creating content for the first product and take the second product to market and scale it.

What You Will Own

  • Reviewing and refining the positioning, messaging, elevator pitch, and tagline our software drafts for each product
  • Keeping every asset on target and on brand
  • Website content, blog posts, and social media content for each product, plus managing and monitoring the social accounts
  • Cold email sequences for each account list, and LinkedIn outreach through the founder’s accounts
  • Ad messaging for the first product, and reviewing results with the agency that runs the campaigns
  • Video content: cutting clips from our community sessions, editing customer testimonials and user-generated content (UGC), and coordinating paid talent for the UGC that needs it, with contractor support when volume requires it
  • Launch plans for new products and new features
  • The target account lists for each product, built and maintained with the founder
  • Sales assets for each product: pitch decks, one-pagers, and answers to the objections buyers raise most often
  • Pricing and packaging messaging
  • Case studies built from early customers
  • Ongoing tracking of competitors in each product’s market
  • A regular feedback loop that carries what customers and prospects tell us back to the founder and the product team

What You Bring

  • 5 or more years of marketing experience, with hands-on work in content, outbound, or growth
  • Experience in both B2B and B2C marketing
  • Strong editorial judgment: you can tell when a draft is accurate, on brand, and worth publishing, and you can fix it when it falls short
  • The ability to write every day at high volume and keep the quality up
  • Comfort working with AI tools and with workflows where a person reviews AI output
  • Hands-on cold email and LinkedIn outreach experience: writing sequences and testing what gets replies
  • Familiarity with Clay or a similar tool, or eagerness to learn it
  • Experience writing blog posts and running social media accounts
  • Video editing experience (preferred), including cutting long recordings into short clips and finishing testimonial and UGC video
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing, or eagerness to learn it
  • Experience helping launch products or features
  • Clear, plain writing, and the ability to match a founder’s voice after reading a few of his posts
  • Availability to work part time for the first 45 days and full time from day 45

Tools You Will Use

  • Our own software for drafting and checking messaging and content
  • Clay or a similar tool for account research and enrichment, used alongside our cold email operator
  • A cold email platform for sending, run by our cold email operator
  • A CRM for tracking accounts and conversations
  • A social media scheduling and monitoring tool
  • Ad platforms such as LinkedIn and Google, run with our agency
  • A video editor for cutting and finishing clips
  • AI tools for drafting and research, with a person reviewing the output

Who You Work With

  • The founder, directly, on positioning, voice, and the target account lists
  • The product team, directly, so you know what is shipping and can bring customer feedback to the people building it
  • Customers, directly, to collect testimonials and feedback on what they need from our products
  • The VP of Operations, on priorities, timelines, and resources
  • Agency specialists and contractors, who the founder and the VP of Operations manage, with your input on what is needed
  • A cold email operator, who runs the sending system and deliverability while you write the sequences and review results

Who Thrives Here

  • You are hungry to build something from the ground up
  • You like owning a result and you move quickly when the goal is clear
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and learn new tools in days, not months
  • You take feedback well and improve fast
  • You want to learn from the founder

Nice to Have

  • Experience at an early-stage company or inside a portfolio of products
  • Experience selling or marketing to enterprise buyers
  • Experience running paid ads on LinkedIn or Google
  • Familiarity with positioning frameworks such as jobs to be done

How We Will Measure Success

  • Week 2: the first product’s brand core and all marketing vitals reviewed and refined, with website and social copy underway
  • Day 45: marketing campaign under way and website built, and the role moves to full time
  • Day 90: 100 accounts on the first product, and 10 customers on the second product

Location and Pay

  • Nashville preferred, with remote candidates considered
  • $40 per hour for the first 45 days, about 20 hours a week, part time
  • $80,000 base salary from day 45, full time, plus bonuses

jobs.description:
🛢️ HAFA est un acteur industriel majeur, spécialisé dans la fabrication et de la distribution de lubrifiants en France et à l’export, et dans une offre de services dédié à l’accompagnement de ses clients sur des problématiques de maintenance et de réduction des consommations.

Nos produits sont à la pointe de la technologie depuis soixante ans, avec une gamme en perpétuelle évolution. Notre entreprise apporte une dimension « services » importante à nos clients, à travers notre équipe support siège et nos techniciens sur le terrain.

Notre clientèle est exclusivement professionnelle : elle est composée essentiellement de TPE / PME et grands comptes dans une diversité de secteurs d’activité : automobile (VL), transports de marchandises et voyageurs (PL), Travaux Publics, Entreprises agricoles, forêt, nautisme, marine, entreprises de mécanique générale… tant en France qu’à l’international.

Notre entreprise est une PME familiale et indépendante, impliquée sur son territoire régional, avec une équipe dirigeante et d’encadrement jeune et renouvelée. Sa dynamique actuelle lui permet de compter avec une croissance régulière depuis 4 ans et d’être reconnu dans des réseaux tels que BPI Excellence ou French FAB.

Notre équipe d'environ 120 personnes (70 sur notre siège) forme un groupe à taille humaine, porté sur le développement et la conduite de nombreux projets d’évolution et d’innovation… qui font de l’expérience HAFA une aventure particulièrement stimulante !

🔎 Nous recherchons un(e) International Business Developer qui animera, développera et renforcera notre présence auprès d'un réseau de distributeurs et d'industriels principalement en Afrique et dans les départements d'outre-mer et territoires d'outre-mer (DOM-TOM).

🎯Missions

DEVELOPPER

  • Piloter et développer la relation commerciale avec le portefeuille des clients existants en s’assurant d’une veille constante des besoins et des opportunités de ceux-ci.

  • Suivre les évolutions (environnementales, technologiques, ou concurrentielles) pouvant impacter le développement commercial de la zone.

  • Ce secteur est susceptible d’évoluer en fonction des besoins du business international

DEFRICHER

  • Participer à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités à travers des études de marché et partager les leads de prospection avec l’équipe

  • Construire les offres commerciales adaptées, conduire la négociation et conclure les contrats / accords commerciaux

  • Contribuer à la préparation des appels d’offres complexes (grands comptes, multi-zones, etc.)

BATIR ET PROMOUVOIR

  • Analyser mensuellement les résultats de son secteur

  • Proposer un plan d’actions marketing pour accroître la notoriété de la marque, en appui avec les équipes marketing et communication

  • Participer aux salons internationaux

  • Participer à l’amélioration des outils de l’équipe export

  • Être force de proposition sur les besoins d’évolutions produits / services et les opportunités d’innovation

  • Contribuer au dynamisme et à la bonne vie de l’équipe, et plus largement être acteur de l’entreprise HAFA

💡Profil

De formation supérieure Bac+5 (Ecole de commerce – Master en commerce international – ou Ingénieur avec une formation commerciale complémentaire), vous justifiez a minima d’une première expérience dans une fonction similaire en vente B2B à l’international, avec une connaissance de l’Afrique.

Plus précisément :

  • Expérience à l’international requise : VIE / Stage /expérience professionnelle, de préférence sur le continent africain

  • Mobilité, disponibilité et goût du voyage : déplacements fréquents (1 fois par mois) en Afrique

  • Sens de l’écoute et bon relationnel client

  • Capacité à vendre et à mener des négociations

  • Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problème

  • Patience et persévérance

  • Esprit d’équipe et engagement

  • Maîtrise exigée de l’anglais dans un contexte professionnel

Vous appréciez le contexte d’un environnement de travail en PME, et êtes motivé(e) par un projet d’entreprise en développement et en transformation, dont vous devez être un acteur.

🚀Que trouver chez HAFA ?

Rejoignez HAFA, pour son charme lub', graisses et huiles ! Une ambiance de travail familiale, agréable et conviviale !

Postulez dès maintenant et rejoignez une équipe passionnée où chaque jour est une opportunité de grandir et de réussir ensemble !

jobs.excerpt: This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline.
jobs.description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. Koniag Advisory Business Solutions, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Medical Records Technician Coder III to support KABS and our government customer. The position is remote. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.

This position is covered under the Service Contract Act. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement. Koniag Advisory Business Solutions (KABS) is seeking an experienced Medical Records Technician – Coder III to support the Indian Health Service (IHS) Haskell Indian Health Center. This is a fully remote position responsible for accurate and timely coding of outpatient and ambulatory patient encounters and supporting the facility's efforts to reduce its existing coding backlog and maintain coding currency. The successful candidate will be an experienced, self-directed coding professional who is comfortable working independently in a remote environment, managing priorities and productivity requirements, and communicating professionally with providers, business office staff, and IHS leadership. Strong judgment, diplomacy, organization, and time-management skills are essential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review clinical documentation and accurately assign diagnostic and procedural codes for outpatient, ambulatory, emergency, observation, day surgery, and other applicable encounters.
  • Abstract coded information into IHS RPMS and the Patient Care Component (PCC).
  • Apply current ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II, E/M, and National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) guidelines.
  • Identify and prioritize Medicare and Medicaid All-Inclusive Rate (AIR) encounters and other claims approaching timely filing deadlines.
  • Review medical records for completeness, accuracy, medical necessity, and compliance with reimbursement and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify documentation discrepancies and communicate professionally with providers and staff to obtain clarification or additional information when needed.
  • Support resolution of incomplete or delinquent records and coding-related system or documentation issues.
  • Assist with coding audits, compliance reviews, reimbursement-denial analysis, and performance improvement activities.
  • Maintain accurate coding statistics, deficiency information, error reports, and other required documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with clinical, Health Information Management, and Business Office staff while independently managing daily workload and priorities.
  • Maintain productivity and quality standards while working remotely with limited day-to-day supervision.

Performance Expectations:

  • Code approximately 1,250 patient encounters per month, or the volume made available for coding.
  • Maintain a coding accuracy rate of at least 95%.
  • Work aged backlog encounters in accordance with IHS-established priorities, including timely filing and AIR requirements.
  • Maintain consistent communication regarding records that cannot be coded, documentation deficiencies, system issues, or other barriers affecting productivity.

Required Qualifications:

  • Current coding credential in good standing, such as CCS, CCS-P, CPC, COC, RHIT, or RHIA.
  • Minimum of three years of production outpatient and ambulatory medical coding experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with the Indian Health Service (IHS), RPMS, and PCC.
  • Working knowledge of IHS Medicare and Medicaid All-Inclusive Rate reimbursement requirements.
  • Current knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II, E/M guidelines, and NCCI requirements.
  • Strong analytical, documentation-review, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively and diplomatically across clinical, administrative, and operational teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, organize competing priorities, meet production expectations, and manage time effectively in a remote environment.
  • Must be dependable, responsive, and comfortable taking initiative to resolve coding and documentation issues.

Additional Information:

  • Must successfully complete the required IHS personnel security and suitability determination before beginning work.
  • Must comply with all applicable IHS privacy, security, confidentiality, and training requirements.
  • Provide highspeed internet access and dedicated work area that can be secured. Documented proof of dedicated work area will be required.
  • Will need to be video ready during all duty hours. Video must be on during all call, meetings and conversations with both the client and KABS personnel.

Work Schedule:

  • Position is fully remote, although initial coordination may be required for government-issued equipment and system access.
  • Core hours are 9:00 am to 3:00pm CT. Will work 5 day, 8 hours per day. Upon Government approval, schedule may be modified to 4 days a week, 10 hours per day.
  • No routine travel is anticipated.

Candidate Documentation and Pre-Employment Submission Requirements: Final candidates will be required to provide documentation and information necessary to support background investigation, credentialing, and access processing, which may include:

  • Government-issued identity documents for identity proofing.
  • Information needed for fingerprinting and background investigation processing.
  • Current address and prior residence history, as requested.
  • Employment history and related verification information, as requested.
  • Professional certification and training documentation, as required.
  • Any other forms or supporting materials required by IHS, HHS, or authorized security officials.

The company shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, creed, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity (except where gender is a bona fide occupational qualification), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, citizenship, military/veteran status, marital status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment.

The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e-mail at or by calling 703-488-9377 to request accommodations.

Overview: 

HealthEdge provides the only modern, enterprise-class software platform for healthcare payers. Using the patented HealthRules software suite, health plans, health insurance companies, and other payers can finally respond to new business opportunities and market changes in hours, not months or years, while drastically reducing both IT and operational costs. Leveraging an investment of over $125 million, HealthRules is the most modern, scalable, and cost-effective technology in the industry. HealthEdge is the only choice for payers to survive and thrive in the emerging healthcare economy.  

Our Software Engineers in Test are embedded alongside developers, using our latest in-house automation framework in Java to create reliable and comprehensive automation tests. Teams rely on flexible but standardized processes to ensure test coverage, feature quality, and regression checks.  

What you will do: 

  • Develop automation in existing tools and frameworks and extend those tools and frameworks as necessary. 
  • Execute both white- and black-box testing. 
  • Create and execute test plans and test cases based on requirements and user stories revolving around complex data scenarios. 
  • Identify current testing gaps, process flaws, suggest and implement improvements to increase product quality. 
  • Contribute to the relevant DevOps work and help improve the CI/CD for the team.    
  • Interact with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and drive projects to on-time, seamless releases.   
  • Participate in product Demos. 

You get excited by: 

  • Understanding, testing and debugging complex, data-drive applications. 
  • Routinely digging into code to help identify the root cause of a defect and helping to design a solution. 

What you bring: 

  • 5+ years of professional experience working in a software development environment. 
  • Ability to write automated test code and tools.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Senior Data Platform Engineer serves as Sola's primary database administrator and data platform engineer within the DevSecOps team. This role owns the production databases that support our analytics, transactional, and caching layers, including Amazon Redshift, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and PostgreSQL, as well as the Cube.js semantic layer, the ingestion pipelines that feed it, and the Terraform managed infrastructure beneath it.

This is a hands-on role with a high degree of autonomy. The successful candidate will design new data architecture, resolve production performance issues, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure as code that support them. Operating within a PCI DSS and SOC 2 regulated payments environment, this engineer partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Security to keep the data platform performant, reliable, secure, and scalable as the business grows.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Warehouse and Analytics Layer

  • Own the performance, availability, and cost of the Amazon Redshift data warehouse, including cluster sizing, workload management (WLM), distribution and sort key design, and routine vacuum and analyze maintenance.

  • Administer and tune Cube.js as the semantic and analytics layer built on Redshift.

Relational Database Administration

  • Administer production relational databases, including MySQL/Aurora MySQL and Microsoft SQL Server, covering backup and recovery, patching, version upgrades, CDC and replication, and high availability and failover configuration.

  • Lead schema design, administration, and standards for PostgreSQL, which supports newer services such as the Developer Portal and Hierarchy Service.

Query and Performance Optimization

  • Profile and tune queries, indexes, and execution plans across relational and NoSQL systems.

  • Implement monitoring and alerting that identifies performance regressions before they become incidents.

Database Architecture and Design

  • Partner with engineering teams early in the project lifecycle to design schemas, select the appropriate data store for each workload, and establish standards for scalability, normalization, and data integrity.

Data Pipeline Engineering

  • Own the warehouse ingestion pipelines, including AWS DMS and CDC replication, Glue jobs, Step Functions orchestration, and EventBridge scheduled loads, and resolve throughput, memory, and data freshness issues end to end.

NoSQL and Caching Platforms

  • Design DynamoDB table structures, partition and sort key strategies, secondary indexes, and capacity modes to balance performance and cost at scale.

  • Administer and tune ElastiCache (Redis and Memcached), including cluster topology, eviction policies, and failover behavior.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain runbooks, backup and disaster recovery procedures, and monitoring for all owned database platforms.

  • Participate in the on call rotation as required.

Collaboration

  • Manage day to day database operations independently while collaborating with Engineering and Security on architecture reviews, capacity planning, and incident response.

Key Performance Indicators:

Success in this role will be measured through a combination of platform reliability, performance, data quality, and operational maturity, including:

  • Production database availability that meets defined uptime targets across Redshift, MySQL, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL.

  • Query performance, measured by p95 latency for key dashboards and Cube.js endpoints, with sustained improvement against baseline.

  • Data freshness, with warehouse loads and CDC replication consistently meeting agreed latency windows and pipeline failures resolved within defined SLAs.

  • Backup and disaster recovery readiness, including successful scheduled restore tests and documented RPO and RTO targets met for all owned platforms.

  • Reduction in database related incidents and repeat issues, with root cause analysis completed for every Sev 1 and Sev 2 event.

  • Data platform cost efficiency, with Redshift, DynamoDB, and ElastiCache spend optimized relative to usage growth.

  • Timely completion of patching and version upgrades, with no platforms running unsupported versions.

  • Audit readiness, with database controls and evidence supporting PCI DSS and SOC 2 requirements delivered without findings.

  • Complete and current runbooks, monitoring, and alerting for all owned platforms.

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of hands-on database administration experience across relational and NoSQL technologies.

  • At least 2 years of production Amazon Redshift experience (required), including workload management, distribution and sort key design, vacuum and analyze operations, and diagnosing complex performance issues.

  • Strong MySQL and Microsoft SQL Server administration skills, including backup and restore, replication and CDC, upgrades, and troubleshooting.

  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, with the ability to lead schema design and administration for new services.

  • Experience in PCI DSS or SOC 2 regulated environments.

  • Demonstrated success diagnosing and resolving query performance issues in high throughput environments.

  • Experience designing database architecture for new applications, in addition to maintaining existing systems.

  • Working knowledge of DynamoDB data modeling and performance tuning.

  • Experience administering ElastiCache (Redis or Memcached) or equivalent caching infrastructure.

  • Solid AWS proficiency across the console and CLI, including IAM, CloudWatch, VPC, RDS, and S3.

  • Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar, and enough familiarity with application code to collaborate effectively with engineers.

  • Experience using AI assisted tools to accelerate query development, troubleshooting, documentation, and scripting.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and deliver projects with minimal oversight.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including documenting architecture decisions and operational procedures.

  • Ability to take part in after-hours incident response coverage, including a weekend and holiday backup rotation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Cube.js or a comparable semantic layer.

  • Infrastructure as code experience, preferably Terraform (CloudFormation or CDK also relevant), including extending existing modules.

  • Experience with data pipeline and ETL tooling such as AWS DMS, Glue, or Step Functions.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and database change management tools such as Flyway or Liquibase.

  • Relevant AWS certifications, such as AWS Certified Database Specialty or Solutions Architect.

Leadership Profile:

The successful candidate will combine deep database expertise with sound engineering judgment and a strong sense of ownership. They will hold meaningful accountability for business critical data platforms, exercise autonomy in architectural decisions, and contribute to a team culture grounded in pragmatic engineering, security, and continuous improvement.

Location:

  • Remote

Salary:

  • $165,000 - $200,000 annually

About Sola

Sola is a leading payments provider offering a full suite of merchant services, including payment processing, gateway solutions, and PayFac capabilities. With strong partnerships across key verticals and a deep integration with ISV platforms, we deliver innovative and scalable solutions that help businesses of all sizes manage their payments efficiently. Headquartered in New York, our company is known for its customer-first approach, cutting-edge technology, and commitment to driving seamless transactions.

Sola provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.   4. Hög höjd
  5. Mycket hög höjd

jobs.description:
Blue Circle Health is a nonprofit organization working to improve how type 1 diabetes (T1D) care is delivered and accessed. Funding from The Leona M. and Harry B. Helmsley Charitable Trust makes it possible to provide our 6-month virtual care, education, and support program to adults with T1D for free. Designed based on need rather than traditional reimbursement rules, our whole-person model is individualized and can include endocrinology care, diabetes education, insurance navigation, peer support, diabetes supportive counseling, help paying for T1D medications and supplies, and connections to community resources. We work alongside existing healthcare providers to fill gaps in care and empower people to manage this 24/7 condition.

We’re building a high-quality, scalable model for better T1D care—and we’re looking for mission-driven professionals who want to help create the healthcare system people with T1D deserve. Our ambition is to reach and support as many people living with T1D across the country as possible, and that urgency shapes how we work: we move quickly, set a high bar, and work hard to turn our mission into meaningful impact at scale.

Blue Circle Health is searching for an experienced MD or DO who will provide virtual patient care, specific to people with type 1 diabetes. Blue Circle Health has a team based, whole person approach to care where we bring together multiple specialties to create a personalized care plan for our patients. The Endocrinologist will conduct telehealth visits and will work with the clinical care team to provide the best care possible to the people we serve. The Endocrinologist will partner closely with the care team - including educators, diabetes supportive counselors, case managers, T1D support guides, and insurance navigators - to guide, educate and empower people living with type 1 diabetes to achieve better health outcomes. Currently we offer 30 minute (follow-up) and 60 minute (new patient) appointments , as we believe spending time with each of our patients is critical. This team includes support from medical assistants and from our technology team.

This role is primarily remote, with potential to attend in-person meetings. All team members also attend our annual in person company retreat. Our patients are currently located in 21 states + Washington D.C., with the intention to expand to additional states throughout the country. We will support the Endocrinologist in obtaining and maintaining licensure upon hire. This role is full-time and requires consistent availability Monday–Friday, with scheduled hours of 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. ET on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday. Thursdays are scheduled either 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. ET (preferred) or 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. ET . Blue Circle has a call schedule during the work-day but does not currently have off-hours call, however as we expand, this may be a future need. Candidates can live anywhere in the U.S.

Core Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and treat our patients with T1D. Conduct medical evaluations, consultations, and provide diabetes-related care using telehealth platforms.
  • Provide guidance and care to our patients living with T1D, using evidence-based therapies and following ADA Standards of Care, with a focus on achieving individual goals and optimizing health outcomes.
  • In partnership with the Care Team, design individualized treatment plans for each patient, monitor their progress and adjust their therapies as needed.
  • Analyze data from all existing diabetes devices and stay up to date on future tech advances in the field
  • Teach patients, and new support staff, how to interpret device downloads and adjust insulin dosing and provide additional patient education to support this.
  • Address urgent patient inquiries, critical updates, and emergency interventions from patients and team members during work hours on a defined call schedule.
  • Provide medical guidance to a team of diabetes care providers including APRNs, RNs, diabetes educators, clinical social workers, behavioral health providers and potentially others as the team grows.
  • Direct supervision via state-specific collaborative care agreements with our current APRN with longstanding experience in the field, with potential to add additional mid-level providers in the future.
  • Partner with the VP of Clinical Care, VP of Clinical Operations, and team Endocrinologist(s) to provide support and guidance to the team responsible for the end-to-end patient care journey, ensuring that all services are delivered in a coordinated, efficient, and effective manner.
  • Help ensure that the clinical team provides compassionate and culturally responsive care and ensure rigor in evidence-based quality and safety.
  • Work with leadership and the administration team to ensure regulatory compliance of the clinical care team with local, state and federal regulations.
  • Use quantifiable evidence of impact to advocate for the improvement or scaling of services.
  • Develop partnerships with referring providers (PCPs, Endocrinologists, etc) and keep an open source of communication and camaraderie to support mutual patient care.
  • Potential to attend in-person meetings with partnering clinics to meet providers and present on our approach to care.
  • Lead by example in supporting a non-traditional healthcare model designed to serve both patients and providers to decrease barriers to care.

Expected Credentials, Experiences and Capabilities

  • An MD or DO who is a board certified/board eligible endocrinologist in the United States.
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain medical licensure in U.S. states where BCH provides care and have no known circumstances that would prevent or materially interfere with obtaining additional state licenses as BCH expands.
  • An approach to care delivery that embraces innovation and patient-centered care.
  • A strong communicator that can earn the respect of people with different backgrounds and expertise.
Preferred skills and experience:
  • Experience providing care in a remote care delivery model.
  • Experience in working with under-resourced communities and diverse populations.
  • Experience using data analytics, population health metrics, and quality improvement processes.
  • Experience in oral speaking and presenting to a range of audiences.
  • Experience contributing to the design or oversight of Quality Improvement initiatives

Total Rewards

Compensation:
Range: $220,000-$280,000/year. This range reflects the good-faith estimate of the compensation we reasonably expect to pay for this position. Individual compensation decisions are based on job-related factors, including skills, experience, and internal equity.

Benefits:
  • Health + dental + vision + short & long term disability coverage.
  • 401(k)
  • PTO & Holidays
  • 100% remote work within the United States with much of the current organization located in the Eastern time zone. Attendance at occasional in-person meetings will be required.
  • Opportunity to shape a healthcare delivery system and contribute to strategy every step of the way.
  • Make an impact in the lives of patients at a non-profit dedicated to improving healthcare.

At Blue Circle Health, we strive for a thoughtful and timely hiring process. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled or closed at any time once sufficient qualified candidates are identified. We're committed to keeping candidates informed as decisions move forward.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally.

We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health -digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world.

  • Builds trusted relationships with business stakeholders and develops a deep understanding of their priorities, decisions and reporting gaps. Translates business needs into use cases, requirements, KPIs and acceptance criteria.

  • This role requires advanced experience in marketing analytics, business intelligence or a comparable analytical business-partnering role. As a Service Desk Engineer (Level 1):
You are self-reliant, methodical, and customer-focused. You troubleshoot calmly, keep users informed, know when to escalate, and take pride in accurate documentation and strong follow-through.

Your Responsibilities as a Service Desk Engineer (Level 1) would be:

Incident & Request Handling

• Log every contact in Zoho Desk with an accurate summary, category, priority, and client reference before work begins.
• Diagnose and resolve first-line incidents wherever possible using remote support tools and the knowledge base.
• Set clear expectations and proactively keep users informed on progress, ownership, and next steps.

Ticket Management & Service Levels
• Own your personal ticket queue and work to agreed response and resolution targets for each client.
• Monitor the shared queue and proactively pick up unassigned tickets.
• Flag tickets at risk of breaching service levels before a breach occurs.
• Maintain accurate ticket status, time entries, and resolution notes, and close tickets only after resolution is confirmed and documented.

Technical Support
• Support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Entra ID, covering account creation, licensing, password and MFA resets, mailbox permissions, and distribution lists.
• Troubleshoot Windows 10/11 and macOS endpoints, including operating system, application, profile, and performance issues.
• Support mobile devices and endpoint management, including enrolment, compliance, and policy issues.
• Perform first-line troubleshooting for wireless connectivity, VPN, printing, DNS/DHCP and local connectivity issues.
• Support common client business applications and coordinate with third-party vendors where required.
• Handle joiner, mover, and leaver requests in line with documented client processes.

Monitoring, Escalation & Handover
• Monitor remote monitoring and management platforms and backup reporting, triaging and acting on alerts as they arise.
• Escalate infrastructure, security, backup, major incident, and out-of-scope issues promptly using documented escalation paths.
• Provide Level 2 or Level 3 engineers with complete handovers that clearly document troubleshooting performed and findings.
• Take the afternoon handover from the Hong Kong day team and produce a clear written end-of-shift handover for open and priority items.
• Complete scheduled end-of-shift checks and record the results.

Documentation, Security & Process
• Create clear, reusable resolution notes and update knowledge base articles for recurring issues.
• Maintain accurate client documentation and report gaps or outdated information.
• Follow PTS service management processes and ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 controls, including client-specific verification procedures.
• Handle client information and credentials in line with information security policy and immediately report suspected security incidents.
• Support audit requirements through complete and retrievable ticket evidence, and suggest improvements to service desk processes, tooling, and automation.

Experience & Background
• At least 1 to 2 years of experience in an IT service desk, help desk, or first-line technical support role; managed service provider or multi-client experience is preferred.
• Experience working to defined service levels within a ticketing system and supporting business users remotely.
• Shift-work or extended-hours support experience is an advantage.
