But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Sr. Reliability Engineer ll (DBA) to join our team!

About the Role

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with a DBA (Database Administration) focus to help ensure the stability, scalability, and reliability of our production database systems - primarily Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra - alongside the rest of our services and infrastructure. This role operates within procedures and runbooks established by our senior DBA SREs, and focuses on building automation, maintaining observability, and supporting incident response to keep customer-facing systems performing at their best.

The SRE will collaborate with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed reliability practices into day-to-day development and operations while contributing to tools and processes that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort

Key Responsibilities

Database Administration

  • Operating and maintaining high-availability database systems — primarily Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra — against established architecture and runbooks.

  • Executing documented backup, recovery, and replication procedures to ensure data durability; escalating architecture-level changes to senior DBA SREs.
  • Ensuring database security compliance and access control.

Service Reliability & Operations

  • Support the availability and durability of critical services across production environments.
  • Monitor service health using SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and escalate issues when thresholds are at risk.

  • Follow established ITIL/OSS processes (incident, change, problem, and capacity management).

Automation & Tooling

jobs.description:
The Health Management Academy (THMA) brings together health system leaders and innovators to collectively address the industry’s biggest challenges and opportunities. By assisting executives in cultivating peer networks, understanding key strategic trends, establishing pragmatic partnerships, and developing next-generation leaders, our members are better positioned to lead industry transformation.

The Health Management Academy offers a dynamic atmosphere with significant opportunities for employees. If you are interested in contributing to a member-centric, creative, and collaborative workforce while deeply influencing top leaders and institutions in healthcare, THMA could be the right place for you!

Position Overview

The Health Management Academy brings together health-system leaders and healthcare innovators to navigate the industry's most important challenges. We help executives build trusted peer relationships, understand strategic trends, form practical partnerships, and develop the next generation of healthcare leaders.

Provelle, part of The Health Management Academy, builds software that helps healthcare leaders make better decisions, strengthen their organizations, and become more effective leaders. We are a small, collaborative team with the opportunity to shape both the products we build and the impact they have across healthcare.

Embley is our AI-enabled leadership-support platform for frontline nurse managers. It helps managers work through difficult situations, practice critical conversations, and build leadership skills in the flow of work - while giving health-system leaders better visibility into where their teams need support.

The Senior Customer Success Manager will own implementation and adoption across Provelle's health-system customers.

This is not a relationship-maintenance role. You will be accountable for getting complex organizations live, helping the product become part of managers' day-to-day work, and demonstrating meaningful value to executive sponsors. You will spend time with customers in the field, solve problems that do not yet have a playbook, and help us build a repeatable customer-success model.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports to start.

Primary Job Duties

  • Health-system implementations end to end. Lead customers from sales handoff through discovery, planning, configuration, training, go-live, stabilization, and sustained adoption.
  • Frontline adoption. Understand how nurse managers actually work, identify the barriers preventing behavior change, and create practical programs that make Embley useful in the moments that matter.
  • Executive relationships. Build credibility with CNEs, CNOs, nursing leaders, learning and development teams, IT partners, and other executive sponsors. Run steering conversations, communicate risk clearly, and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • Customer outcomes. Establish success plans, define measurable outcomes, monitor product engagement and customer health, and connect usage to the priorities that led the customer to choose Embley.
  • Training and launch support. Facilitate executive kickoffs, manager training, onsite launch activities, office hours, and follow-up programs. During major launches, you should expect to be close to the customer and highly hands-on.
  • Escalations and problem-solving. Identify issues early, take ownership when something goes off track, and coordinate across product, engineering, sales, and customer stakeholders to resolve them.
  • The customer-success operating system. Build the implementation plans, handoffs, health indicators, reporting rhythms, adoption programs, and playbooks that will allow us to serve more health systems without losing the quality of the customer experience.
  • The voice of the customer. Bring structured insight back to the product team. Distinguish between one-off requests and recurring customer needs, and help us make better product and operating decisions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • A senior implementation and customer-success operator. You likely have 6-9 years of relevant experience, including 3-5 years personally leading complex healthcare or enterprise technology implementations. We care more about what you have owned than an exact number of years.
  • Experienced with health systems. You have worked directly with hospitals or health systems through healthcare SaaS, implementation services, consulting, clinical transformation, or a similar environment. You understand that decisions involve many stakeholders and that frontline adoption cannot be managed from a project plan alone.
  • Accountable beyond go-live. You do not consider a launch successful because training was completed or a checklist was closed. You stay engaged until customers are using the product, sponsors can see the value, and the implementation is positioned for retention and growth.
  • Credible in the executive room and useful on the hospital floor. You can lead a concise conversation with a senior nursing executive, then work directly with nurse managers to understand why a workflow is not landing.
  • Strong at change management. You know how to diagnose resistance, activate champions, tailor communication to different audiences, and help customers turn a new tool into a sustained way of working.
  • Operationally rigorous. You create clear plans, identify dependencies, maintain decision and risk logs, communicate changes early, and make sure important details do not disappear between teams.
  • Comfortable with data. You can use engagement, adoption, milestone, and customer-health data to identify problems and guide action. You also know when the numbers need to be supplemented with direct customer observation.
  • Technically fluent enough to lead the work. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can discuss integrations, data requirements, authentication, product configuration, and technical constraints with customer IT teams and internal partners.
  • Effective in an early-stage environment. You can operate without a mature process, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and improve the system while continuing to deliver for customers.
  • A clear, direct communicator. You write well, facilitate productive meetings, and can deliver difficult updates without creating unnecessary confusion or drama.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Nursing, clinical, or healthcare-operations background.

Work Environment and Travel

  • Remote, but not distant from customers. This role can be based anywhere in the United States within reasonable access - approximately one hour - to a major commercial airport. Central or Eastern Time is preferred, though we will consider exceptional candidates elsewhere.
  • Customer travel is part of the job. Expect approximately 30-50% travel, with more concentrated periods around implementations and launches.
  • Small team, direct communication. You will work closely with sales, product, engineering, and company leadership
  • High ownership and high trust. We hire people who can understand the goal, determine what needs to happen, and carry the work through to a strong result.
  • Build while delivering. Some of the systems you need will not exist yet. You should be energized by serving the customer today while creating a better, more repeatable approach for tomorrow.
  • Strong point of view, low ego. Bring your judgment, explain your reasoning, listen closely, and change course when the evidence supports it.

The Senior SCADA & Communications Engineer supports the design, integration, and operation of communication and control systems across utility-scale renewable energy assets, including solar PV, battery storage, and hybrid plants. PRIMARY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead integration of site controllers, inverters, and auxiliary equipment into a unified SCADA architecture

  • Manage secure communication interfaces between sites and utilities, transmission operators, ISOs/RTOs, asset owners, and cloud-based platforms
  • Configure and validate protocols for wide-area communications, including real-time telemetry, dispatch and control signals, and event and disturbance reporting
  • Design and implement multi-layer cybersecurity architectures, including segmented network zones, secure data replication layers, and unidirectional gateways (data diodes) for critical assets
  • Support compliance with NERC CIP standards, utility interconnection requirements, and internal cybersecurity frameworks
  • Enable inverter monitoring, diagnostics, and fault detection through integration with cloud-based dashboards

  • Maintain auditable data and communication structures to meet regulatory compliance requirements
  • Other duties as assigned

  • Strong understanding of firewalls and network security fundamentals

  • Extensive hands-on experience with utility-scale SCADA systems, including SCADA servers, RTUs, PLCs, industrial gateways, and edge/data collection devices
  • Strong experience with industrial and utility protocols such as Modbus TCP/IP, DNP3, IEC 61850 (preferred), and OPC UA
  • Strong understanding of OT cybersecurity principles, including defense-in-depth architectures, secure remote access/VPNs, and network segmentation and monitoring
  • Experience implementing secure communication paths between OT and IT systems
  • Comfort working with field data, diagnostics, and system telemetry

OTHER SPECIALIZED SKILLS

  • Background in commissioning or field deployment
  • Experience implementing unidirectional security solutions (data diodes)

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration across engineering, O&M, and IT/security teams
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with NERC CIP and cybersecurity frameworks for critical infrastructure
  • Proficiency in English required; German and/or Spanish language skills are a plus
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a matrix organization
  • Periodic domestic travel required; international travel may be required

WE OFFER

An overview of this role

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own GitLab's Secret Detection offering and the Vulnerability Research function that produces the detection content across security products. Secret Detection is one of the highest-signal, highest-volume security capabilities on the platform. Leaked credentials are the most common initial access vector in real breaches, and as AI agents write, commit, and configure more of the software, the surface area for exposed secrets grows faster than the number of humans watching it.

You will own the full loop: detect a secret with high precision, tell the customer whether it is still live, get it revoked, and prevent the next one from ever landing. In parallel, you will own vulnerability research as a product asset rather than a back-office function. The detection rules, advisory data, and malicious package and reference intelligence your team produces are what make GitLab's security scanners worth paying for, and they need to ship on a cadence with measurable quality.

This is an outcome-owning role - you will carry adoption, retention, and revenue targets for your area and be expected to explain how your roadmap moves them.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Push protection and pre-receive blocking that stops a credential before it reaches a repository, without wrecking developer flow
  • Secret validity checking and automated revocation partnerships with major cloud and SaaS token issuers
  • Detection content pipelines that turn threat research into shipped rules, with precision and recall tracked per rule
  • Intelligence-driven detection of malicious packages, dependencies, and references entering the software supply chain

What you'll do

  • Own the business outcomes for Secret Detection and Vulnerability Research, including adoption, expansion, competitive win rate, and revenue contribution. Bring a point of view on packaging and pricing, not just features.
  • Set the strategy for the full secret lifecycle: prevention, detection, validation, revocation, and reporting across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed.
  • Treat detection content as a product. Define how rules, advisories, and intelligence feeds are sourced, validated, versioned, and measured, and make quality visible to customers.
  • Hold the line on detection quality. False positives are a product defect and you will own the metrics that prove precision is improving.
  • Work at the level of the technology. Read the rule syntax, question the entropy heuristics, understand why a scanner missed something, and challenge engineering with informed alternatives.
  • Use AI to compress the distance between question and answer. Pull your own data, prototype your own flows, synthesize research and competitive input yourself, and bring conclusions rather than requests for someone else to investigate.
  • Build the case for where AI belongs in the product: triage, rule generation, remediation guidance, and reducing the human review burden per finding.
  • Partner with engineering, security research, threat intelligence, Field, and GitLab's own Security team, who are one of your most demanding users.
  • Communicate in writing, asynchronously, with enough precision that a distributed team can act without a meeting.

What you'll bring

  • Domain depth in application security, vulnerability management, or security research. You have worked on or adjacent to scanners, detection content, threat intelligence, or SDLC security tooling and you know how these products actually get evaluated in a bake-off.
  • Technical credibility sufficient to earn the respect of a security engineering team. You do not need to have written the scanner, but you should be able to reason about detection logic, data pipelines, CI integration, and the tradeoffs between coverage and noise.
  • Commercial reasoning. You start from revenue mechanics, buyer motion, and competitive displacement, then work inward to product decisions. Candidates who reason only from feature lists outward are not a fit.
  • Evidence of using AI as a force multiplier in your own work: research, analysis, data pulls, prototyping, drafting. Consuming a chat assistant occasionally is not the same as restructuring how you work.
  • Judgment under ambiguity. You bring structured options and a recommendation instead of escalating an open question.
  • Bias for clarity. You can take a noisy, technical, politically contested problem and produce one page that everyone can align on.
  • Bonus: hands-on background as a developer, security engineer, red teamer, or researcher; experience with credential and token ecosystems; experience commercializing a data or intelligence asset.

This role sits in GitLab's Security product management organization, which owns application security testing, vulnerability management, supply chain security, secrets management, and AI governance. For more information, please visit . Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Vice President, Corporate Communications

Position Overview

The Vice President, Corporate Communications is senior leadership role at Mineralys and is responsible for developing and executing Mineralys' comprehensive corporate communications strategy.

Mineralys is moving from a clinical-stage to a commercial-stage company. Commercial launch is a defining near-term milestone, but the mandate extends well beyond it: establishing a durable corporate narrative, building the internal communications infrastructure a growing organization requires, and positioning Mineralys with media, healthcare stakeholders, employees, and the financial community over the long term.

The role partners closely with the Executive Team, functional leaders, and Investor Relations to align communication strategy with corporate objectives. The individual will serves as a strategic advisor across the organization on how Mineralys communicates internally and externally.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Communications Strategy

  • Own the enterprise communications strategy, spanning external and internal audiences, and align it to corporate objectives and launch readiness milestones.
  • Define the Mineralys corporate narrative and core messaging platform, and ensure it is applied consistently across every audience and channel.
  • Establish the communications operating model, including planning calendars, message review and approval pathways, spokesperson protocols, and escalation and crisis procedures.
  • Set measures of effectiveness for communications and report on outcomes to the Executive Team.

Corporate Communications and Public Relations

  • Oversee the creation of all external communications, including press releases, media statements and corporate messaging campaigns.
  • Build and manage relationships with key healthcare, trade, and financial media; serve as a company spokesperson and prepare and coach executives for media interactions.
  • Lead communications for all significant corporate milestones, including clinical data readouts, regulatory submissions and approvals, launch announcements, business development activity, and commercial progress.
  • Lead issues management and crisis communications, including preparedness planning, rapid response, and executive counsel under pressure.

Brand, Digital, and Corporate Identity

  • Own the corporate brand: identity, visual standards, voice, and tone, and ensure disciplined application across all internal and external materials.
  • Partner with Commercial team to ensure the corporate brand and product brand reinforce one another while remaining appropriately distinct.
  • Own the company's digital presence, including the corporate website, social media channels, and other digital platforms, along with the governance that supports them.

Internal Communications and Employee Engagement

  • Build the internal communications function, including channels, cadence, and standards, for an organization that is growing quickly and operating across headquarters, field, and remote employees.
  • Partner with the Executive Team on leadership communications, all-hands meetings, organizational announcements, and change communications.
  • Partner with HR on culture, employee engagement, onboarding, and manager communications capability.
  • Ensure employees understand company strategy, priorities, and progress, and that internal and external messaging are consistent.

Commercial Launch and Beyond

  • Partner with Commercial, Medical Affairs, and Market Access to develop and execute communications that support product launch, including healthcare professional outreach, disease education, patient communications, and advocacy engagement.
  • Build the post-launch communications plan that sustains awareness, reputation, and stakeholder engagement as the company moves into ongoing commercial operations.

Investor Relations Support

  • Partner with Investor Relations and Finance to ensure consistency between corporate messaging and financial communications, including earnings materials, investor presentations, and conference participation.
  • Contribute to investor relations activities as needed.

Building and Leading the Function

  • Operate as a hands-on leader initially, personally producing high-quality work while establishing the function.
  • Define the structure, roles, sequencing, and budget for the communications team, and hire and develop that team as the company scales.
  • Select and manage external agencies and vendors, and hold them accountable to clear scope, quality, and cost expectations.
  • Serve as a senior advisor to the Executive Team and participate in key organizational decision-making.
  • Ensure all communications activities comply with SEC regulations, FDA guidelines, and other applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

Required

  • 15+ years of progressive corporate communications experience, with substantial experience in the biotech or pharmaceutical sector.
  • Demonstrated track record of building a communications function, ideally as the first or sole senior communications leader in an organization.
  • Experience leading communications at a publicly traded company, ideally spanning development-stage through commercial-stage milestones.
  • Experience across the full product lifecycle, including clinical data disclosure, regulatory milestones, and product launch.
  • Familiarity with the biotech investor and healthcare media landscape.
  • Demonstrated internal communications and change communications capability in a fast-growing organization.
  • Proven issues and crisis management experience, including advising executives in high-stakes situations.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; a strategic storyteller who can translate complex scientific and financial information into clear, compelling narratives.
  • A player-coach who is comfortable operating without infrastructure and building it while delivering.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; track record of working closely with Finance, Legal, Clinical, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, and Commercial teams.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting a first commercial launch.
  • Experience building and evolving internal communications channels and governance as an organization scales.

Travel:

At ecoATM the proof of our success is in our staggering growth, extraordinary impact on protecting the planet, and providing a work culture unlike any other. Through our 7,000 automated kiosks and online marketplace Gazelle.com, we enable people all over the world to join the mobile device re-use revolution, a revolution that will get billions of used smartphones out of the e-waste cycle and into the hands of people who don’t have affordable access to the empowerment of the latest mobile technology.

At ecoATM we know our employees are our greatest strength and the key to our continued growth and success. Our Values and Leadership Behaviors

The Business Development Director will be ecoATM's front line for growth — hunting, negotiating, and closing new retail partnerships that put our kiosks in the hands (and stores) of the nation's biggest retailers. From first outreach to signed contract to a kiosk live on the floor, you own the entire deal. This is a quota-carrying, full-cycle sales role for someone who thrives on the close.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Corporate Development, you'll run a sharp, disciplined sales process — prospecting, discovery, ROI-driven proposals, negotiation, contracting, and handoff — while partnering closely with Legal, Marketing, Analytics, Account Management, and Sales Ops to turn commitments into results. About us:

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that’s gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested over $2 billion in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than 100 countries and over 5 million borrowers

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva’s team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

Kiva's values:

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.

Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.

Role overview:

Kiva has been around for 20 years, and we are in an exciting period of building for growth, combining technology solutions with tried and true nonprofit tactics to reach the populations we serve.

Kiva is looking for a strategic and collaborative Principal Product Manager to help us reach our growth goals. Product managers at Kiva take extreme ownership and roll up their sleeves to step in where help is needed. We understand our users and prioritize impact first. In this role, you will report to the Head of Product. You will identify and evaluate new product opportunities across our B2C and B2B audiences, starting with the high-net-worth individual audience. You will decide what gets built and why, define what success looks like, and stay accountable for results. We are product builders and stay involved from crafting the strategic vision to speaking with users, creating prototypes, defining requirements, evaluating tradeoffs, and measuring results. You’ll work with engineers, designers, marketing, and strategic partnerships, ensuring the team is aligned to execute a shared vision.

At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately, we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Define and drive the vision for your product area, breaking it into a productive action plan that prioritizes impact, results, and speed of learnings
  • Emphasize problem discovery and prioritization- know what the most important thing to solve is before diving into solutions
  • Leverage internal and market signals to identify which longer-term bets or new product ideas are likely to succeed. Use frameworks and structured thinking to make decisions, even with incomplete information or ambiguity, where the problem or solution is not clear.
  • Lead outcome definition for your product and projects. Define KPIs and success metrics.
  • Know your customer, be able to run your own qualitative and quantitative research.
  • Build relationships inside and outside the product team to anticipate stakeholder needs, and align leadership and cross-functional partners around your product vision
  • Partner with engineering to build and execute solutions at quality commensurate to the risk, help shape GTM for significant releases
  • Communicate roadmap, vision, results, and tradeoffs across the organization
  • Learn and fail fast - know when to iterate, scale, or stop. Help others do the same
  • Be able to communicate ideas and prototype with AI to validate ideas or experiment

Preferred qualifications:

  • 8-10 years of experience in product management roles, ideally B2C or marketplace, where you have managed a significant product area
  • Track record of shipping successful products
  • User-centered mindset; empathy for users and instinct for good UX.
  • Strong business acumen and a habit of using data to support decisions
  • Self-starter and leader. You anticipate second- and third-order effects and decision tradeoffs, and reframe ambiguous or cross-functional problems in ways that reveal better opportunities and align stakeholders around the right problem.
  • Nice to have: nonprofit, impact-focused, or philanthropy experience

What we offer:

  • A work-from-home position; final candidate must be authorized to work in the U.S.
  • An opportunity to improve real lives, solve hard problems, and change the world
  • Friendly, supportive, and adventurous environment with a team of engaged colleagues
  • A comprehensive, industry-leading benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, professional development, 401k matching, and unlimited PTO. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by Kiva.
  • Opportunities to connect with and learn from colleagues and partners around the world
  • Salary range: $162K - $178K; a final offer will be dependent upon a candidate’s location, skills, and experience.
  • Currently, we are notopen to working with home employees residing in the following states: AL, AK, AR, CT, ID, IN, HI, IN, KY, MS, MO, NE, NM, ND, OK, RI, SD, TN, WV, WI, and WY

A diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is an integral part of Kiva's culture. We actively welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a great place to work. Join us and help us achieve our mission!

We will only accept applications directly from candidates. Kiva will not be responsible for any recruiting agency fees, absent a formal agreement.

jobs.description:
This is a dual-mandate sales role with real commercial ownership — and the person who thrives here will be as comfortable hunting new logo opportunities in the long-tail market as they are driving expansion across an existing account portfolio. As Inside Sales Manager for APAC, you'll own the full sales cycle for Duetto's Silver accounts and long-tail prospects across the region, ensuring systematic coverage of accounts that field reps can't dedicate enough time to — and closing the deals that add up to meaningful ARR. If you're a target-driven, hunter-mentality sales professional with a feel for hospitality technology, this is your opportunity to own a segment and make it perform.

What Makes Us Different?

Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue & Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.

What You'll Be Doing

  • You'll own the expansion pipeline across assigned Silver accounts — driving adoption of Advance, GameTime, and HotStats through structured outreach, upsell conversations, and cross-sell campaigns in close coordination with the BDR and CSM teams.
  • You'll identify and close new logo opportunities in the long-tail market segment (properties under 150 rooms) — managing the full sales cycle from qualification through proposal to close, with independent pricing authority up to the market threshold.
  • You'll coordinate structured outreach campaigns across calls, email, and social with the BDR team, and work with Marketing on timely follow-up of inbound leads to maximise conversion from interest to opportunity.
  • You'll partner with field Sales to align territory and account strategy — ensuring clean coverage, avoiding overlap, and freeing Directors of Sales to focus on larger strategic opportunities while you own the long-tail and Silver segment.
  • You'll maintain accurate opportunity data and forecasting in Salesforce, keeping full pipeline visibility across the team and leadership at all times.
  • You'll use AI tools to accelerate prospect profiling, analysis, and outreach — applying your relationship-building instincts and deal judgment where AI can't, and staying sharp on the human edge that closes deals in a consultative hospitality tech sale.

What We're Looking For

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 2–3 years of experience in SaaS inside sales or business development
  • A hunter mentality — you're driven by hitting targets, energised by pipeline building, and comfortable owning a full sales cycle independently
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills — you're comfortable engaging hotel owners, GMs, and Revenue Managers at all levels
  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM and sales engagement platforms
  • The right to work in Singapore or Thailand

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Familiarity with the APAC hospitality market — hotel ownership structures, buying dynamics, and key segments across the region
  • Experience coordinating with BDR, CSM, and Marketing teams in a cross-functional inside sales motion

Why Duetto?

  • A segment that's ready. Long-tail and Silver accounts are underserved by field reps — there's real pipeline to build and real deals to close for the right person who shows up with energy and discipline.

  • A product worth selling. The #1 RMS in hospitality tech, trusted globally — when you call a Revenue Manager or GM, you're leading with a platform they've heard of and a category that matters to their business.

The Details

You don't need to have sold Duetto before. If you have inside sales experience in SaaS or hospitality tech, a genuine hunter mentality, and the drive to own a segment in one of the most exciting hospitality markets in the world — we'd love to hear from you.

project management skills, and hands-on fluency with AI tools and emerging workplace technologies.

apply them with confidence in real workplace contexts. Because AI is increasingly embedded across GA
programs and client needs, you should understand how modern AI tools are actually used in the
workplace and be able to translate that fluency into applied activities, labs, simulations, facilitator guides,
assessments, and client-specific adaptations.

While this role will contribute significantly to GA’s AI-enabled and emerging technology portfolio, it is
not a purely AI curriculum role. The core responsibility is to create scalable, high-quality GA programs
that meet learner needs, client goals, market expectations, and GA’s instructional standards.

learning designers, assessment specialists, vendors, and client-facing teams to create learning experiences
that reflect current market needs, emerging capabilities, and practical workplace application.

Program Ownership & Discovery

technology, digital transformation, technical skills, leadership, role-based application, or

workplace productivity components.

    workflow improvement, productivity gains, behavior change, and responsible technology use.

Applied Learning Design & AI-Enabled Development

expertise, including programs where AI tools, workflows, or emerging technologies are central to

the learner outcome.

    assessments, facilitator guides, learner workbooks, and practical workplace exercises.
    ● Build learning experiences that help learners actively apply new skills in realistic workplace

    other LEDs or instructional designers, assessment specialists, instructors, vendors, contractors,

and freelancers.

Delivery & Instructor Enablement

facilitator guides, run-of-show documents, learner workbooks, real-world case studies, tool setup
instructions, troubleshooting guidance, and activity facilitation notes.

tool demonstrations, coaching, discussion facilitation, learner support, applied exercises, and

technology-supported problem solving.

Qualifications:

world of work.

Nice to Have:

    ● Experience designing AI training labs, coding exercises, model-building workshops, or real-world

    ● Experience designing enterprise AI adoption programs, leadership AI programs, role-based AI

    ● Experience creating learning experiences for tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft
    Copilot, Perplexity, NotebookLM, Midjourney, or similar platforms.

The anticipated annualized salary range for this position in the US market is $75,000 and $80,000. Salary will be determined based on experience, education, geographic location, and other factors. Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About the InfoSec & IT Team

The Application Security team helps Affirm build and launch products that earn customer trust, meet compliance obligations, and reduce business risk. We partner closely with product, engineering, infrastructure, risk, compliance, and other teams to identify security risks early, recommend pragmatic mitigations, and help teams find safe paths to launch.

We are looking for an early-career Application Security Engineer who is curious, collaborative, and comfortable working with code. You will help assess application risks, support vulnerability management efforts, partner with engineering teams on secure design decisions, and contribute lightweight tooling, automation, and code-informed analysis that helps AppSec scale across Affirm.

This role is a great fit for someone who has hands-on software or security experience, enjoys reading and reasoning about code, is actively developing offensive security skills, and wants to apply those skills in a product-minded, risk-based way.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with product and engineering teams to identify application security risks and help frame them as clear business risks, launch options, and recommended next steps.

  • Read application code, configuration, pull requests, logs, and documentation to understand how systems work and where security risks may exist.

  • Contribute small code changes, scripts, detections, tests, secure defaults, or automation that improve AppSec workflows and reduce recurring issues.

  • Work in GitHub to review code changes, understand engineering context, participate in pull request discussions, track remediation work, and collaborate with engineers.

  • Help evaluate vulnerabilities from internal testing, bug bounty reports, security tooling, penetration tests, and other sources; partner with teams to prioritize and remediate issues based on real-world risk.

  • Contribute to vulnerability management workflows, including triage, validation, severity assessment, remediation guidance, tracking, and reporting.

  • Translate recurring security findings into repeatable mechanisms such as secure coding guidance, checklists, paved paths, lightweight automation, detection logic, reusable review patterns, or developer-facing documentation.

  • Work with engineers to understand system designs, data flows, trust boundaries, authentication and authorization models, code paths, and potential abuse cases.

  • Communicate security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including the risk, tradeoffs, recommended mitigations, and residual risk.

  • Build strong relationships across Affirm teams and influence security outcomes without relying on formal authority.

  • Help connect AppSec work to customer trust, regulatory/compliance expectations, operational resilience, and business outcomes.

  • Continue developing hands-on offensive, defensive, and software engineering skills through practical work, labs, tooling, research, certifications, or contributions to internal security programs.

What We Look For

  • 0–2+ years of experience in application security, software engineering, security engineering, vulnerability management, penetration testing, security operations, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Foundational programming ability in one or more languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Kotlin, or similar.

  • Comfort reading, navigating, and reasoning about code, even in unfamiliar codebases.

  • Experience using Git and GitHub or similar version-control workflows, including branches, commits, pull requests, code review, issues, or project tracking.

  • Some hands-on experience building, testing, breaking, or securing software. This could include professional experience, internships, security labs, CTFs, bug bounty work, open-source contributions, personal projects, automation scripts, internal tools, or coursework.

  • Ability to write clear, maintainable scripts or small programs to solve practical problems, automate manual workflows, analyze data, validate findings, or improve security processes.

  • Foundational understanding of common web, API, mobile, cloud, and application security risks, such as OWASP Top 10 issues, authentication and authorization flaws, injection, insecure design, secrets exposure, dependency risks, and data protection concerns.

  • Interest in offensive security, such as studying for or completing security certifications, practicing web/API testing, learning exploit development fundamentals, using tools like Burp Suite, or participating in labs and capture-the-flag environments.

  • Exposure to vulnerability management concepts, including triage, severity assessment, remediation tracking, false-positive analysis, compensating controls, and risk-based prioritization.

  • Ability to reason about risk and tradeoffs, not just identify issues. You can explain what could go wrong, how likely it is, what impact it may have, and what options exist to reduce risk.

  • Strong product and engineering empathy. You seek to understand launch goals, technical constraints, user impact, and business priorities before recommending a path forward.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain security findings in practical, actionable terms.

  • A collaborative mindset and comfort working across product, engineering, compliance, risk, infrastructure, and security teams.

  • Curiosity, humility, and a growth mindset. You proactively seek feedback, ask good questions, and continue building your technical depth.

  • Secure-by-design judgment, including the ability to spot patterns, recommend simple controls, and balance launch velocity with meaningful risk reduction.

Base Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: CAD $133,000 - $183,000

Location - Remote CanadaThis remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
  • ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum qualifications:

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in technical customer-facing roles (e.g., Technical Account Manager, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, Customer Success Engineer).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of cloud services, architectures, and security best practices, with CSP-level certifications (e.g., Certified Solutions Architect, Certified DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and their associated security considerations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience building and maintaining relationships with enterprise clients, driving customer success, and exceeding performance targets.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues and driving resolution.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of an organisation.

About the Job:

As a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM), you'll be responsible for planning and executing strategies to drive customer adoption and use of the Wiz platform. You will provide both strategic and hands-on technical guidance to customers throughout the Wiz journey, from onboarding to operationalisation.

Serving as the bridge between customers and the broader Wiz team, you'll streamline collaboration between Product Management, Sales, Engineering and Support for a cohesive customer experience.

Join Wiz as a Senior TAM to contribute to customer success and to be a part of an innovative and collaborative company that values excellence and growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide customers with expert guidance on deployment, operational best practices, and assist in establishing a Wiz Center of Excellence.
  • Serve as the primary Wiz liaison for technical questions or escalations, collaborating with Support, Product Management, and other relevant teams.
  • Develop trusted advisor relationships and establish a regular cadence with customer stakeholders from practitioners to C-level, with a focus on increasing adoption, ensuring retention, and fostering satisfaction.
  • Help customers develop Success Plans, outlining critical goals and key performance indicators, and provide guidance in achieving these objectives.
  • Measure customers’ achievement of these key performance indicators and report those both internally and externally.
  • Advocate for customer needs across various departments (product management, support, etc.) and offer insights regarding the availability of new features in Wiz.
  • Assist in identifying opportunities for expanding Wiz usage across the customer’s organisation.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need forvisa sponsorship.This role does not offervisasponsorship.

Wiz is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wiz will process your personal data in accordance with Wiz's Privacy Policy.

Vision

We will be the definitive home for next-generation superfans of music & culture. A leader in social first brand-building, obsession drives perfection in tailoring content to audience passion points transforming followers into fiercely loyal community members.

Low Battery is the home for next-gen superfans of pop culture. With over 52M fans across 9 social-first brands in music, fashion, gaming and internet news—we're where the next-generation comes for entertainment and culturally relevant content.
RapTV | What’s Next in Hip Hop & Culture | @rap

Low Battery is looking to add an experienced campaign manager in the music industry to the Music Partnerships team to directly manage campaigns for the biggest Music Labels and Agencies in the world across Hip Hop, Pop, Latin, and Country.
From the biggest artists in the industry to up and coming independent artists, this person will have the opportunity to play a significant role in artist’s campaigns from start to finish. Responsibilities

  • Generate and deliver comprehensive performance reports for live posts, offering clients valuable insights into campaign analytics.
  • Maintain organized tracking for clients using strategic spreadsheets to monitor post history and live links.

What We're Looking For (Must Haves)

  • 1-3 years experience in Account or Campaign Management. At least 1 year of experience in the music industry at a Label or Agency.
  • Music is 24/7. Ability, excitement and willingness to work in the always-on, fast-paced nature of Music including being available 7 days per week. News breaks on nights, weekends, and holidays. Working shifts during these times is part of the game and required.
  • Passionate about music & culture, specifically Hip Hop.
  • Expert in Social Media platforms with an emphasis on Instagram and TikTok.
  • Project Management. Excellent attention to detail and proven ability managing client projects & campaigns end to end. Intermediate to advanced skills with a project management software.
  • Excellent Client Communication (Written & Verbal).
  • Creative Chops. We’re looking for someone who does more than simply execute a campaign. Ability to to engage with clients as an expert on what assets, narratives, copy, etc. will perform best on social.
  • Problem Solver. Ability to work in fast paced environment. Maintain composure when a client doesn’t agree / understand a stance.

What We're Looking For (Nice to Haves)

jobs.title: Physics Tutor
jobs.excerpt: SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Tutor - Physics Specialist at SpaceXAI, you will be instrumental in enhancing our cutting-edge AI technologies by providing high-quality input and labels using specialized software. You will collaborate closely with our technical team to support the training of new AI tasks, contributing to innovative initiatives. Your responsibilities include refining annotation tools and selecting complex problems from advanced physics fields to drive significant improvements in model performance. This involves gathering or providing data in text, voice, and video formats, including annotations, audio recordings, or video sessions—tasks with which you must be comfortable and eager to engage.

This position demands a dynamic approach to learning and adapting in a fast-paced environment, where your ability to interpret and execute tasks based on evolving instructions is crucial.

The AI Tutor - Physics Specialist role is a remote position. We prefer candidates available for full-time employment, but exceptional applicants seeking part-time opportunities will also be considered (please see the bottom of this job description for more details).

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Use proprietary software applications to provide input/labels on defined projects.
  • Support and ensure the delivery of high-quality curated data.
  • Play a pivotal role in supporting and contributing to the training of new tasks, working closely with the technical staff to ensure the successful development and implementation of cutting-edge initiatives/technologies.
  • Interact with the technical staff to help improve the design of efficient annotation tools.
  • Solve problems that help drive innovation in physics by guiding AI models to enhance research in specialized areas, improving outcomes in scientific discovery and application.
  • Choose problems from various fields across physics that align with your specialization, where you can confidently provide detailed solutions and evaluate model responses.
  • Regularly interpret, analyze, and execute tasks based on given instructions.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master’s or PhD in physics or a highly related field.
  • Expertise in one or more subdomains of physics, including but not limited to: condensed matter physics, high energy physics, nuclear physics, atomic/molecular/optical physics, quantum computing and information, computational physics, mathematical physics, and interdisciplinary physics (such as biophysics).
  • Proficiency in reading and writing, both in informal and professional English.
  • Strong ability to navigate various information resources, databases, and online resources is essential.
  • Outstanding communication, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational capabilities.
  • Solid reading comprehension skills combined with the capacity to exercise autonomous judgment even when presented with limited data/material.
  • Strong passion for and commitment to technological advancements and innovation.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Advanced expertise in physics, demonstrated by multiple publications, preferably with one or more first-author papers, in reputable peer-reviewed journals
  • Previous AI Tutoring experience.
  • Teaching experience (as a professor, teacher, or tutor).
  • Experience in technical writing, journalism, or a professional writing setting.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

  • Tutor roles may be offered as full-time, part-time, or contractor positions, depending on role needs and candidate fit.
  • For contractor positions, hours will vary widely based on project scope and contractor availability, with no fixed commitments required. On average most projects may involve at least 10 hours per week to achieve deliverables effectively though this is not a fixed commitment and depends on the scope of work. Contractors have full flexibility to set their own hours and determine the exact amount of time needed to complete deliverables.
  • Tutor roles may be performed remotely from any location worldwide, subject to legal eligibility, time-zone compatibility, and role specific needs.
  • For US based candidates, please note we are unable to hire in the states of Wyoming and Illinois at this time.
  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.
  • For those who will be working from a personal device, your computer must be a Chromebook, Mac with MacOS 11.0 or later, or Windows 10 or later.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US based candidates: $45/hour - $75/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible U.S. based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm

Hello! We are GoFasti, a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe.

We need an English-fluent Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, based in Latin America, available to work remotely.

We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills.

Are you the one we are looking for?

Responsibilities:

  • A TypeScript monorepo: a Next.js 16 web app and API, an Expo mobile app, and a Cloudflare Worker.

  • A PostgreSQL + Prisma data model with dozens of models and a long migration history, shared across apps.

  • Background systems: webhook handlers (Plaid, Stripe, Linq), queued inbound-message batching, and scheduled jobs.

  • Security-sensitive paths: encrypted bank tokens and chat content, per-user data scoping, auth across web and mobile.

  • The AI layer: LLM tool-calling over users' financial data, long-term memory, and proactive insights.

  • Reviewing AI-generated code, including your own, with a skeptical eye.

Requirements:

  • 6+ years as a software engineer, 3+ years shipping production TypeScript/Node backends.

  • Shipped work at a company that moved money or handled bank or card data (Plaid, Stripe Treasury, Unit, Synapse-era BaaS, card issuing, lending, payroll).

  • Deep PostgreSQL: migrations safe to run on live data, indexes, transactions, query plans.

  • Real experience with async systems: idempotency, retries, deduplicating webhooks, jobs that fail halfway.

  • A security-first instinct around PII, encryption at rest, auth tokens and least privilege.

  • Solo ownership of production at least once: on-call, reading error tracking, writing root-cause analyses.

  • Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar), and clear views on where they go wrong.

  • Written English good enough that a PR description or incident write-up needs no follow-up questions.

It's a plus:

  • Plaid in production: webhooks, item re-authentication, transaction sync cursors.

  • LLMs in production: tool-calling, prompt evaluation, cost and latency control.

  • Next.js App Router and React Server Components.

  • SMS or messaging compliance (opt-outs, TCPA), or Stripe subscription billing.

  • Expo / React Native.

Compensation:

  • The salary range offered for this position varies from (USD) $3,000 - $3,200 per month, depending on seniority and skillset.

  • This position is for a full time contract, through a payroll platform.

  • The talent will work remotely allocated at our client.

Application review/approval > Screening interview with GoFasti's team > We build and send your profile to our client > Profile review/approval by client > Interview with the client > Hiring and onboarding.

If you were contacted directly by a member of our team and are interested in this opportunity, please do not apply through this link. Instead, reach out to the person who contacted you to coordinate a meeting.

In this role, you will apply your expertise in mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field to help build and refine the algorithmic systems that power how Instacart's advertising marketplace operates. You'll work alongside a talented team of scientists and engineers, contributing to production systems that have real, measurable impact on a scaled ads platform. If you're excited by the intersection of rigorous quantitative thinking and large-scale engineering, this is the role for you.

About the Job

  • Develop and evaluate models and algorithms for ads bidding, pacing, and budgeting, applying your training in mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline to solve complex marketplace problems at scale.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain assumptions, methodologies, results, and limitations to both technical and cross-functional audiences.

Brief Overview

We're looking for a practical, business-minded attorney to join Amwell's Legal team as Senior Legal Counsel. The heart of this role is federal commercial contracting and compliance—you'll be our go-to person for prime contracts, subcontracts, flow-down requirements, and the program compliance obligations that come with doing business with the government.

From that foundation, you'll also get plenty of variety: supporting clinical contracting and lending a hand on employment, privacy, regulatory, and litigation matters as they come up. If you enjoy being close to the business, like the mix of deep specialty work and broad generalist support, and get satisfaction from being the person teams turn to for a clear, sensible answer, you'll feel right at home here.

Core Responsibilities

• Support employment matters. Work alongside HR and the Head of Legal on employment and separation agreements, workplace policies, and the everyday employment questions that come up at a growing company.

• Lend a hand on disputes and litigation. Help manage litigation holds, gather relevant information, coordinate with internal teams, outside parties, and outside counsel, support discovery and subpoenas, and weigh in on legal risk and settlement strategy.

• Collaborate across the company. Partner with cross-functional teams to land approvals on non-standard terms, take part in deal desk review, and make sure our commitments are accurately captured and realistic to deliver.

• Make us better as you go. Contribute to our contract templates, playbooks, processes, compliance controls, and self-service tools so the whole team works smarter over time.

• Get to know our world. Build a solid understanding of Amwell's healthcare technology platform, product roadmap, and provider services model so your advice is grounded in how the business actually works.

• Fifteen more years of relevant legal experience, including meaningful commercial contracting work. In-house experience at a technology, healthcare, digital health, or SaaS company is a plus.

• Strong experience with federal, state, or local government contracting—procurement requirements, flow-down clauses, subcontracting, compliance obligations, public-sector RFPs, and regulated program support. This is central to the role, so it's a strong preference.

• Experience drafting and negotiating a range of agreements (technology, SaaS, software licensing, healthcare provider services, business associate, data protection, and professional services).

• Sound, practical judgment: the ability to spot what really matters, explain it clearly to non-lawyers, and offer a sensible path forward.

• Comfort with ambiguity—you can assess legal and operational risk, make a recommendation, and keep things moving without perfect information.

• Strong organizational instincts and attention to detail, with a knack for tracking complex contract, compliance, and stakeholder requirements.

• Clear, friendly written and verbal communication.

As the #1 doctor-recommended weight-loss program, WW provides a trusted, science-backed foundation for care.   • Integrated care: Access to a comprehensive suite of digital and clinical tools to support member success.
  • Join a mission-driven organization redefining modern weight management and nutrition care.

We are looking for experienced, independent registered dietitians to provide compassionate, member-centered Medical Nutrition Therapy via telehealth. In this role, you will be expected to:

  • Practice evidence-based, member-centered care free of bias.
  • Review intake information and medical history during video visits, guiding members with personalized, evidence-based recommendations
  • Build ongoing relationships through regular MNT follow-ups, using counseling techniques to support progress, explore barriers, and adapt care plans over time
  • Utilize a counseling-focused, motivational interviewing approach to support members in exploring their goals, building sustainable habits, and navigating the program, while applying Weight Watchers nutrition guidance, protocols, and evidence-based practices

Requirements

    • Windows 11

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing telehealth company focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We deliver patient-centered, provider-guided care through a modern virtual platform, combining clinical oversight with strong operational support.

As part of our expansion, LumiMeds is building and scaling itsProfessional Corporation (PC) group, bringing licensed clinicians directly into our care model to support high-quality, compliant patient care across the U.S.

Role Overview

We’re seeking an experiencedPhysician or Nurse Practitionerto join LumiMeds’ PC group and provide direct patient care via telehealth.

In this role, you’ll conduct virtual evaluations, review patient health data, and determine appropriate treatment plans based on your independent clinical judgment. You’ll work closely with LumiMeds’ care coordination and operations teams to ensure patients receive safe, compliant, and evidence-based care.

This role offers flexibility, clinical autonomy, and the opportunity to be part of a rapidly scaling telehealth organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conductvirtual patient consultations(synchronous and asynchronous, as applicable)

  • Review patient intake forms, medical histories, and laboratory results

  • Determine medical necessity and prescribe treatmentwhen clinically appropriate, in accordance with state and federal regulations

  • Provide ongoing clinical oversight, follow-ups, and adjustments as needed

  • Document all encounters, decisions, and prescriptions accurately in the EMR

  • Collaborate with care coordinators and internal teams to support patient adherence and outcomes

  • Maintain compliance with all applicable telehealth, prescribing, and documentation standards

  • Serve as an active clinical member of LumiMeds’ PC group

Qualifications

Physicians

  • MD or DO with an active, unrestricted U.S. medical license

  • Board-certified inFamily MedicineorInternal Medicine

  • Eligible to practice telemedicine in licensed states

Nurse Practitioners

  • Active, unrestricted NP license with prescriptive authority

  • Board-certified (FNP, AGNP, or equivalent)

  • Meets state requirements for telehealth practice

For All Candidates

  • Licensed inmultiple U.S. states(30+ state coverage strongly preferred)

  • Prior telehealth experience preferred

  • Strong understanding of evidence-based weight management and metabolic health

  • Excellent clinical judgment, documentation skills, and attention to detail

  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, remote-first environment

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, flexible schedule

  • Administrative, care coordination, and operational support

  • Modern EMR and streamlined workflows

  • Opportunity to help shape and grow a physician-led telehealth PC group

  • Competitive per-visit or contract-based compensation (role-dependent)

Important Notes

  • All clinical decisions, including prescribing, are madesolely at the discretion of the provider

  • LumiMeds does not direct or mandate specific medical treatments

  • This role is designed to support compliant, ethical, patient-first care

How to Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role.

This position is open to candidates based in approved locations, depending on the role and business needs. Qualified applicants will be contacted for next steps.

LumiMeds is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skills, experience, and alignment with our values.

Please note: This role requires professional-level English communication and availability to work U.S. business hours.

About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the Team:

The Financial Data team at AlphaSense is responsible for delivering the data foundation that powers our industry-leading market intelligence platform. We focus on sourcing, integrating, and surfacing structured datasets that enable clients to discover and act on insights in new ways. Our team is dedicated to delivering these datasets directly into our clients' most critical workflows.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Product Manager to own and define the next generation of our financial data offerings, with a specific emphasis on Private Markets, including Shareholder + Deals content. In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of our vast financial datasets and the end-user's core research and diligence workflows. You will drive the roadmap for how users discover, evaluate, and act on Private Markets Content, defining the content strategy and feature set that makes this content an indispensable input for financial professionals — including identifying and closing content gaps, and driving adoption and usage across the client base.

You'll partner closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to define requirements, author PRDs, and lead the development of new features.

Who You Are:

  • An experienced Product Manager with a minimum of 2 years of experience building SaaS products in partnership with engineering and scrum teams.
  • Experienced in financial data and search products.
  • A clear, persuasive communicator who creates PRDs, roadmaps, and requirements that align stakeholders and drive execution.
  • Organized and detail-oriented, with a proven ability to manage a complex product backlog and deliver features end-to-end.
  • A strategic thinker with a discovery mindset, deeply curious about client workflows and pain points, especially those of financial analysts, investment bankers, and corporate development/deal teams.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered search or workflow technologies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field required.

What You'll Do:

  • Define and execute the short- and mid-term roadmaps for AlphaSense's private markets, shareholder, and deals content, aligning with business objectives and client needs.
  • Contribute to the long-term Financial Data vision by building a deep understanding of client personas (e.g., analysts, bankers, corporate development professionals) and their diligence, deal-sourcing, and ownership-analysis use cases.
  • Continuously assess content gaps across private markets, shareholder, and deals data, and prioritize sourcing and coverage improvements to close them.
  • Write and prioritize product requirements (PRDs) informed by customer discovery and client feedback, specifically related to content coverage, data quality, and discoverability of vendor, shareholder, and deals content.
    Work with core data platform teams to ensure seamless data delivery, sourcing pipeline performance, and reliability for vendor, shareholder, and deals content.
  • Identify and conduct QA strategies for content coverage, accuracy, and completeness.
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, and GTM teams to ensure successful product launches and adoption of new content and feature releases.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

You will be joining Stripe’s ML Foundations and Gen AI team to incubate new ML applications and improve our ML capabilities across Stripe. Our team is responsible for unlocking novel ML and LLM techniques and applications across Stripe’s product suite to drive business outcomes, as well as providing infrastructure, tooling and support for ML teams.

What you’ll do

As a senior product leader, you will lead a cross-functional team to define, incubate and scale new ML/AI applications across Stripe’s product suite, and drive our strategy and roadmap for ML/AI infrastructure powering all of Stripe’s teams. You will work closely with product leaders across business units to define and deliver on an AI-centric product strategy, launching new applications that drive incremental business outcomes. At the same time, you will be advancing our core AI technology stack to empower teams across Stripe to infuse their scenarios with Agents and agentic capabilities, with API support for agent quality and continuous improvement.

We’re looking for someone who meets the requirements below, and has a passion for AI to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

    • 7+ years of experience delivering highly successful and innovative software products which are ML powered

    • You push the pace. You take blame and pass the praise. People love working with you.

    • Confidence creating client-facing reports, quarterly business reviews, and Excel-based program summaries

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
