jobs.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEWOnTrac is seeking a Scrum Master to serve as the dedicated Agile facilitator and servant leader for a Google Cloud Platform application development engagement.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

OnTrac is seeking a Scrum Master to serve as the dedicated Agile facilitator and servant leader for a Google Cloud Platform application development engagement. You own the outcome, not just the process: predictable delivery, team health, and client confidence are results you are accountable for. Working closely with the Product Owner, UX team, engineers, and architects, you will make sure the team follows Scrum practices and delivers high-quality software predictably.

This is a high-bar role for a proven practitioner. You will facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, remove impediments, coach the team on Agile methodologies, and handle team dynamics with minimal oversight, acting as a trusted advisor to client leaders while continuing to grow toward senior leadership.

The ideal candidate is organized, empathetic, analytical, client-minded, and accountable. You structure ambiguous problems, form and test hypotheses, and lead with the answer. You take full ownership, escalate early with a recommendation attached, and never wait to be asked. You deliver results, communicate with confidence, and keep raising your own standard.

ENGAGEMENT

  • Expected start date: as soon as possible
  • Location: United States only, fully remote
  • You must be located in, and authorized to work in, the United States for the full duration of the engagement

PRIMARY DUTIES

These duties are representative rather than exhaustive.

  • Scrum Ceremonies Facilitation: Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, and Retrospectives, keeping ceremonies time-boxed, engaging, and valuable. Design each ceremony around a clear purpose and decision, measure its value, and retire or redesign any ceremony that does not earn its time.
  • Agile Coaching: Coach the development team, Product Owner, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum frameworks, and best practices. Baseline team and organizational Agile maturity at the start of the engagement, set improvement targets, and report progress against them.
  • Impediment Removal: Proactively identify and remove blockers, surface conflicts early, and foster a culture of problem-solving. Own every impediment to closure, track time-to-resolve, and escalate within 24 hours when it cannot be resolved at team level, with options and a recommended path.
  • Team Health and Velocity: Track team velocity, capacity, and overall health to drive continuous improvement and predictable delivery. Go beyond velocity by tracking flow metrics (cycle time, throughput, work in progress, and aging items) and team health indicators, and act on the trends before they become problems.
  • SAFe Participation: Contribute to PI Planning, iteration planning, System Demos, and Inspect and Adapt. Help manage dependencies across teams within the Agile Release Train. Prepare teams for PI Planning with a refined, sized, and dependency-mapped backlog, and run a visible dependency plan that gives the Release Train Engineer no surprises.
  • Product Owner Collaboration: Support the Product Owner in maintaining and continuously refining the backlog, ensuring stories have clear acceptance criteria and meet the Definition of Ready. Coach the Product Owner to prioritize by business value and outcome, and keep at least two sprints of ready work in the backlog at all times.
  • Client Engagement: Support demos and working sessions, build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, and communicate sprint progress and Agile maturity clearly. Hold regular one-to-one touch points with client sponsors, anticipate their questions, and bring a point of view on delivery risk, pace, and trade-offs.
  • Metrics and Reporting: Track sprint progress, burn-down/burn-up charts, and backlog health, and report clearly to stakeholders and the PMO. Produce a concise one-page delivery summary each sprint that leads with the headline, shows status against plan, and states the decisions required from stakeholders.
  • Scope and Risk Visibility: Maintain risk, assumption, issue, and dependency (RAID) logs, escalating to the PMO and Project Manager when needed. Track potential scope changes through Agile tracking tools. Quantify the schedule and budget impact of each risk and scope change, and partner with the Project Manager on mitigation before the client raises the question.
  • Documentation and Practice Contribution: Maintain clear documentation and boards in Jira and Confluence, and contribute reusable Agile assets and ideas to the PMO Center of Excellence. Publish at least one reusable asset or practice improvement each quarter, and keep boards accurate enough that any stakeholder can self-serve status without asking.
  • Outcome and Value Ownership: Define success measures with the Product Owner and client sponsor at the start of the engagement. Track delivered value alongside delivered output, and challenge the team when activity is not translating into outcomes.
  • Forecasting and Predictability: Provide probabilistic delivery forecasts using historical throughput and cycle time, state the confidence level, and update the forecast every sprint. Flag deviations from plan early with a recovery option.
  • Engineering Enablement: Partner with architects and engineers to improve delivery practices on Google Cloud, including CI/CD, automated testing, and release cadence. Track delivery performance indicators such as deployment frequency and lead time for changes.
  • Mentorship and Leadership: Mentor junior Scrum Masters and Agile practitioners, share lessons across engagements, and help shape the program's Agile delivery standards.

PATHWAY TO SUCCESS

Be prepared, work with intentional effort, and offer no surprises for our clients and teammates. Anticipate the next question, the next risk, and the next decision before others do.

Your success starts with shaping the direction of a fast-growing practice. You will be measured quarterly on the breadth, magnitude, and quality of your contributions, team health, sprint delivery predictability, estimate and forecast accuracy, customer feedback at project close, mentorship of others, and the consultative polish you bring to interactions.

Measures are set with the PMO for each engagement and typically include:

  • Sprint predictability: Consistently meeting sprint goals, with the variance between committed and delivered work trending down.
  • Forecast accuracy: Release and milestone forecasts that land within an agreed tolerance of actual results.
  • Zero-surprise escalation: Risks and impediments raised early, with options, rather than discovered by the client.
  • Client confidence: Strong client satisfaction scores and positive feedback from sponsors at project close.
  • Team health: Stable or improving team health and engagement trends across the engagement.

As you succeed, we will build a customized development plan with you that follows either the individual contributor or the management track.

EXPECTATIONS

  • Customer Facing: You will be a primary voice to the client on Agile delivery, with touch points ranging from daily to bi-weekly, including PI Planning, sprint reviews, steering committees, and Agile workshops. You will present confidently to senior stakeholders and shape client decisions with clear, evidence-based recommendations.
  • Consulting Environment: You will work in a billable, project-based model, balancing client outcomes with schedule and utilization targets, and you may support more than one engagement. You will manage your time and priorities across engagements without needing direction, and flag capacity concerns early.
  • Servant Leadership: You will champion the Scrum team, fostering self-organization, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration. You will hold the team and yourself to a high standard, with candid and constructive feedback.
  • Ownership Mindset: You treat the engagement as your own. When something is unclear, broken, or at risk, you take the first step to fix it and keep the right people informed.
  • Onboarding and Training: The first several weeks are dedicated to learning, including materials, assignments, compliance training, and meetings with the people you will work with. By day 30 you will deliver a baseline assessment of team health, delivery flow, and risks, and by day 90 an agreed improvement plan with measurable targets.

REQUIRED CREDENTIALS

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field. An advanced degree is a plus.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least five years of experience in a technical, engineering, or software development environment.
  • At least three years as a Scrum Master or Agile delivery lead, facilitating all Scrum ceremonies for one or more application development teams.
  • At least three years of IT consulting or professional services experience in a client-facing role.
  • CSM, PSM, or SAFe Scrum Master certification.
  • Hands-on participation in at least two SAFe projects or Agile Release Trains, including PI Planning.
  • Experience supporting UX, design, and engineering teams to turn requirements into shippable increments.
  • Strong capability with backlog management tools, specifically Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience tracking team metrics (velocity, capacity, burn-down) and providing status reports.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • A positive attitude toward change and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • A love for cloud computing and modern application development.
  • Demonstrated ownership: examples of taking accountability for a delivery outcome, recovering a struggling project, or escalating a risk early that protected the client.

USEFUL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced Agile certifications (A-CSM, PSM II, PMI-ACP, or equivalent).
  • Experience with GCP or other public cloud application development projects.
  • Consulting experience at a cloud partner, systems integrator, or advisory firm.
  • Exposure to pre-sales, solution scoping, or Agile transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience in the government sector.

  • Experience with distributed and offshore teams.
  • Experience with probabilistic forecasting, Agile maturity assessments, or coaching Product Owners and client executives.

The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR


We are hiring a Director of Cybersecurity to own security and security compliance across all of Slate. This is a company-wide program, not a corporate IT function. You will set the strategy, roadmap, and standards that protect our people, our data, our factory, our customers, and the truck itself, and you will build the team and partnerships to carry it out.

You will work across every part of the business: corporate IT, software engineering, enterprise systems, manufacturing systems, data, vehicle engineering, legal, finance, and our external partners. The job is to make security a capability that helps Slate ship faster and with confidence, not a gate that slows it down.

You will inherit early foundations, including a team, a NIST CSF 2.0 self-assessment, a managed detection and response plan, and baseline security policies, and turn them into a mature, measurable program that holds up to auditors, regulators, partners, and the board.

WHAT YOU GET TO DO


Security strategy and governance. Define Slate's cybersecurity strategy, multi-year roadmap, and risk-based priorities. Own the security policy framework, risk register, and governance model. Report on security posture and risk to the CTO, executive team, and board in clear business terms, and own the security budget.


Compliance and regulatory readiness. Lead Slate toward the frameworks and obligations our business will require, sequenced to match our growth: SOX IT general controls in partnership with Finance and internal audit, NIST CSF 2.0 maturity, ISO 27001 certification, PCI-DSS for payments, CCPA and state privacy laws, NIST 800-171 and CMMC for government and defense-adjacent work, and export control obligations. Own audit readiness, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.


Team and culture. Recruit, lead, and develop a security team, deciding where to build in-house expertise and where to rely on partners. Run security awareness and training that people remember, and build a culture where teams bring security problems forward early.


Vehicle and product cybersecurity. Partner with vehicle engineering and connected vehicle teams to stand up a Cybersecurity Management System aligned to ISO/SAE 21434 and UN R155/R156, including threat analysis and risk assessment (TARA), secure over-the-air updates, telematics and backend security, key and certificate management, and supplier cybersecurity requirements. Establish a product security incident response function and a coordinated vulnerability disclosure program and represent Slate in industry groups such as Auto-ISAC.


Application and cloud security. Work with Software Engineering and DevOps to embed security into the SDLC across our consumer website, ecommerce platform, mobile app, B2B integrations, and internal applications. Set standards for threat modeling, secure code review, SAST/DAST, dependency and secrets management, and cloud security posture across AWS, Azure, and edge platforms. Drive penetration testing and remediation prioritization.

Enterprise systems security. Partner with Enterprise Systems to secure ERP (SAP S/4HANA), WMS, procurement, warranty, and other business platforms. Own role design standards, segregation of duties, privileged access, and access reviews that satisfy SOX and keep financial and operational data trustworthy.


Manufacturing and OT security. Partner with Manufacturing Systems, Controls, and IT Operations to secure the plant floor at Warsaw and future sites. Establish an OT security program aligned to IEC 62443, including network segmentation across ISA-95 levels, asset inventory, secure remote and vendor access, OT monitoring, and incident response plans that put safety and production uptime first. You understand that in a factory, a security control that stops the line is also an outage.


Corporate and enterprise security. Own identity and access management strategy (workforce and federated customer and partner identity), endpoint and email security, vulnerability management, and security architecture for corporate infrastructure, working closely with IT Operations who run the underlying platforms and day to day.


Data security and privacy. Partner with the Data team and Legal to define data classification, retention, and protection standards across our data lake house, vehicle telemetry, customer data, and manufacturing data. Ensure privacy by design for consumer and connected vehicle data and set controls for safe use of AI and LLM tools across the company.


Security operations and incident response. Own detection, response, and threat intelligence. Build and exercise the incident response plan across IT, cloud, OT, and vehicle scenarios, including crisis communications, legal coordination, and regulatory notification. Track and improve detection coverage and response times.


Third-party and supply chain risk. Establish a vendor security risk program covering SaaS providers, MSPs, integration partners, component suppliers, and contract manufacturers, scaled to the risk each one carries.


Partnerships

This role sits within the Technology organization and partners as a peer with the leaders of IT Infrastructure and Operations, Enterprise Systems, Manufacturing Systems, Software Engineering, DevOps, and Data. Outside of Technology, you will work closely with vehicle engineering, manufacturing, legal and compliance, finance and internal audit, supply chain, and customer care. Much of your impact will come through influence rather than authority, so trust, clarity, and pragmatism matter as much as technical depth.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM


  • 10 or more years in information security or cybersecurity, with at least 5 years leading security teams or programs.
  • Experience building or substantially maturing a security program across multiple domains, not only a single function such as SOC, GRC, or AppSec.
  • Hands-on leadership of compliance efforts against recognized frameworks, including SOX IT general controls and at least one of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, or NIST 800-171. You have been through real audits and certifications.
  • Direct experience securing manufacturing, industrial, or OT environments, or a strong working knowledge of IEC 62443, OT network segmentation, and the operational realities of a production floor.
  • Solid technical grounding in cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, application security, and security operations. Deep enough to evaluate architecture and challenge vendors, not only to manage people who do.
  • A track record of translating risk into business terms and making pragmatic, prioritized tradeoffs in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting to executives and boards, and a low-ego, collaborative approach to working across departments.

Preferred

  • Automotive, EV, or connected product security experience, including ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155/R156, or a Cybersecurity Management System.
  • Experience standing up security for a greenfield plant, a new company, or a business going through rapid scale-up.
  • Consumer ecommerce and payments security, including PCI-DSS scoping and consumer privacy regulations.
  • Experience with CMMC, ITAR/EAR, or government and defense contracting requirements.
  • Familiarity with securing data platforms and AI/ML or LLM-based applications.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GICSP, or CCSP.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Work Authorization Requirement:

SALARY RANGE

ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?

At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles.

Company:

Mitsubishi Performance Polymers Division

Job Description:

Are you a strategic sales professional with a passion for engineering plastics, automotive applications, and building strong customer relationships? Mitsubishi Chemical is seeking an experienced Sales Manager, Engineering Plastics to drive business growth, strengthen strategic customer partnerships, and expand our presence across automotive and non-automotive markets.


In this highly collaborative role, you'll serve as a key connection between our U.S. commercial organization and our Sales and R&D teams in Japan. You'll be responsible for developing new business opportunities, supporting Japanese customer accounts, and delivering innovative material solutions that meet evolving customer needs.


If you're a fluent Japanese-speaking sales professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with relationship management, business development, and global collaboration, we'd love to hear from you!


What You'll Do

Drive Sales Growth & Business Development

  • Develop and execute sales strategies that support revenue growth, operating income improvement, and business objectives.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within engineering plastics, automotive applications, and related markets.
  • Expand the customer base across automotive and non-automotive industries.
  • Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional products and services.
  • Develop compelling value propositions that demonstrate the technical and commercial benefits of Mitsubishi Chemical products.
  • Provide strategic account direction and qualified business opportunities to the commercial team.

Build & Strengthen Strategic Customer Relationships

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers, including Japanese automotive accounts.
  • Engage with senior-level customer stakeholders to understand business priorities, technical requirements, and growth opportunities.
  • Serve as a trusted commercial partner by providing responsive customer service and technical solutions.
  • Identify customer challenges and collaborate with internal teams to develop tailored solutions.
  • Support long-term customer relationships that drive sustainable business growth.

Partner with Global Sales & R&D Teams

  • Serve as a primary communication liaison between U.S. commercial teams and Sales and R&D teams in Japan.
  • Facilitate communication, updates, and information sharing across global sales and marketing organizations.
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders to align commercial priorities, customer requirements, and product development opportunities.
  • Communicate customer feedback, emerging applications, and new product requests to Commercial and R&D teams.
  • Support collaboration across regions to strengthen customer engagement and business development efforts.

Provide Technical Sales & Application Support

  • Develop and maintain strong technical knowledge of engineering plastics, compounding, and application development.
  • Partner with technical teams to provide customers with product information, application guidance, and technical support.
  • Help customers identify material solutions that address performance, manufacturing, and application requirements.
  • Support the introduction of new products, applications, and services.
  • Translate technical capabilities into customer value and commercial opportunities.

Monitor Market Trends & Identify Opportunities

  • Stay informed about automotive and engineering plastics industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.
  • Monitor changes in legislation, regulations, trade developments, and industry standards that may impact the business.
  • Gather customer and market intelligence to identify new opportunities.
  • Share insights regarding customer preferences, market needs, and product development opportunities.
  • Provide recommendations that support long-term commercial strategies and market expansion.

Drive Commercial Excellence

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales activities, and business opportunities.
  • Prepare regular reports on sales performance, customer feedback, and market developments.
  • Support the development and improvement of sales tools, processes, and commercial practices.
  • Maintain strong product knowledge through ongoing training and professional development.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment on customer priorities and business objectives.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluency in Japanese, both written and verbal, is required, along with an understanding of Japanese business culture.
  • Four-year degree in Plastics Technology, Business, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of related commercial experience in sales, marketing, or new business development, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong knowledge of engineering plastics, compounding, application development, and technical support.
  • Experience working within a multinational organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain relationships with senior-level customer stakeholders.
  • Strong business development, strategic thinking, and customer relationship management capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong planning, organization, and time-management abilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the automotive industry.
  • Background in plastic resin manufacturing and sales.
  • Experience supporting Japanese automotive customers or multinational accounts.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another CRM platform.
  • Experience collaborating with international Sales, Marketing, and R&D teams.
  • Strong technical understanding of engineered plastic materials and their applications.

Work Arrangement & Travel

  • Location: Remote (United States)
  • Travel: Approximately 30% within the United States.
  • Regular collaboration with global commercial and technical teams, including colleagues in Japan.

What Will Help You Succeed

We're looking for a sales professional who combines technical knowledge, commercial expertise, and strong cross-cultural communication skills.

You'll be successful in this role if you enjoy developing strategic customer relationships, identifying new applications for engineered materials, and collaborating with global teams to bring innovative solutions to market.

The ideal candidate is proactive, customer-focused, and comfortable navigating a multinational business environment. You'll bring the ability to engage senior-level stakeholders, communicate effectively across cultures, and translate customer needs into meaningful business opportunities.


Why Join Us?

  • Play a key role in expanding Mitsubishi Chemical's Engineering Plastics business.
  • Develop strategic relationships with Japanese automotive customers and other key industry partners.
  • Serve as an important connection between U.S. commercial operations and global teams in Japan.
  • Influence new product development and emerging application opportunities.
  • Work with innovative engineering plastics and advanced material solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced professionals across Sales, Marketing, R&D, and technical functions.
  • Contribute to business growth across automotive and non-automotive markets.
  • Join a global organization committed to innovation, collaboration, and long-term customer partnerships.

If you're a Japanese-speaking commercial professional with a strong technical background and a passion for developing business within the engineering plastics industry, we encourage you to apply and help drive the continued growth of Mitsubishi Chemical's Engineering Plastics business!

jobs.description:
Overview

The Business Technology team, which reports to the CIO, is building intelligent internal tools that help our clinical, operational, and financial teams work faster and make better decisions across ~850 clinics and 40+ brands. This is a business need supported by technology — not a “tech for tech’s sake” initiative.

We’re looking for an AI Solutions Engineer / Product Builder who can take a messy business problem, turn it into a clear technical plan, and ship something useful quickly. You’ll work hands-on with business leaders across ClinOps, Finance, HR, Marketing, and other teams to design and build practical tools, workflows, and AI-enabled solutions.

This is a builder role. You’ll spend most of your time creating, testing, debugging, and improving solutions, often with the help of AI tools that amplify your output. We want someone who is comfortable moving quickly, learning new systems, and figuring things out without waiting for perfect instructions.

Our current environment includes modern internal automation and solution-engineering platforms, with TypeScript as the primary build language and Python used where needed. Prior experience with our exact platforms is not required; what matters most is that you can adapt fast, build well, and solve real problems.

What You’ll Build
You’ll work on a mix of internal products, automations, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows, including:
AI Agents — role-specific assistants for procurement, operations, clinical education, and other business functions
Automations — multi-step workflows triggered by schedules, emails, forms, and webhooks
Internal Web Apps — React-based dashboards, forms, and operational tools
Data Infrastructure — PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and datasets that power internal tools
Agent-Orchestrated Workflows — solutions that combine data, tools, and memory to solve multi-step problems
Data Pipelines — ingesting and transforming data across internal and external sources
Custom Microservices — lightweight services, APIs, and tools that extend what the team can do

Mindset & Approach

  • Business First:You’re energized by turning messy business processes into clear, logical systems.
  • Product-Minded Builder: You think about the user, the workflow, and the outcome — not just the code.
  • Fearless Problem Solver:You’re comfortable with ambiguity, you push forward without perfect instructions, and you know how to course-correct when the first version isn’t quite right.
  • AI-Leveraged: You use AI as a force multiplier. You know how to direct it, review its output, and keep quality high while moving quickly.
  • Hands-On Debugger: You like getting under the hood when something breaks and figuring out why a workflow, integration, or agent isn’t behaving the way it should.

Responsibilities

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you’ll be successful if you can:

  • Turn a business request into a working technical solution
  • Ask the right questions up front, then build with autonomy
  • Move quickly without losing quality
  • Debug issues across data, APIs, application logic, and AI workflows
  • Build things that people actually want to use
  • Learn unfamiliar systems and tools fast
  • Use AI to multiply your output, not replace your judgment

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Managing a team of developers
  • Owning enterprise cloud infrastructure or DevOps pipelines
  • Spending all day on Power Platform or Power Automate
  • Waiting for highly detailed tickets before you can start
  • Working only in one narrow technology area

Why This Role Matters

This is a chance to help shape how Confluent Health builds internal AI-powered tools that improve operations, reduce manual work, and make teams more effective. The work is practical, fast-moving, and high-impact.

If you like being close to the business problem, enjoy building useful things, and are excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, automation, data, and software, this role should feel like a strong fit.

Qualifications

Required Core Skills

  • TypeScript: Strong fluency. This is the primary language for much of the work.
  • Integration Fundamentals: Strong experience with REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, permissions, and debugging authentication issues.
  • React: Comfortable building functional components, hooks, and data-driven interfaces.
  • SQL / PostgreSQL: Strong schema design and querying skills, including joins, aggregates, and performance-aware queries.
  • LLM / Agentic AI: Experience building with tool-calling, prompt design, agent loops, or similar AI-driven workflows.

Strongly Preferred

  • Python: Comfortable reading, writing, and debugging Python for scripts, pipelines, or microservices.
  • Microsoft 365 / Graph API: Experience integrating with SharePoint, Outlook, Teams, or Excel.
  • AI-assisted development: Experience using AI tools to accelerate real work while maintaining code quality and judgment.
  • Low-code / pro-code platforms: Experience with systems that combine workflow logic, code, and integrations.
  • Healthcare or regulated-environment experience: Familiarity with operational, clinical, finance, or compliance-oriented workflows.

Helpful Differentiators

  • Experience building internal tools, automations, or operational applications
  • Experience with workflow orchestration or agent reliability
  • Experience troubleshooting APIs, data issues, or production workflow failures
  • Familiarity with persistent memory, knowledge graphs, or multi-step AI systems

jobs.description:
About Self Bill Pro:

Self Bill Pro is a rapidly growing startup dedicated to solving one of the most persistent challenges in the employee benefits ecosystem: the complexity of monthly benefits billing. We provide a tech-enabled service where our dedicated team leverages proprietary software to eliminate the administrative burdens of manual invoice audits and costly billing errors. Our mission is to streamline this critical operation, freeing up employers, brokers, and carriers to focus on their strategic priorities.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Client Service Manager (CSM) with employee benefits experience to be the primary point of contact and relationship owner for a dedicated portfolio of clients. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager of Client Services, not a people-leadership position. This is a client-facing role: fielding inbound inquiries, running proactive touchpoints across the client lifecycle, and owning the overall health of each relationship. This is a remote position.

Key Responsibilities:

Relationship Ownership & Client Success

  • Serve as the main point of contact and relationship owner for a portfolio of clients.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key client stakeholders, benefit administrators, brokers, and benefit carriers.

  • Run proactive touchpoints across the client lifecycle (post-onboarding check-ins, periodic health checks, pre-renewal outreach), adapting cadence and communication style (call vs. email) to each client.

  • Keep brokers looped into client communications and maintain the broker relationship directly.

  • Own the controllable retention rate for your book of business.

Client-Facing Support & Advocacy

  • Own inbound client inquiries end-to-end — billing questions, benefit invoice issues, and general account concerns — through to full resolution.

  • Explain how benefit changes and data flow into billing so clients understand the invoice, not just the answer.

  • Partner with cross-functional internal teams to resolve billing and benefit-related issues.

  • Interface directly with reps from benefit administration platforms and insurance carriers to execute data or account updates.

  • When an issue can't be solved directly, guide the client to the right resource and follow up to confirm resolution.

Invoicing Accuracy & Data Auditing

  • Create and deliver precise, on-time benefit invoices every month through meticulous preparation and rigorous review.

  • Coordinate daily with Client Services Administrative Specialists (CSAS) who assist with invoice creation, ensuring they understand each account and are meeting expectations on every invoice.

  • Regularly audit data between systems (e.g., carrier, payroll/HRIS, and billing platforms) to confirm accuracy and consistency.

  • Identify and find the root cause of enrollment, date, premium, and coverage discrepancies.

  • Correct discrepancies and follow up with the relevant system or party to prevent recurrence.

  • Provide training and guidance to clients on billing procedures and benefit plan details as needed.

Renewal & Account Management

  • Lead clients through the annual renewal process, managing billing changes and the transition.

  • Monitor account health and flag early warning signs — slow responses, unresolved questions, disengaged brokers or carriers.

  • Identify and surface opportunities for process improvements in billing and account management.

Requirements

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience in employee benefits account management, client success, or a client-facing relationship management role, or 7+ years of relevant experience.

  • Customer-centric mindset with strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfortable initiating proactive outreach and scheduling calls rather than defaulting to email.

  • Ability to manage a portfolio of complex client accounts, including hands-on billing issue resolution.

  • Familiarity with 834 and LDEx EDI files.

  • Strong analytical acumen; comfort with data analysis and manipulation, particularly in Microsoft Excel.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, project management tools, and CRM systems.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced startup environment.

Why Join Self Bill Pro:

At Self Bill Pro, you'll join a collaborative, ambitious team using smart, scalable technology to modernize benefits billing. We encourage motivated relationship-builders to apply!

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Rockstar is seeking an experienced Provider Credentialing Specialist to support U.S.-based healthcare practices on a full-time remote basis. This is a credentialing-first role built for professionals who understand the full provider enrollment lifecycle, from initial application through re-credentialing and payer follow-up, and who take pride in keeping processes accurate, organized, and moving forward without gaps.

In this role, you will manage provider credentialing and re-credentialing workflows, complete payer enrollments, maintain CAQH profiles, conduct sanctions checks, and serve as a reliable point of contact for providers and payers alike. Depending on the client, you may also provide light support to billing and accounts receivable functions as a secondary responsibility.

This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and confident making follow-up calls to insurance payers: someone who doesn't let applications sit and knows exactly what to do when a payer goes quiet.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Provider Credentialing & Enrollment

  • Gather required documentation from new and existing providers to initiate credentialing
  • Prepare, complete, and submit credentialing applications for new providers across commercial and government payers
  • Complete re-credentialing applications as they come due and ensure submissions are made ahead of expiration deadlines
  • Submit and track NPI enrollment, PECOS enrollment, and Medicare/Medicaid applications as required
  • Manage multi-state credentialing processes and payer-specific enrollment requirements
  • Track all active credentialing applications, submission dates, payer responses, and approval confirmations
  • Save credentialing confirmations in provider files and update credentialing trackers accordingly

CAQH, Sanctions & Compliance

  • Create and maintain CAQH profiles for new providers, ensuring all information is accurate and current
  • Complete CAQH attestations on schedule and keep provider data up to date across all payer portals
  • Perform monthly sanctions checks for all providers and document results consistently
  • Maintain organized, compliant, and audit-ready credentialing records at all times
  • Stay current on payer credentialing requirements, enrollment changes, and industry updates

Payer Follow-Up & Communication

  • Proactively follow up with insurance payers via phone and email to confirm receipt, check application status, and resolve outstanding items
  • Coordinate with providers to ensure required documentation is submitted completely and on time
  • Serve as a key point of contact for credentialing-related questions from providers, payers, and internal teams
  • Escalate credentialing delays or payer issues to leadership when timelines are at risk
  • Maintain clear records of all payer communications, follow-up dates, and credentialing decisions

Provider Offboarding

  • Manage credentialing offboarding processes when providers depart, including payer notification and record updates
  • Ensure departing providers are properly removed from active payer rosters and internal trackers

Billing & Administrative Support (Where Applicable)

  • Depending on the client, this role may include light support for billing and accounts receivable workflows as time allows, including claims follow-up, payer calls related to unpaid or denied claims, and general administrative coordination to keep revenue cycle operations moving.

Requirements

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on provider credentialing experience: this is not an entry-level role
  • Proven experience managing full credentialing workflows: application submission, payer follow-up, re-credentialing, and documentation
  • Strong working knowledge of CAQH, NPI enrollment, and payer-specific credentialing requirements
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer enrollment processes
  • Comfortable making proactive follow-up calls to insurance payers and requesting information from providers
  • Exceptional attention to detail and deadline management: accuracy and follow-through are essential in this role
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple active credentialing workflows simultaneously
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) or Google Workspace
  • Reliable home office setup with a stable internet connection

Preferred

Overview

Please note that this position is contingent upon the successful award of a contract currently under bid.

Goldbelt Glacier is accelerating healthcare delivery and providing superior force health readiness across the military, federal, and civilian landscapes. Goldbelt Glacier is committed to providing transformative and comprehensive health operational capabilities to support customers across scientific, clinical, technological, and program management areas.

Goldbelt Glacier is a trusted industry partner to the Department of the Interior, Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA). Goldbelt Glacier supports programs administered through the BIA including social services, natural resources management, economic development, law enforcement and detention services, administration of tribal courts, implementation of land and water claim settlements, housing improvement, disaster relief, replacement and repair of schools, repair and maintenance of roads and bridges, and the repair of structural deficiencies on high hazard dams.

Summary:

The Level II (Junior) acquisition support personnel, which is equivalent to the skills and experience expected of a GS-11 to GS-12 Contract Specialist, must be capable of supporting cradle-to-grave federal acquisitions across Construction, Architecture & Engineering (A&E), Supplies, and Services. This support will cross the IA enterprise but will primarily support the Division of Water and Power, under the Office of Trust Services. The Acquisition support personnel must possess foundational experience in federal contracting sufficient to work semi-independently while still operating under the oversight of senior acquisition officials.

This is a remote position, but travel may be required.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Construction, A&E Services, Supplies, and General Services: Provide advice, recommendations, drafting, and document support to multiple offices in all areas of acquisitions, program management, and requirements development with a focus on Construction, A&E Services, Supplies, and Service acquisitions. Provide all necessary support, by working with BIA, BIE, AS/IA, and other Government customers, in a team environment, to review draft documents and assist customers to the extent necessary to produce executable acquisition strategies, contractible requirements, Statements of Work, and sound Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCE). Coordinate with their client agencies on all requirement support services. Develop and use a system to accurately track and maintain information on Taskers and Requests for Information, keep track of and remind customers of suspenses, and coordinate with customers for current information to update status.
  • Statements of Work/Specifications/Requirements Documents: Prepare pre-award documents such as Determinations and Findings (D&F), Single Source Determinations, Limited Source Determinations, and Justifications for Other Than Full and Open Competition (JOFOC) and other necessary contract file documents. All final decisions will be made by appropriate Government personnel. Guide the customer through the evaluation process and prepare written documentation to support either informal or formal evaluation procedures. Guide evaluators, with guidance from the CO, to identify pre-negotiation objectives and assist the CO with discussions with offerors.
  • Acquisition Strategy Support: Provide advice and recommendations for all elements in acquisition plans—including approaches, options, strategies, risks, contracting methods, competition, sources, cost, and milestone schedules—for Construction, A&E, Supplies, and Service acquisitions. Research existing Government-wide contracts for available products and services. Evaluate different approaches to and sources for acquisition support. Research available suppliers and compare the services and costs of obtaining support from different providers. Assist with Economy Act applicability determinations.
  • Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs): Assist program offices in preparing IGCEs for Construction, A&E, Supplies, and Service requirements. Assistance may include research and analysis of past purchases of similar products or services, current market pricing, and other agency purchases of similar requirements.
  • Market Research and Market Surveys. Assist in conducting market research to identify potential sources and contract vehicles for Construction, A&E, Supplies, and Service procurements. Potential sources should include socio-economic program participants (e.g., ISBEE, IEE, small businesses, small and disadvantaged businesses, HUBZone firms). Potential vehicles should include GSA Schedule vendors, Government-wide Agency Contracts, and other agency contract tools. Conduct market surveys and prepare written documentation of market research. Support program offices in documenting small business capability analysis. Prepare SAM.gov and other electronic posting announcements.
  • Contract Administration. Assist the contracting office with contract award and administration for Construction, A&E, Supplies, and Service contracts. This includes providing guidance to the customer, recommending contract modifications, drafting modification documents, and performing any duties required to provide excellent contract administration support.
  • Automated Systems Support. Plan, deploy, upload, and maintain business systems, including FBMS support and intranet, SharePoint, and internet sites. Provide expert advice to users on DOI-wide electronic acquisition systems. Collect and analyze acquisition data, including FPDS-NG reporting data.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Working-level proficiency with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and the Department of the Interior Acquisition Regulation (DIAR), including requirements related to the Buy Indian Act and how its mandates are implemented through acquisition strategies and contractual mechanisms.
  • Experience supporting multiple requirement types, including Construction, A&E, Supplies, and Services—consistent with IA acquisition operations that manage all such categories.
  • Functional experience using PRISM, the IA contract-writing system, to perform acquisition-specific tasks such as drafting solicitations, assisting with awards, executing modifications, and supporting terminations or closeouts.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Three (3) years' relevant experience.
  • Ability to travel if needed.
  • Required to successfully pass a federal background investigation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Draft and refine acquisition documents (SOWs, PWSs, IGCE inputs, solicitation components) with supervisory guidance.
  • Conduct market research and assist with small business considerations.
  • Support evaluation activities and documentation.
  • Assist Contracting Officers and CORs with routine contract administration actions across Construction, A&E, Supplies, and Services.
  • Navigate and complete tasks within PRISM with limited oversight.

Pay and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $65,000 - $75,000 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

jobs.excerpt: Du verbindest technische Beratung mit kundennaher Vertriebsunterstützung und möchtest Robotics-Lösungen aktiv in den Markt bringen?
jobs.description:
Du verbindest technische Beratung mit kundennaher Vertriebsunterstützung und möchtest Robotics-Lösungen aktiv in den Markt bringen? Für den Ausbau unseres Robotics-Geschäfts suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Kundenanforderungen versteht, passende Lösungen entwickelt und Sales dabei unterstützt, konkrete Projekte und Deals erfolgreich abzuschließen.

Deine Rolle bei Tekpoint

Als Technical Sales Engineer - Robotics bist du die technische Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Vendoren und Sales. Du analysierst Use Cases in Logistik, Manufacturing und Retail, übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete Robotics-Lösungen und begleitest Demos, Piloten und Proofs of Concept bis zur Entscheidungsreife.

Aufgaben

Kundenanforderungen & Lösungskonzepte

  • Analyse von Kunden-Use-Cases in Logistik, Manufacturing und Retail
  • Design passender Robotics-Lösungen, z. B. AMR, Service Robots und Cobots
  • Erklärung komplexer technischer Lösungen in einfacher, verständlicher Sprache
  • Vorbereitung technischer Konzepte, Lösungsskizzen und Entscheidungsvorlagen

Demos, Piloten & Sales Support

  • Durchführung und Begleitung von Demos, Piloten und Proofs of Concept
  • Erstellung technischer Angebote, Vorschläge und ROI-Berechnungen
  • Unterstützung des Sales Teams in der Angebotsphase und beim Abschluss von Deals
  • Pre-Sales-Support sowie erste technische After-Sales-Unterstützung nach Projektstart

Schnittstelle zu Vendoren und Kunden

  • Hauptansprechperson zwischen Vendoren, Kunden und internen Teams bei technischen Fragen
  • Testing, Setup und Troubleshooting im Rahmen von Kundenprojekten
  • Ableitung wiederholbarer Use Cases aus Pilotprojekten und Kundenfeedback

Qualifikation

Fachliche Qualifikationen

  • Studium, Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Erfahrung in Robotics, Automation, Mechatronics oder einem ähnlichen Bereich
  • 3 bis 7 Jahre Erfahrung in Technical Sales, Application Engineering, Presales oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Kundenrolle
  • Starkes Verständnis von Robotics-Systemen und deren Integration in bestehende Prozesse
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Persönliche Kompetenzen

  • Kundennahes Auftreten und Erfahrung in direkter Kundenkommunikation
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Lösungen einfach, klar und überzeugend zu erklären
  • Hands-on-Mindset bei Testing, Setup und Troubleshooting
  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und verbindliche Arbeitsweise

Must-have

  • Erfahrung mit Industrial Automation oder Robotics
  • Customer-facing Experience in technischer Beratung, Presales, Application Engineering oder ähnlichen Rollen

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit AMR oder Warehouse Robotics
  • Kenntnisse in PLC, IoT oder System Integration

Erfolg nach 6 Monaten

  • 5 bis 10 qualifizierte Kunden-Opportunities aufgebaut
  • 2 bis 3 erfolgreiche Piloten oder Proofs of Concept begleitetErste abgeschlossene Deals mit wiederholbaren Use Cases erreicht

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Spannende Aufgabe in einem dynamischen und internationalen Umfeld
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung eines wachsenden Geschäftsbereichs mit hoher Sichtbarkeit
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Kommunikation und eine teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur
  • Moderne Arbeitsweise mit Fokus auf Digitalisierung, Effizienz und pragmatische Lösungen

jobs.excerpt: About Eve Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there.
jobs.description:
About Eve
Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

The Role

We're hiring a Staff Analytics Engineer to own Eve's go-to-market data model and set the standard the rest of the analytics engineering team works inside.

The number of people asking the data a question is growing faster than the business, and the business is doubling. Today the same question can produce different answers depending on who asks and which tool they open. As the Staff engineer, GTM is your domain but not your limit. You'll own the certification framework and catalog that determine what counts as trusted across every domain, set the modeling standards other analytics engineers and analysts build inside, and make the calls when two teams define the same thing differently. Your users span analysts and stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, CS, and RevOps.

You'll work on our central team and report to the Head of Data Engineering, who reports directly to the CEO. Data is a first-class function at Eve and the fuel to drive our future growth.

What You'll Do

Model GTM

  • Partner with analysts and stakeholders to build the models that power Eve's GTM decisions: pipeline, funnel, campaign, and revenue, sourced from HubSpot, DealHub, Apollo, and Clay and built in the warehouse and semantic layer rather than inside those tools
  • Design semantic models for core GTM SaaS metrics (pipeline coverage, funnel conversion, CAC, win rate, sales cycle time, ARR and bookings), then own deploying and maintaining them as the trusted foundation for both analytics and AI consumption

  • Maintain documentation of the models, metrics, and definitions you own
  • Stand up internal AI agents and data-grounded tools that give GTM stakeholders a direct, trustworthy answer without waiting on a ticket

  • Define the modeling standards and semantic layer patterns every analytics engineer and contributing analyst works inside
  • Partner with analysts building on the semantic layer, and own the certification call on what becomes a governed definition

  • Establish patterns and standards for analytical application development in Omni and Hex
  • Sit with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to turn open questions into durable models rather than one-off answers
  • Mentor analytics engineers and set the technical bar for how analytics engineering gets done at Eve

What We're Looking For

Guiding Principles

    Customer‑First Outcomes

    We favor composable primitives over clever abstractions. Open standards, clean APIs, and clear contracts win over custom complexity, even if the custom version is cooler.

jobs.description:
Company Summary:

Slang is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences. At Slang, we foster a culture of innovation, inclusivity, and growth, ensuring that every "Slangsta" (employee) feels valued and connected to our broader AI driven impact

What Your Experience Will Be:

As an Account Executive at Slang, you will play a pivotal role in driving our business forward. Collaborating closely with the Head of Sales and your manager, you will be integral to our rapid growth phase. You will work within the Sales department, engaging with various internal teams, such as Product and Customer Experience, to ensure a cohesive customer journey. Occasional travel may be required for attending conferences or company offsite meetings. Additionally, you will leverage sales technology to enhance productivity and connectivity with prospects and with your teammates.

Why You Belong Here & How You Will Grow:

At Slang , ou believe that trust is a foundational layer to any relationship starting internally as a slangsta through your touch points with each prospect. We cultivate a culture where every Slangster has a deep sense of pride in their achievements with humility. Our team is collaborative, supportive, and driven by shared goals fostering an abundance mindset in addition to belonging and inclusivity. We offer experiences and benefits designed to foster a sense of community both within and outside the organization. Learner Fervor represents our strongest attribute for growth, as we challenge each employee to take every opportunity to learn especially when it's hard. You will grow not only as a professional but also as an individual. We support and foster opportunities for learning and development, aligning with your career aspirations. From weekly team trainings to 1:1 coaching sessions with your manager or peers, company wide workshops, we will help your journey in finding purpose in your work and achieving your fullest potential.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Hunting and Closing: Proactively prospecting and closing new business opportunities.
  • Value Based Discovery and Demos: Actively listening to expertly uncover business impact, quantify value, and position Slang as uniquely qualified to deliver those outcomes.
  • Growing Key Markets: Expanding both existing and new market segments strategically.
  • Pipeline Management: Managing your sales pipeline to ensure quality multi-threading with key stakeholders, driving urgency of purchase, and navigating the buying process to ensure a predictable and steady flow of closed deals.
  • Leverage AI to innovate and drive process efficiency and achieve business objectives.
  • Collaborative Support: Working closely with the Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and expansion of existing accounts you have worked with.
  • Exceeding Targets: Consistently achieving and surpassing monthly sales quotas and weekly top-of-funnel metrics.

What You Will Bring:

  • Experience: 3+ years of sales experience with a proven track record of exceeding targets.
  • Traits and Behaviors: Described by others as a self starter, hunter, closer, curious, resourceful, and resilient. You possess a growth mindset and hustle to achieve your very best.
  • Business Acumen: The ability to speak directly to a prospect’s business problems, understand the industry, and act as a consultant.
  • Grit: You give your very best in everything you do and take ownership of the outcomes. Adversity and challenges don’t deter you from your commitment to driving results.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced and ever-evolving startup environment and excels under pressure.
  • Coachability: Open to feedback, self-motivated, and innovative in your approach.
  • Communication Skills: Strong in both written and verbal communication, a good listener, assertive, persistent, and persuasive, with a high EQ.
  • Preferred Experience: Experience in SaaS or hospitality (Hotels or restaurants) is a plus.

How Work Affects My Life:

At Slang, your role as an Account Executive will not only shape your professional trajectory but also enhance your personal well-being. We offer competitive compensation, including various rewards and benefits, to reflect your value to the company. By joining Slang.ai, you’ll find your work meaningful and aligned with your personal goals, shaping a positive worldview and reinforcing your sense of worth by helping businesses more efficiently serve their customers and alleviate pain for their staff while developing your business and hospitality ai acumen and skills.

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang.ai. We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).
We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

Overachiever Fever. We’re overachievers (we don’t know any other way)
Learner Fervor. We take every opportunity to learn (especially when it’s hard)
Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)
SMB MVP. We’re an expert member of our customers’ teams (we earn their trust)

jobs.description:
The Clinical Account Manager (CAM) acts as the primary customer contact for sales demand creation by executing marketing strategy and promoting Sobi products as lead by the Regional Sales Director. In this strategic role, the CAM provides current and comprehensive clinical knowledge of Sobi’s products and effectively communicates the on-label clinical benefits of the products. As a sales leader, the CAM is expected to achieve territory sales by executing Plan of Action (POA) marketing strategies, which includes delivering branded sales messages to customers, representing Sobi at local meetings, and achieving or exceeding sales targets.

*Please note this is a remote position but candidate must reside within the territory

  • Responsible for representing Sobi’s products and services to a defined customer base, generating and growing sales and consistently achieving or exceeding sales goals within a specific geographic area and actively promotes the appropriate use of Sobi products to healthcare professionals in accordance with all Corporate, PhRMA, and OIG guidelines
  • Comprehensive understand of Sobi and competitor products in their therapeutic area, and an in-depth knowledge of the disease states.
  • Develops and implements a territory business plan to meet customer needs and achieve sales goals and weekly analysis of territory sales data to help prioritize physician targeting and ensure accurate reporting of physicians
  • Strict compliance with all regulatory agencies, state, and federal law is required.
  • Prepares territory budget plans for customer contacts, local symposia, and other miscellaneous external expenditures
  • Assists in the identification and resolution of issues and opportunities and communicates proactively to sales and marketing management.
  • Reports all adverse events to Sobi’s Drug Safety department as appropriate per required guidelines
  • Performs all administrative functions require of the position, including reporting call activity and customer information into the appropriate call reporting system in a timely manner, submitting expenses, etc.
  • Located within the territory
  • BA/BS in business or science
  • Minimum of 5 years’ with dedicated hospital selling experience in the Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology industry, with minimum of 3 years’ specialty sales experience in the Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology industry
  • A CAM will have a minimum of 3 years’ of biologics sales experience that will utilize a specialty pharmacy or 8 years with dedicated hospital selling experience. Experience with a transition of care/patient journey process from the hospital to the outpatient setting
  • Demonstrated history of high sales performance
  • Experience with single source pharmacies, reimbursement programs, managed care, and formulary
  • Strong work ethic, ability to develop priorities, and manage time appropriately in a large, assigned geography.
  • Travel within the assigned territory, including overnights, which could be as high as 40-50% in some cases. Must be based in, or located near given geographic territory (relocation will not be provided)
  • This individual will also be responsible for accurately performing all administrative functions require of the position, including reporting call activity and customer information into the appropriate call reporting system in a timely manner, submitting expenses, etc., and travel within the assigned territory, including overnights, which could be as high as 40-50% in some cases. Must be based in or located in close proximity to given geographic territory (relocation will not be provided).

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

  • A competitive 401(k) match to support your financial future.
  • Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
  • A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.
  • Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. As a Client Experience Manager at Slang AI, you’ll own the end-to-end customer journey for our SMB clients — from onboarding through long-term success and day-to-day support. You’ll guide customers through their initial rollout, transition seamlessly into serving as their long-term success manager, and directly manage the support inbox during business hours, where many of their most important interactions occur.
Because support volume is currently low (fewer than 60 inquiries per month across 1,500+ customers), this role offers the opportunity to both deliver excellent frontline support and help design how support scales as we grow. You’ll gain unique visibility into customer needs in real time while influencing the tools, processes, and standards that will shape support as the business expands.

In addition, you’ll play a key role in our digital customer success program — helping define and refine automated success sequences to ensure accuracy, consistency, and strong adoption results. This work ensures customers experience the same hospitality-first service at scale, while giving you a direct impact on how Slang drives measurable results for our clients.

Why You Belong Here & How You Will Grow:

At Slang, we believe success starts with great execution and great service. In this role, you’ll gain valuable experience managing full customer lifecycles and working with hospitality operators in a fast-paced environment. You’ll learn how to onboard, support, and grow a book of business with autonomy, while contributing to scalable processes that improve outcomes across the team. We offer training, feedback, and growth opportunities to help you level up in customer success, technical product fluency, and strategic account management.

What Success Looks Like

  • Driving Long-Term Success: You are responsible for the health and success of your assigned accounts. You ensure customers are seeing clear outcomes, meeting their goals, and staying on track for renewal.

Team

Our people

We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Role Overview

HighLevel is accelerating its Email Marketing platform to become the AI-first communication engine for businesses worldwide. We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to transform Email Marketing from a traditional campaign builder into an intelligent, end-to-end campaign creation and automation ecosystem.

Today, HighLevel powers email creation, campaign scheduling, reporting, and lifecycle automation through Email Builder and Sequences. Your mandate is to redefine the customer experience through AI-native creation, intuitive editing interfaces, intelligent lifecycle automation, and actionable campaign intelligence — driving user adoption, activation, engagement, and revenue with a clear, metrics-driven product roadmap.




Key Responsibilities

1. Build World-Class Email Creation Experiences

  • Own the end-to-end Email Builder user experience, including drag-and-drop editors, custom HTML tools, reusable visual components, responsive templates, and real-time collaborative editing.

  • Build an industry-leading AI-native email editor that enables users to generate complete, high-converting email layouts using simple natural language prompts.

  • Lead the evolution of a natural language prompt-to-layout generation ("vibe-code") builder, allowing non-technical marketers to create production-ready emails instantaneously.

  • Deliver native multivariate experimentation tools, including subject line, body copy, layout, and Call-To-Action (CTA) A/B testing to continuously improve conversion rates.

  • Define the multi-year vision and execution strategy for Email AI, enabling automated campaign generation, brand-aware messaging, localized/multilingual copy creation, and intelligent optimization.

  • Build Sequence AI to automatically create multi-step lifecycle journeys, including onboarding, lead nurture, abandoned cart recovery, upsells, and re-engagement campaigns.

  • Partner closely with core AI teams to deliver prompt-based workflow creation, predictive recommendations, and autonomous campaign creation.

  • Maintain high standards for responsible AI, establishing guardrails around brand voice consistency, content quality evaluation, and privacy compliance.

3. Build Intelligent Campaign Delivery & Automation Workflows

  • Own execution and scheduling features, including Send Now, Scheduled Send, Timezone-aware Sending, and AI-powered Send Time Optimization.

  • Scale automated Sequences, trigger logic, dynamic branching, smart personalization fields, and event-driven marketing workflows.

  • Streamline campaign creation workflows to minimize operational complexity for marketers while maximizing end-user engagement.

4. Drive Campaign Intelligence & Customer Insights

  • Build reporting dashboards that accurately measure campaign execution, open/click engagement, conversion rates, attributed revenue, and overall ROI.

  • Deliver actionable, AI-powered recommendations that guide users on how to improve campaign engagement and conversion performance.

  • Establish robust product instrumentation, funnels, and experimentation frameworks to measure feature adoption and product-led outcomes.

5. Build Audience & Preference Management

  • Own subscriber preferences, consent management workflows, and end-user preference centers.

  • Deliver flexible preference experiences that increase customer trust and support global messaging compliance (CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR, etc.).

6. Drive Product Strategy & Execution

  • Establish a 12–18 month product roadmap for Email Marketing aligned with HighLevel’s broader product strategy.

  • Conduct continuous customer discovery, competitive analysis, and usability research.

  • Author clear, outcome-focused PRDs and partner closely with Engineering, Product Design, AI, Customer Success, and Go-To-Market teams.

First 90 Days

  • Identify and ship initial usability and performance quick-wins in the core Email Builder and Sequence tools based on user feedback and analytics.

  • Establish clear instrumentation and North Star KPIs around activation, campaign creation velocity, and engagement.

  • Align cross-functional Engineering, Design, AI, and GTM teams on upcoming priorities.

  • Deploy production-ready natural language prompt-to-layout email generation capabilities.

  • Ship Sequence AI, enabling users to generate multi-touch customer journeys using simple prompts.

  • Drive measurable uplift in activation, feature adoption, and campaign success across the HighLevel ecosystem.
