Headquartered in Fairfax, Virginia with offices in Dallas, Texas; and Prague, Czech Republic, with 500+ team members across the world. We have both location-focused and work-from-home jobs.

Overview:

  • Workstyle: This is a remote position; however, to be eligible for hire, candidates must reside in a state where Custom Ink is registered to do business as an employer. Eligible states currently include:
    • AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, ME, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV.

The role involves regular use of standard office equipment, such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, and telephone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.
  • Application Period Disclosure: We are accepting applications for this role for the next 48 hours. We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible for full consideration.

What we’re looking for:

Are you a detail-oriented, data-curious marketer who believes in the power of custom swag? In this role, you’ll be part of our CRM Marketing team to help us deliver engaging, personalized experiences that ignite a sense of belonging and connection for our customers. You'll be a key player in our mission to help people express what brings them together, one custom product at a time.

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in CRM or data-driven marketing, with a focus on email, SMS, or Direct Mail.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms: Email Service Providers (ESPs) and Customer Data Platforms (CDPs): Klaviyo, Hubspot, and Salesforce
  • Understanding of how AI can be leveraged for tasks like content generation, audience segmentation, and predictive analysis.
  • A basic understanding of customer segmentation, personalization, and testing methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to pull reports and analyze data to surface key insights.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, with a proactive, reliable, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Hands-on experience with Canva and a foundational understanding of design principles are a strong plus.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, or a related field is preferred.

Who this role isn't for:

  • The High-Level Strategist: If you prefer designing long-term, overarching marketing strategies rather than getting hands-on with daily email, SMS, and Direct Mail campaign execution, this role won't be a fit.
  • The Data-Averse Creative: While this role supports creative campaigns, it relies heavily on analyzing reports, A/B testing, and maintaining CRM segments. If you prefer to avoid the numbers and data platforms, you'll likely struggle here.
  • The Lone Wolf: You will constantly partner with internal teams like Site and Sales to gather insights and draft creative briefs. If you prefer working completely independently without frequent cross-functional collaboration, this environment might be frustrating.

What you’ll do:

  • Campaign Execution: Create and deploy email, SMS, and Direct Mail campaigns, ensuring they are accurate and consistent with the Custom Ink brand. You will be responsible for setting up campaigns, managing assets, and scheduling sends using our CRM platform.
  • Customer Data Management: Maintain and manage CRM segments and customer profile data to ensure accurate audience targeting and personalized messaging.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Support campaign measurement by pulling reports, gathering and analyzing performance data, and identifying key trends. Your work will contribute to our ongoing efforts to optimize the customer journey.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teams like Site and Sales to help draft creative briefs and provide customer insights, ensuring our marketing initiatives are customer-centric.
  • Testing Agenda: Accurate setup and reporting of A/B and multi-variate test results that inform creative and segmentation strategy.

How you’ll be measured:

  • Increased efficiency, accuracy, and quality of campaign execution.
  • Timely delivery of campaign performance components and reporting.
  • Contributions to improved CRM targeting and segmentation strategies.
  • Cross-functional collaboration that ensures customer-centric thinking is embedded across all marketing initiatives.

How you’ll make a difference:

As a CRM Marketing Coordinator, your meticulous attention to detail and dedication to the customer experience will be at the heart of our marketing efforts. You’ll directly support the execution of campaigns that help customers celebrate milestones, unite teams, and build communities. Your work will ensure that every message we send is timely, relevant, and helps strengthen the connection our customers feel to the Custom Ink brand.

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Pages of Your Handwriting". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.

What you will do

Take a photo of a page of your own handwriting, a shopping list, notes, a diary page, anything you wrote yourself. Messy is better than neat.

Steps

  1. Pick a page with plenty of your handwriting on it

  2. Lay it flat and photograph from directly above

  3. Check the writing is in focus

  4. Upload

What gets rejected

  • No printed or typed pages

  • Nothing private you would not want read

  • Do not shoot at an angle that skews the lines

Accepted: Handwriting fills most of the page; your own hand; a human could read it.

Pay

$0.25 per accepted page. At a typical pace of about 45 seconds per page, that is about $20 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 27 pages pays about $6.75. Up to 50 pages per upload. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).

Where and when

Open worldwide: the task runs in 100+ countries. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.

What you need

  • An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

  • 18 or older

  • Your phone camera, used inside the Kled app

How to start

  1. Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

  2. Create your account and open Tasks.

  3. Search "Pages of Your Handwriting", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

  4. Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

Job Title: IT Specialist

Job Type: (Remote)

Job Summary

The IT Specialist — Systems Administration is responsible for the administration, maintenance, monitoring, security, and troubleshooting of the organization's IT systems and infrastructure. This position ensures that servers, operating systems, applications, user accounts, and related technologies remain secure, reliable, available, and properly maintained.

The IT Specialist works closely with network administrators, cybersecurity teams, help desk personnel, application teams, vendors, and business users to maintain stable IT operations and support technology initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot servers, operating systems, and enterprise IT infrastructure.

  • Administer Windows and Linux server environments.

  • Manage and maintain physical, virtual, and cloud-based systems.

  • Monitor system availability, performance, capacity, and resource utilization.

  • Troubleshoot server, operating system, application, and infrastructure-related issues.

  • Manage user accounts, groups, permissions, and access controls using Active Directory and/or Microsoft Entra ID.

  • Administer Group Policy, organizational units, authentication, and access management.

  • Install and maintain operating system updates, security patches, drivers, and software.

  • Monitor system logs, alerts, and performance metrics to identify potential issues.

  • Manage and maintain virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, or similar technologies.

  • Support cloud infrastructure and services in platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Job Title

Cloud Vendor Management Specialist

India - Remote

Find your future at Revvity

Primary Responsibilities


Vendor Onboarding and Due Diligence

  • Manage new vendor onboarding from initial request through approval, including supplier registration, document exchange, internal coordination, and completion of required procurement workflows.
  • Ensure vendors satisfy company requirements for information security, privacy, legal, financial, insurance, compliance, business continuity, and operational readiness before services are approved or implemented.
  • Coordinate the collection and review of contracts, statements of work, certificates of insurance, security questionnaires, compliance attestations, financial information, data-processing terms, and other required documentation.
  • Maintain accurate vendor profiles, ownership records, risk classifications, documentation, approval status, and renewal dates in applicable procurement and contract-management systems.

Vendor Evaluation and Selection

  • Coordinate vendor evaluations for data center hardware, infrastructure platforms, cloud services, cybersecurity solutions, software, telecommunications, support services, and managed service providers.
  • Develop and apply consistent evaluation criteria covering technical fit, security, compliance, financial stability, service capability, implementation risk, support model, scalability, and total cost of ownership.
  • Support requests for information, requests for proposal, demonstrations, proofs of concept, reference checks, and commercial evaluations.
  • Prepare comparative analyses and recommendations that clearly document vendor strengths, weaknesses, risks, costs, and alignment with business and technology requirements.

Contract Review, Renewal, and Commercial Analysis

  • Manage the vendor renewal calendar and begin renewal planning early enough to support requirements validation, competitive review, budgeting, negotiation, approval, and service continuity.
  • Review contracts, statements of work, order forms, pricing schedules, service-level agreements, licensing terms, support provisions, renewal clauses, termination rights, and commercial commitments in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
  • Compare renewal proposals against prior-year agreements, historical spend, consumption, market benchmarks, alternative vendors, and changes in scope or service levels.
  • Identify unfavorable pricing changes, redundant services, unused licenses, minimum commitments, auto-renewal risk, and contractual terms requiring clarification or negotiation.
  • Prepare concise renewal recommendations, financial impact summaries, negotiation positions, and approval materials for operational and executive stakeholders.

Vendor Relationship and Performance Management

  • Build and maintain effective vendor relationships throughout onboarding, implementation, steady-state operations, renewal, escalation, and offboarding.
  • Plan and lead vendor meetings, operational reviews, service reviews, quarterly business reviews, renewal discussions, and executive-level engagements.
  • Establish agendas, document decisions and action items, assign owners, track commitments, and follow issues through resolution.
  • Maintain vendor scorecards and monitor service-level performance, delivery quality, responsiveness, support effectiveness, risk, and contractual compliance.
  • Coordinate escalations for service failures, unresolved incidents, delayed deliverables, commercial disputes, and other matters that could affect availability, security, cost, or business operations.

FinOps and Financial Optimization

  • Partner with Finance, FinOps, Procurement, and technology owners to improve the financial management of vendor relationships and technology services.
  • Analyze spend, usage, support coverage, license allocation, maintenance costs, commercial commitments, and pricing trends to identify savings and cost-avoidance opportunities.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, accruals, purchase-order planning, and variance analysis for assigned technology vendors and contracts.
  • Develop total cost of ownership, return on investment, unit-cost, and multi-year financial analyses for vendor selections, renewals, migrations, and modernization initiatives.
  • Recommend opportunities to right-size services, consolidate suppliers, eliminate duplication, optimize licensing, renegotiate commitments, improve discount structures, and align cost with actual consumption and business value.

Governance, Reporting, and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as a central point of coordination among vendors and internal technical, procurement, finance, legal, security, compliance, and business teams.
  • Maintain contract repositories, vendor records, renewal schedules, performance reports, meeting documentation, risk items, and decision history.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting for vendor spend, savings, renewals, performance, risk, contract status, and action-item completion.
  • Support audits, third-party risk assessments, compliance reviews, strategic sourcing initiatives, infrastructure modernization programs, and vendor offboarding activities.
  • Participate in local and global cross-functional teams and perform related procurement, vendor management, contract administration, and financial-analysis activities as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, supply chain management, information technology, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in vendor management, vendor procurement, supplier management, contract administration, technology operations, strategic sourcing, or a related discipline.
  • Experience managing vendors that provide data center infrastructure, cloud services, cybersecurity products, enterprise software, telecommunications, hardware maintenance, professional services, or managed services.
  • Demonstrated experience with vendor onboarding, due diligence, document exchange, supplier approvals, contract renewals, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Ability to review commercial contracts, licensing structures, statements of work, service-level commitments, pricing schedules, renewal provisions, and vendor proposals.
  • Experience comparing vendor proposals and renewal pricing against prior-year agreements, historical utilization, existing contracts, market alternatives, and business requirements.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills, including spend analysis, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, total cost of ownership, return on investment, and cost-optimization assessments.
  • Ability to organize and lead vendor meetings involving technical teams, business owners, procurement, finance, legal, and vendor executives.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder-management, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple vendor engagements, deadlines, approvals, renewals, and escalations while maintaining confidentiality and attention to detail.
  • Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets, presentations, reporting tools, databases, and procurement or contract-management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with NetSuite, or a comparable procurement, ERP, vendor-risk, or contract-lifecycle platform.
  • Experience supporting hybrid infrastructure, on-premises data centers, VMware environments, public cloud platforms, cybersecurity operations, or enterprise technology modernization.
  • Knowledge of FinOps principles, software asset management, license optimization, third-party risk management, and technology procurement best practices.
  • Experience developing vendor scorecards, executive business reviews, sourcing recommendations, and multi-year commercial models, having knowledge of any visualization tool like QuickSight would be an added advantage.
  • Relevant certification such as FinOps Certified Practitioner, CPSM, CSCP, PMP, ITIL Foundation, or a comparable procurement, finance, or technology credential.

Description

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for driving the overall planning, management and completion of Operations projects across our organization and its affiliates. The Senior Project Manager is responsible for providing delivery leadership and execution support to multiple shared services teams and game teams across our studios. This role focuses on enabling teams by driving technically complex initiatives—such as platform services, tooling, infrastructure, and cross-studio programs—rather than owning feature delivery within a single game team.

The ideal candidate is technically fluent, comfortable operating across multiple stakeholders, and excels at bringing structure, visibility, and predictability to projects that span teams, disciplines, and time zones. The ideal candidate understands game development pipelines, can speak the language of engineers and technical leads, and brings structure, predictability, and risk management to fast-moving creative environments.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Program Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of complex projects (e.g., service upgrades, tooling, integrations, live ops initiatives).
  • Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and delivery plans across multiple teams and time zones.
  • Drive execution against schedules while balancing quality, technical debt, and production realities.
  • Define standardized project management processes, tools, workflows.
  • Mentor other project managers

Cross-Team Project Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate initiatives that support multiple game teams and shared services teams.
  • Own integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
  • Enable alignment and execution without direct line management authority over delivery teams.

Technical Enablement & Partnership

  • Translate technical strategies and architectural decisions into clear execution plans, timelines, and risks.
  • Ensure teams have visibility into delivery progress, impacts, and adoption timelines.
  • Partner closely with stakeholders to translate designs into executable project plans.
  • Act as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring clarity and alignment.

Process & Delivery Governance

  • Establish and maintain consistent project management practices across shared services initiatives.
  • Facilitate planning, execution, and retrospectives for cross-team efforts with a focus on delivery outcomes.
  • Track progress and delivery metrics, manage dependencies and risks; proactively escalate and resolve blockers.
  • Implement and continuously improve methodologies and processes.

Stakeholder & Communication Management

  • Act as a primary point of coordination between shared services teams and supported game teams.
  • Provide clear, concise status reporting to studio leadership and senior stakeholders.
  • Manage expectations and trade-offs across competing priorities and timelines.
  • Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to studio leadership and stakeholders.
  • Align project priorities with product, publishing, and business objectives.
  • Support go-to-market timelines, certification, and launch readiness.

Risk, Dependency & Change Management

  • Identify, understand, and manage technical, operational, and resourcing risks that may impact teams.
  • Drive mitigation plans and manage changes while minimizing disruption.
  • Support release coordination, rollout planning, and adoption of shared services and tools.
  • Manage change requests while protecting team focus and delivery commitments.
  • Ensure lessons learned are captured and applied.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of senior project or program management experience in technical or software-driven organizations.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; PMP or CSM certification is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing cross-team, shared-services initiatives.
  • Experience with budget planning, ROI analysis
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, infrastructure, and technical delivery models.
  • High degree of initiative, self-starter, looks for opportunities to make improvements
  • Experience working in data analytics a plus
  • Proven ability to influence and coordinate without direct ownership of delivery teams.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with high interdependency.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage deeply with technical teams.
  • Ability to pivot quickly when priorities shift, demonstrating both adaptability and agility.
  • Excellent and effective problem solving and time management skills.
  • Creative, self-driven with a strong work ethic.
  • Administrative knowledge and experience of Jira and Confluence with hands on experience in setting up projects, dashboards, reporting capabilities, and custom JQL filters.
  • Solid Microsoft Excel skills (e.g., functions, formulas, PivotTables, data validation, charts)
  • Game Industry experience and a passion for games especially MMOs
  • Comfortable reviewing technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and release plans.
  • Experience working in a centralized/shared services organization

Be Aware of Fraudulent Recruiting Activities

jobs.description:
Vitamin Angels

Position Description

Position: Brand Strategy & Creative Production Manager

Employer: Vitamin Angels

Department: Marketing & Communications

Location: Remote anywhere in the continental U.S.

Salary Range: $80,000-$95,000

About Vitamin Angels

Vitamin Angels is a global health organization working to save lives and improve the health of women and children most at risk through proven nutrition solutions. We prioritize high-impact, cost-effective, evidence-based nutrition interventions and apply evidence, implementation learning, and innovation to introduce, strengthen, and scale nutrition programs in geographies where we can achieve the greatest and most sustainable impact. Our programs are advanced through long-term partnerships that enable government and local partner ownership, are implemented within existing structures, and adapted to local contexts.

Vitamin Angels is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a supportive environment where all individuals have access to equal opportunities to succeed, regardless of background, identity, or perspective. Our efforts aim to ensure fairness and mutual respect for all employees, promoting a culture of belonging and professional growth.

Role or Purpose of Position

The Brand Strategy and Creative Production Manager is an important brand and creative leadership role, owning the connective tissue between strategy, brand, narrative, content, creative, campaigns, and performance.

The Brand Strategy and Creative Production Manager is responsible for strengthening and advancing Vitamin Angels’ enterprise-wide brand through a clear, compelling, and differentiated brand identity—and translating that narrative into high-quality content, creative, and marketing and communications experiences across audiences and channels. This role serves as a strategic brand leader and creative integrator, connecting organizational strategy to how Vitamin Angels presents itself to the world. The Brand Strategy and Creative Production Manager leads the department-wide editorial strategy, plan, and calendar, working collaboratively with functional leads and stakeholders from across the organization to build an integrated and impactful editorial calendar. Working closely with the VP of Marketing & Communications, marketing operations manager, functional area leads, and key stakeholders across the organization, the Brand Strategy and Creative Production Manager will help the organization define and evolve Vitamin Angels’ enterprise brand, positioning, messaging tools, visual identity, voice, and creative standards.

The Brand Strategy and Creative Production Manager will oversee all creative contractors and partner closely with other functional areas within Marketing and Communications, includingDigital Marketing, Communications, and Operations as well as functions outside the department including Development and Information Technology, to deliver socialize and govern integrated, omnichannel materials that build awareness, deepen engagement, mobilize resources, and advance Vitamin Angels’ mission. The role will lead the strategy, development, production, and governance of enterprise-level content and creative production, ensuring that materials are compelling, consistent, audience-centered, strategic, and aligned with organizational and functional unit priorities.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Enterprise Narrative

  • Lead the development and ongoing evolution of Vitamin Angels’ brand in partnership with the VP of Marketing & Communications, various MarCom functions, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Develop systems and tools that establish, articulate and govern the brand. Allowing a diverse set of stakeholders from inside and outside the organization to clearly articulate who Vitamin Angels is, why its work matters, the change it seeks to create, how it works, and the distinctive value it brings to global health and nutrition.
  • Translate organizational strategy and priorities into a compelling brand platform that can be consistently understood and expressed across audiences, channels, and markets.
  • Establish and evolve Vitamin Angels’ identity: voice, tone, visual identity, tagline, logo usage, messaging tools, and other core elements of the brand.
  • Work with Communications unit to establish messaging architecture that provides a clear framework for communicating with diverse audiences, including donors, foundations, corporate partners, technical audiences, policymakers, employees, and the public. While this role will work with others (Communications, Sr. leadership, contract writers, etc.) towrite the messaging, the role is responsible for identifying, project managing, socializing, and governing the messaging tools necessary to ensure our diverse set of stakeholders have what they need to effectively communicate about the organization.
  • Manage Intellectual Property and work with VP, Marketing and Communications and legal to protect and maintain the organizations visual and owned identity.
  • Ensure the brand is differentiated, relevant, credible, emotionally resonant, and consistently connected to evidence and organizational impact.
  • Serve as a strategic brand advisor to, help stakeholders translate organizational priorities into effective communications.

Brand Systems, Tools, & Governance

  • Develop, maintain, and govern enterprise-wide brand tools that enable consistent and effective expression of the Vitamin Angels brand.
  • Oversee organizational presentations, corporate overviews, key messages, talking points, templates, campaign toolkits, brand guidance, and other core communications materials.
  • Establish clear processes for brand governance, review, approval, and quality control across the organization.
  • Build internal understanding, adoption, and advocacy of the brand through training, guidance, presentations, and ongoing socialization.
  • Partner with teams across Vitamin Angels to ensure brand standards are practical, accessible, and consistently applied.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen brand integration across organizational touchpoints and stakeholder experiences.

Content & Creative Strategy

  • Lead enterprise content and creative strategy, ensuring that content and creative work are grounded in the enterprise narrative, brand strategy, audience insights, and organizational priorities.
  • Oversee the development of compelling stories, campaigns, visual assets, video, presentations, digital content, and other creative expressions of the brand.
  • Establish editorial standards, creative principles, channel roles, content calendars, workflows, and production processes that support high-quality and efficient execution.
  • Work with functional units (Communications and Digital Marketing) to ensure content is tailored appropriately to different audience needs while maintaining a consistent and recognizable Vitamin Angels brand.
  • Partner with Digital Marketing and Communications functions to develop integrated, end-to-end creative campaigns across paid, owned, earned, and shared channels.
  • Translate complex global health and nutrition issues into clear, accessible, compelling narratives for mass audiences, foundations, corporate partners, technical audiences, and other stakeholders.
  • Balance strategic storytelling with evidence-based communications, ensuring that creative work is both emotionally engaging and technically credible.

Creative Production & Agency Management

  • Lead the creative production process from strategic brief through concept development, production, review, delivery, and evaluation.
  • Establish creative briefs and production standards that clarify objectives, audiences, messages, deliverables, timelines, budgets, and measures of success.
  • Oversee external creative agencies, freelancers, photographers, videographers, designers, and other production partners as needed.
  • Work with Digital Marketing and Communications and across the organization to ensure external partners understand and appropriately apply Vitamin Angels’ brand strategy, narrative, and creative standards.
  • Manage production priorities, resources, timelines, budgets, and competing organizational needs.
  • Build scalable production processes that enable the organization to produce high-quality work efficiently, quickly, and consistently.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage existing content and creative assets—including photography, video, and other B-roll/A-roll—to maximize value and extend the life of investments.
  • Manage asset collection process and standards, ensuring raw creative assets (photography, videography) are collected with both high ethical standards and efficiency.
  • Develop and uphold processes for informed consent, working with Marketing Operations and legal team to ensure raw assets are consented for broad use across marketing and donor applications. Omnichannel Campaign Development
  • Work collaboratively with Digital Marketing and Communications to create integrated campaigns that move audiences from awareness to engagement and action.
  • Oversee the development of core multi-channel multi-audience campaigns.
  • Develop creative platforms and campaign concepts that can be adapted across digital, social, video, email, presentations, events, fundraising, partnership, and other channels.
  • Ensure campaign content is designed for the specific behaviors, motivations, and information needs of different audiences.
  • Create cohesive campaign experiences that strengthen brand recognition while supporting specific objectives such as donor acquisition, fundraising, partnership development, advocacy, awareness, and engagement.
  • Help establish repeatable campaign frameworks that enable Vitamin Angels to move efficiently from strategy to concept to production to activation.

Editorial Strategy & Content Planning

  • Own and manage the department-wide editorial calendar, aligning content priorities, campaigns, organizational moments, fundraising activities, partner activations, and key external opportunities.
  • Work with other functional units (Digital Marketing and Communications) to solicit input to the department-wide editorial calendar to ensure integrated and impactful marketing across all owned and earned platforms.
  • Establish processes that improve coordination, visibility, prioritization, and timely delivery of marketing and communications activities across teams.
  • Ensure editorial planning is informed by audience needs, organizational priorities, campaign objectives, and available channels.
  • Evaluate channel effectiveness and determine the right mix of paid, earned, owned, partner, and experiential opportunities for each campaign.
  • Ensure offline and online experiences are strategically integrated and consistently reflect Vitamin Angels’ brand and messaging.

Analytics, Testing, & Performance Management

  • Contribute to department-wide analytics program (owned by Director of Digital Marketing) building and contributing marketing analytics that provide actionable insights into campaign, channel, audience, and partnership performance.
  • Translate data and analytics into clear recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness, audience engagement, fundraising outcomes, and return on investment.
  • Regularly communicate campaign performance, insights, and recommendations to Marketing & Communications team, senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Level of Decision-Making

Within the bounds of Vitamin Angels’ mission, values and policies, and sound professional practices, the Brand Strategy and Creative Production Manager has the discretion to use independent judgment to make decisions of significant consequence that affect Vitamin Angels’ clients, partners, and employees.

Organizational Relationships

Vitamin Angels operates under a collaborative, matrix management model. The Brand Strategy and Creative Production Manager establishes their own daily work priorities and ensures that all responsibilities are conducted consistent with accepted best practices, sound professional judgment and within established schedule and budget.

Reports to:

VP, Marketing & Communications

Supervises:

  • No direct reports. Manages internal and external creative resources including consultants (graphic design, videography, writing)

Primary working relationships:

  • Functional unit leads (digital marketing and communications)

· Marketing Operations Manager

  • Contacts from departments across the organization (Development, Programs, IT, Finance)

Travel required:

International and domestic, as needed.

Qualifications and Skills (Required and Preferred)

Required:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in brand strategy, integrated marketing, creative development, communications, advertising, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and evolving an enterprise or organizational brand, including narrative, positioning, messaging, visual identity, and brand standards.
  • Experience communicating with philanthropic, corporate, foundation,scientific, and mass-market audiences.
  • Proven ability to translate complex organizational strategies or ideas into clear, compelling narratives and creative platforms.
  • Significant experience leading integrated, omnichannel campaigns across multiple audiences and channels.
  • Experience managing creative production, agencies, vendors, budgets, timelines, and complex workflows.
  • Experience with the Adobe creative suite and fluency in visual design.
  • Strong understanding of digital, social, video, content, and emerging marketing channels.
  • Experience using analytics, audience insights, testing, and performance data to inform creative and marketing decisions.
  • Excellent strategic, creative, editorial, direction and project-management skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives, technical experts, creative professionals, and external partners.
  • Strong interpersonal and influencing skills and the ability to build alignment across a complex organization.
  • Experience working in a nonprofit, global health, international development, public health, or mission-driven environment is highly desirable.

Preferred:

  • Experience working in a global setting.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to manage stress, including but not limited to, stress resulting from local and foreign travel, large crowds, open spaces, shared office space, and daily activities with reasonable accommodations.
  • Ability to remain seated and/or stationary for extended periods of time, including but not limited to prolonged air travel, and general job assignments performed at a desk.

BENEFITS: Comprehensive benefit package includes Medical, Dental and Vision Care, Life Insurance, Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Wellness Reimbursement, 401(k), Paid Time Off, Winter/Summer Recharge Weeks, Holidays, paid parental leave and more.

What you will do

Photograph a table with at least ten things on it, then count them and tell us the exact number.

Steps

  1. Find or make a surface with at least ten separate objects on it

  3. Count the objects carefully

  4. Enter the exact number and submit

Accepted: At least ten separately countable objects visible; user-stated count matches on review.

Summary:

The Civil Engineer (Structural Specialty) serves as the senior structural engineering authority responsible for the planning, design, review, and construction oversight of new Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP) facilities. This position provides technical expertise in structural systems, building integrity, foundation coordination, and overall facility design to ensure compliance with applicable building codes, engineering standards, security requirements, and life-cycle performance objectives.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee structural engineering design and construction activities for new correctional facilities.
  • Review structural engineering documents prepared by consultant A/E firms for completeness, constructability, code compliance, and engineering adequacy.
  • Evaluate structural framing systems, building envelopes, foundations, retaining structures, and other structural components for safety, durability, and long-term performance.
  • Coordinate structural design with civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, architectural, and security disciplines.
  • Provide technical recommendations regarding structural systems, materials, seismic considerations, wind loading, and foundation integration.
  • Serve as the technical authority for resolving complex structural engineering issues affecting facility safety, construction, and operational performance.
  • Develop engineering policies, technical standards, design criteria, and structural guidelines supporting FBOP construction programs.
  • Participate in Value Engineering (VE) workshops to improve constructability, reduce life-cycle costs, and optimize structural system performance.
  • Review contractor requests for information (RFIs), change orders, claims, and contract modifications involving structural work and recommend appropriate action.
  • Conduct technical evaluations of proposed project sites to identify structural design considerations and potential construction constraints.
  • Participate in site inspections and construction observations to verify compliance with approved structural designs and engineering standards.
  • Assist in developing construction cost estimates and evaluating structural construction costs.
  • Participate on technical evaluation panels for Architect/Engineer and Construction Management procurements.
  • Provide engineering support during contract negotiations, construction administration, and dispute resolution.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining engineering documentation, standards, technical files, and project records.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Knowledge and mastery of advanced principles and practices of civil engineering and the related architectural and other engineering disciplines (structural, mechanical and electrical) and of construction methods and techniques that enables the employee to guide and lead the development and maintenance of technical civil engineering guidelines, standards and design criteria to support the overall program for development of complex institutional projects with a wide range of building types and construction methods, numerous participants, complex social and environmental issues, and involving unusual and difficult problems.
  • Extensive knowledge of planning and engineering issues to the extent the employee can make design decisions related to these areas.
  • Willingness to work with others as part of a team.
  • Knowledge of site and building materials, site and building utility systems, and construction and installation techniques and of methods specifying their selection and use.
  • Knowledge and skill in the reading and interpretation of construction documents, architectural and engineering drawings and technical specifications, and construction projects estimates.
  • Knowledge of Federal and agency regulations and the policies related to environmental concerns and the preparation of environmental impact statements and including those related to wetlands, endangered species, historical and archaeological preservation, and hazardous or toxic materials.
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with the application of building codes and fire and life safety codes to the design of buildings.
  • Skill in drawing and technical drafting (computer aided drafting and freehand) in the production of working drawings and technical specifications.
  • Skill in written and verbal communication and in organizing reports and correspondence.
  • Skill in meeting with others and eliciting information.
  • Skill in organizing and conducting conferences, meetings and contract negotiations.
  • Knowledge and analytical skills to prepare analyses and recommendations related to planning and operational issues and to complex engineering issues.
  • Skill in working with computers, including word processing, project management and scheduling programs; and skill in developing and analyzing complex integrated spreadsheets.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must have either an RA or PE certification.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible structural engineering experience involving commercial, institutional, industrial, or federal facilities.
  • Experience reviewing structural engineering designs prepared by outside engineering firms.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain DOJ/BOP suitability and facility access.
  • Work Environment and Travel:
    • Primarily remote work. Occasional travel may be required to DOJ/BOP sites and/or meetings.
    • May require participation in virtual design reviews and time-sensitive technical comment cycles.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Value Engineering methodologies.
  • Experience with multidisciplinary design review.
  • Familiarity with sustainable design principles and life-cycle cost analysis.

Pay and Benefits

The annual salary range for this position is $100,000 to $170,000.

As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is the only hybrid data and AI platform company that large organizations trust to bring AI to their data anywhere it lives. As the pioneer in big data, Cloudera delivers a consistent hybrid cloud experience that converges public clouds, on-prem data centers, and the edge. Cloudera empowers the world's largest enterprises to operationalize:

  • Cloud Anywhere: Experience a consistent cloud environment from the data center to the edge while retaining full architectural freedom and control.
  • Data Anywhere: Unify 100% of data with an Open Data Lakehouse to deliver AI-ready insights, regardless of where the data resides.
  • AI Anywhere: Fast-track Enterprise and Private AI innovation by bringing compute to governed data, ensuring secure and sovereign AI deployments.

Cloudera seeks a collaborative, self-motivated, and business-savvy Contracts Manager to join Cloudera’s legal team to support our United States sales organization. We have a highly cohesive and well-respected legal team and would look forward to you joining us.


This role is responsible for providing expertise and support for contracts of all types, with a focus on direct customer sales generated in the United States. You will be responsible for reviewing, drafting, and negotiating a broad range of commercial contracts, including enterprise subscription and services agreements, non-disclosure agreements, complex order forms, and statements of work. You will also be able to participate in legal and cross-functional projects that seek to improve our processes and procedures. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted advisor to internal clients.


As a Contracts Manager you will:

  • Negotiation & Expertise: Work closely with cross-functional teams and customers to provide contracting expertise to negotiate requisite agreements for new and follow-on business.
  • Policy Compliance: Ensure all agreements comply with company policies and global legal standards with respect to hybrid deployment anywhere cloud software, data privacy, and commercial licensing requirements.
  • Risk & Advisory: Prepare contract paperwork, advise management and internal stakeholders of contractual rights and obligations, and mitigate contractual risks.
  • Strategic Judgment: Balance competing priorities of constituencies as compared to business needs and use astute judgment as to when to escalate.
  • Data Management: Compile and analyze contract-related data while maintaining accurate historical contract information.
  • Trusted Advisor: Build rapport with internal clients (including the sales, deal desk, and revenue teams) and leverage these relationships to facilitate closing sales contracts efficiently while minimizing risk.

We're excited about you if you have:

  • A minimum of 5+ years of experience negotiating sell-side business technology and digital data contracts, preferably enterprise software contracts.
  • Strong knowledge of legal issues affecting software companies, such as data privacy, intellectual property protection, cloud computing, software development, and revenue recognition.
    • Expertise in artificial intelligence, commercial transactions, and complex technology negotiations.
  • Requires excellent drafting, analytical, and negotiation skills.
    • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
    • Superior communication and internal/external customer service skills.
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment while working both independently and collaboratively.
    • Must be comfortable and confident in dealing directly with customers, sales teams, and all levels of management.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Responsibilities

The Manager, IAM Engineering is responsible for leading and managing the Identity and Access Management engineering function, with accountability for setting technical direction, priorities, and standards for enterprise identity platforms. This role provides oversight for the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and related IAM technologies, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with the organization’s security architecture and business objectives. This position leads and develops IAM engineers, establishes engineering practices and delivery expectations, and ensures effective execution of IAM initiatives. The Manager, IAM Engineering serves as the primary point of accountability for identity platform engineering outcomes, while collaborating closely with IAM Provisioning, Security Architecture, Security Operations, Infrastructure, and application teams to deliver reliable identity services and drive continuous improvement across the IAM program.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership, Performance & Development-Leads, develops, and evaluates the IAM engineering team, including staffing, performance management, skill development, and workload prioritization to ensure consistent delivery and long‑term capability growth.

  • Engineering Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement-Oversees planning and execution of IAM engineering initiatives, partnering with Security Operations, GRC, Infrastructure, and application teams to deliver secure, scalable identity solutions that meet business needs.

  • Risk, Compliance & Control Enablement-Ensures IAM engineering practices support regulatory, audit, and risk management requirements by coordinating with Governance, Risk & Compliance teams and maintaining accountability for identity control effectiveness.

  • Continuous Improvement & Operational Readiness-Drives continuous improvement of IAM platforms and processes through modernization, automation, and operational alignment, ensuring solutions are reliable, supportable, and positioned for future needs.

  • IAM Engineering Strategy, Direction & Ownership-Provides leadership and accountability for the IAM engineering function, setting technical direction, priorities, and standards for identity platforms including Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory to ensure alignment with enterprise security objectives.

**This position offers a fully remote work opportunity. Employees in this role must reside in one of the following states to be considered for fully remote positions: Kentucky, Indiana, Missouri, Ohio, Tennessee, Alabama, Virginia, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina**


Qualifications

Required:

  • Three years experience leading IAM or directory services engineering in a large enterprise environment.
  • Deep technical expertise in Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Experience designing and implementing IAM integrations, provisioning workflows, and access controls.
  • Proven ability to lead and mentor technical engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of identity security principles and enterprise authentication models.

Desired:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or Information Systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or Management with significant, demonstrated experience in identity and access management engineering may be considered.
  • Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, CISM, CCSP, CISSP

About Us

Prometeo Talent is a recruitment agency with a strong presence across the Americas and Europe. We specialize in connecting companies with exceptional professionals across data, analytics, and business functions.

We have partnered with a U.S.-based company specialized in marketing effectiveness measurement. They help organizations better understand consumer behavior, purchasing trends, brand performance, and market dynamics through data-driven insights.

We are looking for a Data Analyst (Machine Learning) to join our client's global team.

This role is ideal for analytical and data-driven professionals who enjoy working with large-scale consumer and retail datasets, bridging the gap between complex database structures and business strategy, and turning raw transactional or behavioral data into clear, actionable metrics.

The ideal candidate combines solid SQL and Python skills, a strong "numbers sense", attention to detail, and the ability to translate technical results into clear summaries for stakeholders in English. The position is open to a range of experience levels, from recent graduates with a strong quantitative background to mid-level analysts looking to deepen their technical data manipulation skills.

What You Will Do

  • Write, optimize, and execute SQL queries to extract data from relational databases and cloud data warehouses.

  • Develop, run, and validate machine learning, predictive, or statistical matching models to uncover deeper consumer behaviors and forecast trends.

  • Slice, unpivot, and aggregate raw transactional or panel data to calculate core business metrics such as household penetration, market share, and purchasing trends.

  • Build and maintain clean, structured data tables and views that feed into recurring tracking reports and stakeholder dashboards.

  • Review query outputs, perform data audits, and double-check logic to ensure accuracy and data integrity before insights are finalized.

  • Use conditional logic and filtering techniques to segment data and isolate specific tracking cohorts.

  • Clean, parse, and categorize unstructured or semi-structured text data.

Intellectual Property & Contracts Paralegal


The IP & Contracts Paralegal is an integral member of the Legal Team who assists in-house counsel with special and non-standard contracting matters, escalated contracting projects, and complex Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs), while managing and safeguarding the Company’s proprietary technology and brand portfolio. This role reports to the General Counsel, with dotted-line collaboration with the Products Counsel and Commercial Counsel and provides project-based contracting support and intellectual-property protection in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.


The impact you'll have:

  • Trademark & Brand Protection: Coordinates trademark, copyright, and domain-name registrations and renewals for product and sub-brand names; supports with preliminary clearance searches; maintains evidence-of-use tracking; supports misuse and infringement investigations, including intellectual-property takedown requests
  • Patent & IP Docketing: Runs the intellectual-property docket/calendar, monitoring statutory deadlines for patents and trademarks, and coordinates directly with outside counsel on filings and strategy
  • Copyright & Licensing Records: Maintains copyright registrations and licensing records for Company content, including third-party licensed content
  • Product & Feature Review Support: Supports the Products Counsel on product lifecycle review, feature reviews, product requirement document review, marketing reviews, and legacy-product matters, flagging issues and coordinating input from Product, Marketing, and Engineering stakeholders
  • Terms of Use & Product Policies: Assists with drafting, reviewing, and maintaining Terms of Use, End User License Agreements (EULAs), Acceptable Use Policies (AUPs), and in-product disclosures
  • Company Education & Training: Develops and delivers product, content and IP related trainings to internal stakeholders; creates resources
  • Accessibility Tracking: Supports legal-based accessibility work, including tracking of accessibility-related regulations and risks and compiling reports on contract data related to accessibility
  • Special Contracting Matters & MOUs: Reviews and updates existing contract templates to reflect current law, company policy, and attorney guidance; Assists with special and non-standard contracting matters, including complex Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) and escalated questions related to Special Use MOUs, and maintains related process documentation, escalating novel issues to the Products Counsel or Commercial Counsel as appropriate
  • Contracting Project & Escalation Support: Provides project-based support on contracting initiatives and escalated agreement questions referred by the Products Counsel, Commercial Counsel, or other in-house counsel — including SaaS, MSA, vendor, NDA, licensing/permissions, and evaluation-agreement matters that require additional research, drafting assistance, or cross-functional coordination beyond day-to-day contract administration
  • EdTech Regulatory Compliance: Reviews special contracting matters and product agreements for compliance with applicable data-privacy and ed-tech regulations (e.g., FERPA, COPPA, GDPR), flagging issues for attorney review
  • Research & Release Support: Assist with drafting, reviewing, and managing research agreements with universities and academic institutions. Supports the UXR and Research Recruitment teams with review of user research and efficacy research documentation, and assists with drafting and reviewing releases, including image releases
  • CLM & Contracting-Workflow Support: Supports maintenance and improvement of the Company’s Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) system (Ironclad) as it relates to special contracting workflows, including approval routing, workflow automation, and electronic-signature processes
  • Risk Register & Training: Supports maintenance of the product/content/IP risk register and helps develop and deliver product-, content-, and IP-related trainings
  • Other duties as reasonably assigned, including support on legal escalations related to i-Ready and other product apps and domains, review of public records requests, etc.


Who we're looking for:

  • Contract Competency — Strong understanding of standard SaaS/commercial contract terms and clauses, including uptime SLAs, data processing agreements(DPAs), liability caps, and indemnification
  • Legal Technology Proficiency — Hands-on experience with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) systems – Ironclad preferred; e-signature tools, Legal AI tools, and IP docketing applications
  • IP & Brand Protection Knowledge — Working familiarity with trademark, copyright, and patent processes, including filings, renewals, and enforcement support
  • Regulatory Awareness — Working knowledge of data-privacy and ed-tech regulatory frameworks (FERPA, COPPA, GDPR) as applied to special contracting matters and product agreements
  • Analytical & Drafting Skills — Ability to review, draft, and redline agreements accurately and with attention to detail
  • Communication & Collaboration — Ability to interact professionally with internal stakeholders (Product, Marketing, Engineering, UXR) and external parties, including outside counsel
  • Organization & Judgment — Ability to manage a high volume of special matters independently, exercise sound judgment on when to escalate, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Confidentiality — Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive and proprietary information with discretion
  • Proficient in MS Office applications and standard legal-operations tools. Experience generating reports from IP docketing and contract management systems


Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or an ABA-approved paralegal certificate
  • 3 to 6 years of paralegal experience, including at least 2 years directly in-house at a technology or software company

jobs.title: Director of Engineering -  MetaDefender Email Security
jobs.excerpt: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance.
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

Director of Engineering — MetaDefender Email Security

Reports to: VP, Products

Protecting the World’s Critical Infrastructure

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage they need to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Trusted by more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide — including many of the world’s largest governments, utilities, financial institutions, and defense contractors — OPSWAT protects the systems that keep society running.

The Product: MetaDefender Email Security

MetaDefender Email Security is OPSWAT’s email threat prevention portfolio, trusted by governments and critical infrastructure operators to stop file-borne and email-borne threats before they reach the inbox. It comprises two complementary products designed for different environments and customer profiles — MetaDefender Email Gateway Security, deployed on-premises in front of existing mail servers, and MetaDefender Cloud Email Security, which augments Microsoft 365 — each embedding OPSWAT’s threat prevention technology, including Deep CDR, Metascan Multiscanning, Proactive DLP, and Predictive Alin AI, directly into the mail flow.

This role owns the engineering for the products across both deployment models — the on-premises gateway and the cloud-native Microsoft 365 service — each with its own security, assurance, and operational demands, and all built to scale.

About This Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering who leads from the front. This is a hands-on, technically-centric leadership role — not a pure people-management position — with full accountability for the engineering of the MetaDefender Email Security: architecture, delivery, quality, and the teams that build it. You will lead engineering across multiple deployment form factors — from air-gapped high security environments to native-cloud deployments — operating with the rigor of a principal engineer and the clarity of an executive.

You are an AI-native engineering leader. You have personally orchestrated fleets of AI agents to architect, build, test, and ship production systems, and you have launched and released real products through a full AI-powered software development lifecycle (SDLC) — from specification and code generation to automated testing, review, and deployment. Product Management defines what to ship; you define how to build it. You own the end-to-end delivery of the roadmap Product Management sets, hold the delivery bar, and build a high-performance culture the rest of OPSWAT’s engineering portfolio will look to as a model for AI-native development. You report to the VP, Products and lead a distributed team across Romania and Hungary, while the role itself can be based anywhere — with a preference for the UK, USA, or near an OPSWAT-operated location.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead as an AI-first effort: make AI agents a first-class part of how the team works — orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and run reviews — while ensuring humans own and validate every line that ships. Treat automation and intelligence as the default, not the exception.
  • Stay hands-on: remain directly in the codebase — setting architecture patterns, writing and reviewing critical code, prototyping, and unblocking hard technical problems. You lead by doing, not only by delegating.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of the roadmap: take full ownership of delivering the product roadmap set by Product Management — turning the “what to ship” into the “how to build,” and owning execution sequencing, technical risk, quality, security, and release across every deployment form factor.
  • Set technical direction (the “how”): drive the architecture and technology choices that underpin a product serving high-assurance environments at scale. Hold a strong engineering point of view and be willing to defend it.
  • Build and lead a high-performance team: recruit, develop, and retain top engineers and their leads across Romania and Hungary; create clear career paths and norms for code quality and review; and build a culture where strong engineers want to stay and grow.
  • Drive performance-based management: set clear, measurable expectations and run a rigorous, fair performance culture — recognizing and accelerating top performers, raising the bar continuously, and addressing underperformance decisively by coaching where there is a path and upgrading or exiting the role where there is not.
  • Hold a security-first quality bar: champion code review with a security lens for both human-written and AI-generated code, catching injection risks, insecure defaults, missing validation, and privilege-escalation vectors in file-handling and authentication paths before they ship.
  • Raise engineering velocity: continuously improve how the team works — CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development workflows, incident response, and operational maturity — so the team ships faster and more reliably over time.
  • Codify AI-native practices for the portfolio: establish the playbooks, AI context files, coding harnesses, test frameworks, and review norms developed on this product so other OPSWAT product teams can adopt them.
  • Partner cross-functionally: work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP, Products, plus Product Management, Design, and security leaders — turning the product roadmap (the what) into engineering execution (the how), committing to scope and timelines, and pushing back clearly when trade-offs require it.

What We Need From You

  • Full agentic development experience (required): You have personally run a full agentic, AI-powered SDLC end-to-end — and have done so in B2B and high-security enterprise environments where compliance, data sensitivity, and assurance requirements are non-negotiable. You can show real work (PRs, commit history, shipped products, or a portfolio) where agentic workflows drove delivery — not slideware about AI.
  • A product launched via a full AI-powered SDLC: demonstrable experience taking a product from spec to release using an end-to-end AI-assisted lifecycle (spec generation, code/test generation, automated verification, AI-assisted review, and CI/CD), with you accountable for the outcome.
  • Proven engineering leadership: 8+ years of software engineering experience and 3+ years leading engineering teams (including managing managers/leads) through complex product delivery at scale. You can point to the decisions you made and why.
  • Performance-based leadership: a track record of building high-performing teams through rigorous, fair performance management — promoting excellence, making timely talent decisions, and reducing or replacing low performers when needed.
  • Deep technical excellence: strong, current software engineering fundamentals — solid command of design patterns, SOLID principles, and modern architecture. You can evaluate AI-assisted code with the same rigor as human-authored code. AI tools amplify strong fundamentals; they do not replace them.
  • Scalable systems experience: a proven history building scalable, distributed solutions — including relational/document databases, cloud-native services, and modern CI/CD systems.
  • Quality and test discipline: a high bar for tested, maintainable code; you use AI to accelerate test scaffolding, then validate that coverage is real and meaningful.
  • Distributed-team leadership: demonstrated ability to lead and align engineers across countries and time zones, building trust, clarity, and accountability in a remote/hybrid, multi-country setup.
  • Talent magnet and clear communicator: you identify strong engineers, make a compelling case for why they should join, and create an environment where they do their best work — and you communicate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without oversimplifying.
  • Security-conscious by default: operating in critical infrastructure markets means security is never an afterthought; you hold the team to a security-first bar on design, code review, and incident response.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

  • Domain familiarity: understanding of email as a communication channel and the underlying technology and protocols. Appreciation of the different deployment methods for email security and their characteristics.
  • Cloud services familiarity: experience of integrating products with M365 and/or Google Workspace and their associated API ecosystems
  • .NET / C# ecosystem: hands-on or managerial experience with .NET Core / C# — enough to evaluate architectural decisions, review PRs credibly, and hire well for the stack.
  • Cloud-native and containers: experience leading the design or operation of cloud-native SaaS platforms — Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/Azure/GCP — including using AI agents to script infrastructure and deployment automation.
  • AI context-file authoring: experience writing AI context files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or equivalent) that encode architecture decisions and forbidden patterns for consistent, safe AI output across a team.
  • AI in CI/CD pipelines: familiarity running AI agents inside pipelines — auto-fixing lint, generating missing tests, or running safe migrations as pipeline steps — not as experiments, but as how the team actually works.
  • International team experience: a track record of building and maintaining engineering culture and delivery quality across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Async and high-throughput systems: experience validating concurrency and thread-safety in high-throughput services.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Lead a product trusted by critical infrastructure customers across air-gapped, cross-domain, internet-connected, and native-cloud deployments — the architecture and culture decisions you make now will shape it for years.
  • Influence beyond this product: the AI-native patterns you establish will propagate across OPSWAT’s engineering portfolio.
  • Work from anywhere — a worldwide, remote-friendly role with a preference for the UK, USA, or a location near an OPSWAT-operated country.
  • Stable, growing international company with an exceptional customer base across 50+ countries.
  • A mandate to build AI-native engineering practices — and the latitude to do it your way.
  • Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.

jobs.description:
Senior Fiserv DNA Developer / Integration Consultant

Independent Contractor | Remote within Canada

About the opportunity

Aequilibrium seeks experienced Canadian-based developers and integration consultants to support upcoming credit-union and financial-services opportunities involving Fiserv DNA.

We are looking for professionals who have personally developed, integrated, tested or supported solutions connected to the DNA core banking platform. You will help financial institutions connect their core banking capabilities with digital banking platforms, lending systems, CRM, payments and other third-party services.

What you will do

Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Design, develop and support integrations between Fiserv DNA and third-party applications.

  • Work with DNA APIs and integration interfaces, including DNAconnect, DNA Core API transactions and/or Communicator Open, as applicable to the institution’s environment.

  • Translate banking requirements into technical designs, interface specifications and data mappings.

  • Implement reliable handling of authentication, authorization, validation, errors, retries, duplicate requests and transaction reconciliation.

  • Develop or enhance DNAapps using DNAcreator where required and supported by your experience.

  • Create automated integration tests and support end-to-end testing, regression testing and business acceptance.

  • Diagnose integration issues across DNA, middleware and connected systems, working with client teams and vendors.

  • Support releases, upgrades, production readiness and technical handover.

  • Document dependencies, platform constraints and operational support procedures.

What you bring

Required

  • Demonstrable, hands-on development or integration experience with Fiserv DNA.

  • Direct experience using DNA APIs or integration interfaces, with the ability to explain the specific products, transactions and tools used.

  • Experience delivering or supporting at least one DNA-related solution in a production financial-services environment.

  • Strong software development skills in the languages and frameworks used in your DNA engagements; please identify your stack.

  • Experience with API integration, structured data formats, database queries and troubleshooting across connected systems.

  • Understanding of banking concepts such as members/customers, accounts, deposits, lending, balances and transactions.

  • Experience building secure, reliable integrations involving sensitive financial information.

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA teams and vendor specialists.

  • Based in Canada and able to provide services as an independent contractor.

An asset

  • Experience supporting Canadian credit unions.

  • DNAcreator, DNAapps or Fiserv AppMarket development and validation experience.

  • Experience with multiple DNA versions, upgrades or core banking conversions.

  • Integration experience involving digital banking, loan origination, CRM, payments or reporting platforms.

  • C#/.NET, SQL, Oracle/PLSQL, middleware, cloud platforms or CI/CD experience relevant to your previous DNA work.

  • Previous delivery experience with Fiserv, a credit union, a core banking service provider or a systems integrator.

What success looks like

You can independently assess a DNA integration requirement, identify the relevant interfaces and dependencies, and deliver a secure, tested and supportable solution. You explain platform limitations clearly and work effectively across the financial institution, Fiserv and other technology partners.

How to express interest

Please submit your résumé online, and include the following in your cover letter:

  1. DNA experience: Years of hands-on experience, most recent use and DNA versions worked with, where known.

  2. APIs and tools: Specific DNA interfaces, APIs, SDKs and development tools you have used.

  3. Project examples: One or two examples describing the business requirement, connected systems, your personal responsibilities and the production outcome.

  4. Technical stack: Languages, databases, integration platforms and testing tools used.

  5. Availability: Location/time zone, earliest start date, weekly capacity and expected hourly contract rate in CAD.

Anonymized project examples are welcome. Please do not submit confidential client information, proprietary code or restricted vendor documentation.

About Aequilibrium

Aequilibrium is a Canadian technology consulting company helping organizations enrich people’s lives by crafting remarkable experiences. We combine strategy, architecture, experience design, and engineering to help financial institutions modernize their services and deliver better member experiences.

We welcome qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds and provide accommodations throughout the selection process.

Software Quality & Testing
