Fluent German is required for this role. Our customers are property management companies in Germany.

We're looking for Senior Developers for our fully remote team to work on our agents. You'll be responsible for how well our agents work for customers: you talk to the property managers who use them, see where they go wrong and make them better.

About Us

is an all-in-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI-Agents. We want to automate as much of a property manager's daily work as we can.

About the role

Our platform has been an agentic platform since day one. Before we even planned the UI, we planned the way agents would interact with the software. Our goal is to automate as much of the work in property management as possible.

As of now, almost everything the user can do in the UI, we have an agent tool for it and the Co-Pilot (daily assistant of the user) can do everything for them, even toggling dark mode on and off.

But the Co-Pilot is just the beginning. The real challenge is the autonomous agents. More on that below.

What you’ll be working on

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonomous Agents triggered whenever something new happens inside a ticket. The customer can train them on their own OR rather use one of the templates you will build for them. These agents already have the capabilities to fully own entire complex scenarios and are one of the main reasons customers are interested in our software. But when should the agent escalate to a human rather than finishing on its own? How can we make sure it sticks to the process? Those are your questions, and you answer them together with the customers who use these agents every day.

  • Harness Engineering: The agent has 100+ tools. But it has to read a request the way a property manager would, not the way the words sound elsewhere. What goes into the system prompt, what into skills?

  • Knowledge base: Our platform includes its own knowledge base, similar to Notion. It’s fully custom built and supposed to act as the companys collective brain. But should the AI also “learn” by itself? And if yes, when? And how can we improve the way our AI searches the knowledge base — through better tools, system prompts, or skills? When a customer asks us something in support, the answer should end up in the knowledge base so the agent can handle it next time.

  • Voice-agents: The same agents, but on the phone — built on LiveKit, handling calls the way our text agents handle tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Pick the right model for the job, cache and stream to cut latency, retry when a provider fails, compact context, optimize RAG search, track usage across providers, reduce costs and run evals to see what's actually better.

Our minimalistic tech stack

Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)

Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Technologies you will encounter: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component

Salary

  • $2000 - $4000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100% remote work

  • Allianz Gold Health Insurance with great coverage

  • Flexible hours

  • As many AI-tokens as you need

  • We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

  • Small team, real ownership — what you build actually goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

  • Get things done, every day matters

  • Transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

  • High standards for our own work and each other's

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel — heads up, it's in German.

Requirements

You are:

  • fluent in German and English.

  • a seasoned developer with more than 2 years of experience building production agents

  • AI-native in production. You've shipped agentic features real users rely on, and you have opinions on retrieval, evals, tool design, and where today's frontier models break down.

  • a builder first. You'd rather ship a rough v1 today than spend three weeks planning the perfect one.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. More broadly, Discord is about empowering people to find belonging in all kinds of communities, and those people trust us to keep their communications safe. Our Platform Security Engineering team protects the systems we use to create Discord, making the “secure way” the “easy way.”

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of software engineers in articulating and pursuing the most leveraged opportunities to reduce security risk across Engineering. This team will design and build lovable “paved paths” for managing identities and access, shipping code, configuring cloud infrastructure, and operating services. If you’re an Engineering Manager who’s deeply curious, eager to own technically and socially complex projects, and excited to improve security and privacy at Discord, read on!

What you'll do

You’ll shape company-wide security strategy and lead a highly-autonomous and horizontally-integrated team of software engineers who will...

  • Develop and apply best-in-class secure baselines for cloud infrastructure, owning the security of all cloud environments
  • Manage infrastructure vulnerabilities while supporting a high-velocity engineering org with hundreds of developers
  • Secure first- and third-party software supply chains, from the dev environment through CI/CD and into production
  • Build and operate identity and access management (IAM) systems for humans and machines that are user-friendly and promote least privilege
  • Consult on risk assessments, architectural designs, threat models, code reviews, and more—pragmatically balancing security with other business considerations

What we look for

  • 3+ years of experience as people manager, having managed a team of 3+ security software engineers
  • Passion for creating diverse and inclusive teams and coaching engineers
  • 3+ years of experience securing systems with millions of users
  • Comfort with writing the roadmap, not just following one
  • Experience building in and securing cloud-based environments (we use GCP, Cloudflare, and AWS)
  • Expert reasoning about the security of complex systems, even if they contain unfamiliar components
  • Experience writing software in a general-purpose programming language (we use Python, Typescript, and Rust)
  • Experience developing with agentic AI, and a good grasp of AI security practices

Bonus points if you have…

  • Understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts (e.g. RBAC, OAuth, Zero Trust network architectures, mTLS)
  • Familiarity with build and CI/CD technologies (e.g. Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite, Spacelift)
  • Experience defining and orchestrating containers (e.g. via Kubernetes, Docker, Distroless, OCI) and serverless workloads (e.g. Cloudflare Workers)
  • Experience with running and operationalizing security platforms such as Wiz

This position is West Coast (U.S.) based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you’re welcome to work from our beautiful SF office.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Role: Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer

Experience: 5+ years of software/data engineering experience

Employment Type: Full-Time (US Remote)

Work Location: US Remote (Up to 25% travel to client sites across the US)

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to design, build, and productionize knowledge graph solutions for healthcare and clinical data.

Our architecture uses a hybrid graph approach, combining a Labeled Property Graph (LPG) for patient/clinical data with an RDF-based graph for clinical ontology and semantic knowledge.

The role will focus on translating ontology and mapping specifications into scalable graph solutions, including data transformation, graph ingestion, concept/entity linking, provenance, validation, and querying.

You will work closely with ontology, terminology, FHIR, clinical/domain, and data engineering teams to translate agreed semantic and mapping decisions into robust technical implementations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, implement, build, and maintain production knowledge graph solutions across LPG and RDF graph technologies.
  • Build scalable pipelines to transform healthcare/FHIR data into appropriate graph representations.
  • Implement mappings between patient/clinical data and concepts represented in the clinical ontology.
  • Develop reusable mapping and transformation patterns rather than one-off implementations.
  • Implement consistent approaches for entity identity, canonical identifiers/URI/IRI, relationships, and concept linking.
  • Maintain provenance and traceability between source data, mapping rules, and resulting graph entities and relationships.
  • Develop and optimize graph queries using Cypher and/or SPARQL.
  • Implement automated validation and testing to identify unresolved mappings, inconsistent relationships, and other graph-quality issues.
  • Work with ontology, FHIR, terminology, and clinical SMEs to clarify ambiguous or missing mapping requirements.
  • Participate in technical design, architecture reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software/data engineering experience, including hands-on experience with knowledge graphs or graph technologies.
  • Strong understanding of knowledge graph and graph data modeling concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with either:
    • Labeled Property Graphs, such as Neo4j/Cypher or equivalent, or
    • RDF/semantic technologies, such as RDF/RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
  • Working knowledge of, or ability to work across, both LPG and RDF graph models.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or similar languages.
  • Experience building production data ingestion, transformation, or integration pipelines.
  • Experience with graph databases and/or RDF triple stores.
  • Understanding of entity identity, graph relationships, mappings, provenance, and data quality.
  • Ability to translate conceptual models and mapping specifications into production implementations.
  • Ability to work effectively with evolving requirements and cross-functional technical/domain teams.

Other Qualifications (OQs)

  • Hands-on experience with both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs.
  • Healthcare or life sciences data experience.
  • Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, including concepts such as Coding, CodeableConcept, Reference, and Identifier.
  • Experience with ontology-driven data integration or semantic mapping.
  • Experience with SHACL or other graph/semantic validation approaches.
  • Experience with terminology/concept normalization and canonical concept mapping.
  • Familiarity with clinical terminologies such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS.
  • Cloud and CI/CD experience.

What Sets You Apart?

  • Hands-on experience with both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs.
  • Healthcare or life sciences data experience with familiarity with HL7 FHIR and clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS).
  • Experience with ontology-driven data integration, semantic mapping, and SHACL/semantic validation approaches.
  • Cloud and CI/CD engineering experience in production environment.

What’s In It For YOU At Quantiphi?

  • Make an impact at one of the world’s fastest-growing AI-first digital engineering companies.
  • Upskill and discover your potential as you solve complex challenges in cutting-edge areas of technology alongside passionate, talented colleagues.
  • Work where innovation happens - work with disruptive innovators in a research-focused organization with 60+ patents filed across various disciplines.
  • Stay ahead of the curve, immerse yourself in breakthrough AI, ML, data, and cloud technologies and gain exposure working with Fortune 1000 companies.
